raw_abilities: Overall Skill Level : Akari is a non-combatant type of sorcerer, having enrolled in Kyoto Jujutsu High as an assistant manager. She is only capable of barely seeing cursed spirits , and may have received minimal combat training, although one kick from Haruta Shigemo was enough to deal significant damage to her, leaving her motionless for several minutes, before ultimately escaping.

Overall Abilities : The Angel was a notable sorcerer during the Heian Era, the golden age of jujutsu, and served as part of the Abe Clan 's elite force, though she and her comrades were eventually defeated by Sukuna wielding his two signature cursed tools. Still, due to her experience and holding an innate technique that counters any and all jujutsu without prejudice, the Angel is a formidable force. She is fatally dangerous to fellow incarnated sorcerers who (being cursed objects fused with living flesh) are susceptible to her technique. The Angel's capabilities are made evident through Hana who, despite being a young girl with no formal sorcerer training, was sufficiently empowered by the ancient sorcerer to easily survive the Culling Game, wherein the Angel's ability made her the only player capable of crossing Colony borders freely. Ultimately, Hana cast " Jacob's Ladder " to nearly succeed in purging Sukuna, albeit the King of Curses had not yet achieved a strong hold over his new host, Megumi, nor was he at full strength. Hana failed to eliminate the Disgraced One only because he exploited the girl's love for Megumi to fool her into deactivating her technique halfway through casting it. Later, the Angel's and Hana's greatest contribution to their sorcerer allies would be when they used Jacob's Ladder on the " Back " of the Prison Realm , unsealing Satoru Gojo. Incarnation , Juniku ? ) : Like many past sorcerers, the Angel struck a deal with Kenjaku to effectively bind her soul to a cursed object, allowing her to incarnate post-mortem and possess Hana. Unlike most incarnates, the Angel has formed a symbiotic relationship that leaves Hana in control of her body, with the Angel able to speak by manifesting a second mouth on the girl's body, usually her cheek or hand (much like Sukuna could while inhabiting Yuji). However, this condition leaves the Angel unable to physically interfere in the event that Hana takes a fatal misstep during combat. Moreover, unlike Sukuna, the Angel cannot switch hosts, lacking the King of Curse's knowledge on how to divide her own soul. Flight : While possessing Hana, the Angel grants her the ability to levitate and fly. Great Intellect : The Angel has repeatedly proven herself to be shrewd, perceptive, and knowledgeable on jujutsu, which has made her a major asset to her and Hana's present-day allies. She immediately inferred that Megumi and Yuji, claiming to have sought her out, must have learned of her technique and then used that as leverage to gain her newfound allies' favor and (seeming) willingness to aid her in her goal: killing Sukuna. When the first Tokyo Colony was flooded with over a thousand foreigners of non-sorcerer status, the Angel correctly ascertained that the responsible party was Kenjaku, who was seeking a fail-safe in case the Culling Game players do not sufficiently raise the Colonies' ambient cursed energy (for the ritual to merge Tengen with Japan's populace). Perhaps most impressively, the Angel was the only one to realize the true nature and potential of Takaba's innate technique , despite the man's unassuming, frivolous demeanor. She initially realized that it may have helped Hana survive Sukuna and later recommended that Takaba be sent after Kenjaku. Otherwise, the Angel's jujutsu knowledge extends to the workings of Domain Amplification , the dynamics involved in a domain clash, and the potential recovery of a burnt-out technique using Reverse Cursed Technique . Innate Technique Technique Extinguishment , Jutsushiki no Shmetsu ? ) : The Angel's technique, inherited by Hana, allows for the "extinguishment" of any and all other cursed techniques, negating them. Barriers, seals, and cursed objects alike are susceptible, including special grades like the Prison Realm. However, the Angel admits that it is nearly impossible for her to split incarnated sorcerers from their hosts without killing both, as incarnations are fusions of cursed objects with living flesh. Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder , Shutsuryoku Saidai: Yakobu no Hashigo ? ) : An extension technique through which the Angel conjures a four-winged trumpet made of light in her hands, then an immense circle of light in the sky above her. Said circle resembles a magic array and features a heptagram in its middle, plus several crosses along its periphery. By sounding the trumpet, a pillar of light descends from middle of the circle to engulf whatever is below. Thus, any curse will be "extinguished" under the light of Jacob's Ladder.

Overall Skill Level : Todo is an exceptionally powerful sorcerer, undoubtedly one of Jujutsu High's strongest students. He obtained the rank of a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer as a student despite coming from a non-sorcerer family. Todo single-handedly defeated five grade 1 cursed spirits and 1 special grade during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons in Kyoto, having only used his cursed technique to defeat the special grade. This feat became well known around the jujutsu community and caused the rumor that Todo defeated all six curses without his cursed technique. Todo possesses physical strength that surpasses Maki and Panda 's, rivalling Yuji's prowess. Using brute force and fierce martial arts, Todo was able to easily overwhelm Megumi as well as pummel Yuji in the early stages of their bout. Even after beginning to guide Yuji on how to become stronger, Todo maintained the upper hand while fighting due to his experience and cleverness. Todo and Yuji turned out to be a good match and Todo showcased his intelligence and knowledge surrounding jujutsu sorcery and battles. Aoi's understanding of cursed energy allowed him to teach Yuji how to properly use it alongside his superhuman speed and strength. While fighting alongside Yuji, Todo was very nearly able to defeat Hanami, one of the most powerful special grade cursed spirits to have appeared. During the heat of battle against Hanami, Todo was able to analyze all their moves and instantly create ways to counter them using his own cursed technique. Hanami initially analyzed Todo to be weaker than them, but the careful planning and precise teamwork with Yuji allowed Todo to dominate the fight. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Todo prefers close quarters combat to anything else, normally relying on brute force to overpower his opponents rather than jujutsu. He completely outclassed Megumi when trading blows, easily able to outmaneuver and brutalize the first year at every turn. Even against Yuji, who's extremely talented in hand to hand fight, Todo was able to effortlessly overpower at the start of their fight. Even as the fight went on and Yuji began to adapt to Todo's moves, he was still able to surprise Yuji and stay one step ahead thanks to his combat experience. He generally employs a mix of direct and crushing blows such as punches, forearm smashes, stomps and other brutal strikes. This type of fighting was effective against Hanami, mainly while being used alongside his cursed technique. Enhanced Strength : Against most opponents, Todo is more than capable of relying on raw physicality to win fights. A single strike against Megumi was able to send him reeling back several meters. His fighting style includes a barrage of powerful blows, stomps, and suplexes in quick succession. A cursed energy infused strike from Todo is capable of obliterating a lower grade curse completely while still damaging Yuji, his intended target before the curse suddenly inhibited his punch. Alongside Yuji's enhanced punches, Todo was able to hit Hanami's guard hard enough for the special grade to acknowledge the weight of the hit. Combined with his cursed technique, Todo's strength becomes even more difficult to deal with. It allows him to exploit openings in his opponent's defense which allows him to land lethal strikes using his physical strength. Using Boogie Woogie to switch out his partner for a special grade cursed tool , Todo delivered a strike so powerful it shattered Hanami's weak point, the branches growing out of their face, in a single blow. A hit so strong, Todo believed it should have ended the fight altogether. The cursed tool, Playful Cloud relies on the strength of its user, further cementing Todo's near-superhuman levels of physical power. Enhanced Speed : To match his incredible strength Todo possesses extreme speed. He incorporates his frightening speed in his fighting style by continuously striking with quick succession before his opponents can react. He blitzed clean through Megumi's every defense in their fight and landed blow after blow to overpower him. At the very beginning of the Goodwill Event, it took Todo just a few seconds to reach the opposing team. He was even able to surprise Yuji with his speed and momentarily overpower him with sheer physical prowess. Todo's speed also allows him to move unpredictably when utilizing his cursed technique, as shown while fighting Hanami. Great Tactical Intellect : Todo's oafish demeanor fools most people, but he's actually incredibly intelligent; claiming to have an IQ of 530,000. While this is exaggerated, by using his own experience and vast understanding of jujutsu, he was able to transform Yuji from a sub-par jujutsu sorcerer to a fighter capable of taking on special grade cursed spirits. Todo even has a deeper philosophical side that was able to help Yuji grasp the understanding of jujutsu. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Todo understands the essence of cursed energy and possesses masterful control over it. He understands the nature of how to make cursed energy effectively flow throughout his entire body, allowing him to freely manipulate it as a part of his close combat arsenal and making his flow of energy difficult to read. He is sufficiently knowledgeable in this aspect of cursed energy that he can teach it to others. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Todo has a good understanding of how to utilize cursed energy to reinforce his body. He is able to strengthen his punches enough to obliterate low-grade curses in a single punch and can infuse his energy into cursed tools. For defense, Todo can also apply a coating of cursed energy to his body to protect himself from attacks. Black Flash , Kokusen ? ) : A phenomenon that creates a spatial distortion when a user connects an impact of cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, causing cursed energy to flash black, creating a more potent attack to the power of 2.5 of a normal hit. Todo first used Black Flash when him and Yuji fought Mahito during the Shibuya Incident. Currently, he has performed it once. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how his cursed technique works, Todo increases the effectiveness of his technique as well as mislead his opponents on how it works. Innate Technique Boogie Woogie , Bugi Ugi ? ) : Todo's innate technique allows him to switch the positions of anything with cursed energy within his range with a clap of his hands. He can change himself out with the location of another person, or switch two different parties other than himself as well. Though a clap is required to trigger the ability, he does not have to clap both of his hands specifically, as Todo is shown triggering Boogie Woogie by clapping Mahito's hand with his own. Boogie Woogie: Revised , Bugi Ugi Kai ? ) : After losing his left hand and replacing it with a vibraslap , Todo changed the condition for activating Boogie Woogie from a clap to a metal piece hitting a wooden box. This allows him to perform approximately 50 swaps per second, if necessary. Through a binding vow, the range and targets of his technique may also be expanded if the number of swaps per strike on the vibraslap is limited. Anti-Domain Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that disables a domain expansion 's sure-hit effect within its area by neutralizing its barrier. Todo learned this technique from Yuki Tsukumo .

Overall Skill : Arata Nitta is a first-year student and a non-combatant type of jujutsu sorcerer. He doesn't appear to have much experience but his technique makes him useful on missions despite his lack of combat ability. Arata has knowledge of basic first aid and any type of healing techniques are extremely rare among jujutsu sorcerers, making him a highly valuable asset. While Mechamaru made it so most of the Kyoto students would stay away from Shibuya for their own safety, he was confident that Arata would be helpful during the incident. Innate Technique Pain Killer : This technique allows Arata to stop existing injuries from getting any worse. Arata can't heal wounds but he can stop bleeding and reduce the pain for anyone he applies it to. However, any injuries sustained after the technique's application are unaffected. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level : Despite not possessing an innate technique, Kusakabe is a respected grade 1 sorcerer and a master swordsman of the New Shadow Style. Mei Mei regarded Kusakabe as the only sorcerer of his grade to make that rank without an innate technique. According to her, Kento Nanami and Gojo, Kusakabe is the strongest grade 1 sorcerer, though Gojo specified that this statement may not be accurate if sorcerers from the Big Three Families were to be taken into account. Despite such praises, Kusakabe openly admits on several occasions he has no chance of defeating a special grade and avoids them at all costs. However, he is fully confident he can defeat other adversaries such as the curse users Toshihisa Negi and Manami Suda , who he considered below his level. While several jujutsu sorcerers in training were fighting to get Prison Realm from Kenjaku, Kusakabe intervened just in time to save the lives of all his allies. Kenjaku even commented on Kusakabe's knowledge on New Shadow Style, seemingly out of respect for his skill. Master Swordsman : Kusakabe's swordplay is his main weapon in battle, relying heavily on physical prowess. In combination with the swordsmanship techniques of the New Shadow, he has showcased high proficiency in wielding his blade. Using Batto Sword Drawing , Kusakabe made short work of three curse user henchmen in an instant. New Shadow Style Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a Domain Expansion 's barrier and disables its sure-hit effect within its range. Kusakabe used Simple Domain to weaken Sukuna's Dismantle , reducing the damage of the slashes done to him. Batto Sword Drawing , Batt ? ) : A fast sword drawing technique that coats Kusakabe's blade in cursed energy and rotates it around the blade to increase its drawing speed dramatically, enough so to make it the fastest iai-sword drawing technique of the New Shadow Style. Evening Moon Sword Drawing , IaiYzuki ? ) : Another sword-drawing technique with a different stance than Batto Sword Drawing that activates a Simple Domain. By incorporating an original program into the Simple Domain, Kusakabe can automatically intercept anything that enters the Simple Domain with his katana. Hazy Moon , Oborozuki ? ) : A New Shadow Style technique that recreates part of a broken blade with cursed energy.
Overall Skills: Bayer is a sorcerer with unknown capabilities, but he is said to be the strongest member of Q. Bayer has been shown to use several throwing daggers.

Overall Skill : Charles was a normal person before the Culling Game and was unknowingly given the capacity to develop a cursed technique by Kenjaku . Since developing his technique, Charles has become a proficient jujutsu user and spearman with his G-Warstaff. It is unknown if he eliminated any other players but he has a basic understanding of jujutsu, including understanding how cursed energy and domains work. Charles' combat prowess was capable of forcing Kinji Hakari to take him seriously in a fight despite never gaining much of an advantage over him. He was outmatched against Hakari in terms of speed and strength but was able to use his own cursed technique to keep the fight competitive. He understood how the ability to see the future could be practically applied in a duel and gave the Jujutsu High student a challenge. Charles even managed to injure Hakari right before he hit the jackpot in his domain. However, Charles was no match for Hakari after he hit the jackpot and was defeated by a single blow. Innate Technique G Warstaff , J Senj ? ) : Charles can conjure G Warstaff, a cursed tool to which his innate cursed technique is directly tied. G Warstaff is a long spear with a pen-shaped tip. By drawing his opponent's blood into the pen's tip, Charles can fulfill the condition for "ink". After which, Charles can use the ink to mark his opponents with a manga panel. This panel is forward from the present, allowing Charles to peer into his target's very near future, starting with just one second. As G Warstaff draws more blood and fills with ink, Charles is able to see further into the future.

Overall Skill Level : Although the full extent of Miyaguni's abilities is unknown, she is classified a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer. As a child, she was mentored by Aoi Todo and Yuji Itadori . In addition to having an innate technique , Miyaguni is also a master of the New Shadow Style and is Tsurugi's senior in the discipline.

Overall Skill Level : Little of Chizuru's combat prowess has been on display. He is a skilled enough sorcerer to score 28 points in the Culling Game and to be considered as one of Reggie's allies. However, he was easily overpowered by Megumi on two separate occasions. Chizuru was even killed by him in their second skirmish without ever revealing the power of his cursed technique. Innate Technique Chizuru's technique allows him to shift his fingers into dark claws. It is unknown if their offensive ability was purely physical or if they had some effect on impact. Chizuru attempted to strike Megumi by changing the fingertips on his left hand into claws but failed to land a single hit.

Overall Skill : As a member of the Hei, the Zenin Clan's strongest team of sorcerers, Chojuro was at least of semi-grade 1 level. Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Although he was no match for Maki 's immense physical prowess during her rampage, he displayed some hand-to-hand combat capabilities and decent mobility before perishing. Innate Technique Earth Manipulation : Chojuro's technique allows him to manipulate the earth to some degree. By touching the ground and activating his ability, Chojuro created two giant stone arms to attack Maki, clasping her between the hands. She was easily able to break out, surprising Nobuaki who believes she shouldn't have been able to move at all after being hit. The training ground where Maki and Naoya fought was made by him. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level : As a Cursed Womb: Death Painting, Choso was ranked special grade. After his incarnation, Choso remains exceptionally powerful even by sorcerer standards, comparable to a grade 1 sorcerer. While still existing as a cursed object, Choso was intelligent and self-aware, allowing him to hone his cursed techniques for 150 years. By the time he was incarnated, Choso had already mastered Blood Manipulation to a level that far surpasses the current Noritoshi Kamo . During his minimal role in the battle to seal Satoru Gojo, Choso showcased a host of different Blood Manipulation techniques. None of them could breach Gojo's Infinity, but they were also used to slaughter tons of non-sorcerers to put him at a further disadvantage. In addition to jujutsu, Choso also excels in taijutsu, capable of standing up against a master martial artist like Yuji. Using his wit alongside a host of techniques to contend with Yuji's strength, Choso overcame his opponent to the degree that he could have ended his life. This is even after Mechamaru helped the Jujutsu High student put the blood manipulator in a situation where he couldn't control it outside his body. Despite exhausting himself during the Shibuya Incident , Choso continued to fight on and clashed with Kenjaku in order to help Yuji. Although Kenjaku escaped mostly unscathed, his partner Uraume was hit by Choso's Piercing Blood technique and poisoned. A sorcerer of Uraume's caliber was strong enough to completely immobilize all Yuji's allies. Uraume was able to freeze Choso as well, but after Yuki Tsukumo rescued everyone from Uraume's Icefall , enough time had passed for Choso's poison to take effect. Naoya Zenin, a special grade 1 sorcerer and inheritor of the former head of the Zenin Clan 's Projection Sorcery , is another close combat fighter that Choso battled and defeated. Choso was quickly able to deduce that Naoya was a speed type and there was a trick to it hidden within his cursed technique. While Choso was still outclassed by Naoya's speed and suffered a one-sided beating at the beginning of their fight, he managed to tough it out thanks to his physical endurance and unwavering willingness to defend his little brother. Although Naoya managed to injure the Death Painting Womb and slice him open, Choso turned his wound into an advantage and once again overcame Naoya by using different Blood Manipulation moves in a variety of clever ways. Out of a group of sorcerers, Choso was one of the three Tengen asked to guard them against Kenjaku. Despite losing to Kenjaku in the end, Choso fought strategically with Yuki and Tengen to nearly achieve victory, fulfilling his role the best he possibly could. Choso was the first to fight Kenjaku and his goal was to draw out his father's hidden abilities. He struggled against solely Cursed Spirit Manipulation at first, and weak cursed spirits at that. Choso was unable to effectively counterattack until he used Blood Manipulation in inventive ways by taking inspiration from his brothers. Kenjaku overpowered Choso with low-grade cursed spirits reinforced with his cursed energy but Choso's clever use of blood nearly landed an attack that not even he, a sorcerer with centuries of experience, saw coming. Choso successfully forced Kenjaku to reveal an innate technique other than Cursed Spirit Manipulation and earned Yuki's praise. Choso surprised Kenjaku a second time when he re-entered the fray after allowing Yuki to take over. Despite his injuries, Choso continued to play a pivotal role in the fight, rescuing Yuki and ambushing Kenjaku in one fell swoop. Choso understood it had to be Yuki to deal a decisive blow and fought alongside her shikigami to buy her time to heal herself. This allowed them to take the momentum back which again impressed Yuki, who initially believed Choso would hold her back if they fought together. High Tactical Intellect : Choso has existed for one-hundred and fifty years and one of his greatest weapons is his incredible level of wisdom. His mastery over Blood Manipulation has allowed Choso the freedom to experiment and utilize its abilities in ways that are all unique to him. He applies the technique in many different ways during battle to swing the tide in his favor. When the ability to manipulate blood outside his body was stripped from him, Choso instinctively focused on controlling the blood inside him in spite of his minimal battle experience. Choso knew he couldn't physically compete with Yuji, so he used Flowing Red Scale: Stack to even the odds. Although Yuji began to gain the upper hand in close combat, Choso hid some blood in his hand to ensure it didn't dissolve and shot a Blood Meteorite through his robe to hide the projectile that successfully pierced Yuji's liver. After being on the receiving end of three of Yuji's superpowered punches, Choso quickly assessed the heavy damaged he received and determined that he was a severe threat. He risked thrombosis and hardened blood within his body and used it to block what could've been Yuji's fight-ending blow. Yuji believed that Choso wouldn't think he would use his left hand because he injured it early in the fight. However, not only did Choso predict he would use his left hand, but he also correctly foresaw exactly where he would try to land that punch. Choso hardened his blood to protect his body in the perfect spot and was able to defeat Yuji as a direct result of his tactical prowess. When faced with the responsibility of protecting Yuji against an impossible opponent like Yuta Okkotsu, Choso was able to form a solid plan in a very short amount of time. Although Choso was ultimately thwarted, he wanted to block off Yuta and allow Yuji to escape while also dealing with Naoya so the speed-type couldn't give chase. Once Choso realized he was at a disadvantage, he focused Flowing Red Scale: Stack in his eyes to raise his dynamic visual acuity in order to track Naoya's speed. He also noticed that Naoya was familiar with Blood Manipulation and got the Zenin clan sorcerer to walk right into Supernova , a technique original to Choso and something Naoya's clan would have no knowledge of. Choso's wise and coolheaded nature pairs well with his overall intellect. He is a formidable strategist, best displayed when he helped create the best possible plan to combat Kenjaku with Yuki and Tengen. Choso pointed out that Kenjaku wouldn't open his domain against Yuki if he knew someone else was lying in wait. The plan was altered to use Choso to draw out Kenjaku's cursed techniques and convincingly remove himself from the fight. This was ultimately successful despite a few mishaps, as Kenjaku didn't expect Choso's return to the fight and was caught completely off guard by his ambush. Choso's intelligence also extends to practical situations that don't include combat. When faced with the obstacle of getting past Tengen's concealing barrier, Choso had the clever idea of copying how Mahito invaded during the Goodwill Event . The cursed warehouse storing cursed objects such as the Death Painting Womb lies between Tengen's doors and the Tombs of the Star. By tracking the presence of his six brothers, Choso can guess the one correct door out of thousands to breach Tengen's barrier. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : As previously stated, Choso excels in unarmed combat and was able to overpower two powerful combatants that fight exclusively at close range, Yuji and Naoya. Enhanced by his cursed techniques, Choso's martial arts is a threat that can even contend with the likes of Yuji. Enhanced by Blood Manipulation, Choso was able to parry and counter Yuji's martial arts with his own. Immense Endurance : As noted by Naoya Zenin, Choso is exceptionally tough. He was able to withstand multiple hits from Yuji, who possesses superhuman strength enhanced with cursed energy and masterful precision in his martial arts technique. The Death Painting Womb was also on the receiving end of consecutive blows from Naoya that carried the momentum from him moving at blistering speeds. In both hard-fought battles, Choso was able to endure and come out on top. Choso continued to press on even after his lengthy duel with Yuji as a testament to his stamina as well. Choso received his most brutal beating fighting one-on-one against Kenjaku. He was severely injured by an onslaught from Cursed Spirit Manipulation but used the image of his brothers to persevere and continue fighting. Even after thoroughly expending himself, Choso returned to ambush Kenjaku and fought effectively alongside Yuki until he was eventually incapacitated. Even then, Choso still activated one last cursed technique in an attempt to stop Kenjaku. Blood Connection : A unique ability of Blood Manipulation that only pertains to a Death Painting Womb like Choso allows him to sense the "transformation" of his younger brothers no matter how far away they are. Death is considered a transformation, which is why Choso could feel when Eso and Kechizu were killed. This also caused him to foresee Yuji's upcoming death with his own eyes accompanied by an intense sensation that stopped Choso from slaying him. Blood Poisoning : Like Eso and Kechizu, Choso's blood is also poisonous. It takes effect fairly quickly and drains its victim's stamina, causing them to soon find themselves short of breath. Uraume's Ice Formation technique was even forcibly disengaged when the poison took effect on them. Naoya was also wounded by Choso and his body began to reject the incarnated cursed object's non-human blood, causing him to vomit. Blood Conversion : Choso's constitution as a Death Painting Womb allows him to convert his cursed energy into blood. As long as Choso has enough cursed energy, he can prevent his body from dying of blood loss. This makes him capable of bleeding a literal wave of blood without suffering any significant disfunction in his performance. This unique ability also makes learning reverse cursed technique easier for Death Painting Wombs, as they do not experience the massive cursed energy consumption needed to convert cursed energy into blood for human sorcerers. Inherited Technique Blood Manipulation , Sekketsu Sjutsu ? ) : The Kamo ancestor controlled by Kenjaku mixed his blood with the human and cursed spirit that resulted in the Death Painting Wombs. This allowed Choso to inherit Blood Manipulation and train it to its fullest extent. Choso is a master constantly using this technique to manipulate his own blood and utilizes it in nearly every facet of his combat arsenal. Slicing Exorcism , Karibarai ? ) : Unleashes sharpened blood that rapidly flies through the air and slices through Choso's target. He is capable of shaping it into long streams of blood at a wide range for hitting or forming it into a rotating chakram for a singular attack. Convergence , Byakuren ? ) : Compresses and condenses the blood to its absolute limit with cursed energy. It is one of Choso's most consecutively used techniques as it is key to charging up his most powerful attacks, Piercing Blood and Supernova. There is a traditional stance for activating Convergence but Choso has used other ways to cast it as well. Choso has also used the stance as a feint to trick opponents into thinking he's about to fire Piercing Blood. Piercing Blood , Senketsu ? ) : A deadly blood beam fired from Choso's clasped hands after charging up Convergence. It possesses blistering speed and incredible piercing power, as the name implies. Choso is able to bend the beam and make it ricochet should it miss, but Piercing Blood does not maintain the same level of extreme velocity as when its first shot. Supernova , Chshinsei ? ) : A Choso original that he developed while honing Blood Manipulation for 150 years. It detonates several orbs of blood condensed with Convergence and fires reinforced blood bullets in every direction. It can also be channeled into one larger sphere that explodes into an even more devastating attack. Blood Edge , Ketsujin ? ) : Shapes and strengthens blood's lethality by rotating it at high speed, allowing Choso to shape blood outside his body into a dagger. Flowing Red Scale , Sekirin Yakud ? ) : Used to improve the performance of Choso's body by pumping blood faster throughout his body, allowing them to take in more oxygen. This improves Choso's pulse rate and the number of red blood cells, granting a drastic increase in strength and speed. When Choso activates this technique, the blood mark going across his nose grows two vertical lines on each of his cheeks that extend past his eyes. Flowing Red Scale: Stack , Sekirin YakudSai ? ) : Further improves the increased output provided by Flowing Red Scale to an even higher degree. This gave Choso the ability to compete with Yuji's superhuman physical prowess. He can also channel it into specific bodily functions such as focusing it into his ocular muscles in order to read Naoya's movements. When Choso activates this version of the technique, the three blood marks going across his nose and eyes all gain arrowhead designs at the end of them. Blood Meteorite , Kesseiseki ? ) : A technique that hardens the user's blood which goes typically unused by inheritors. Choso has used it to create a small stone made of supercondensed and hardened blood. He also used it to harden the blood inside his body to reinforce himself despite the risk of thrombosis. Wing King , Shi ? ) : A technique that imitates Eso`s Maximum: Wing King by creating a halo of blood that sprouts four wasp-like wings albeit smaller than original technique. These wings are mediums to create vector lines of blood which can be used offensively. Choso utilized this technique as a distraction to surround his target with compressed blood spheres in preparation of a stronger attack . Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Within the month before the raid against Sukuna, Choso learned how to use reverse cursed technique through replacement training, acquiring it later than Yuji. He presumably used the technique to heal himself after Sukuna punched through his body with two of his fists, and was knowledgeable enough to instruct and correct Yuji on his usage to heal fatal internal wounds he missed healing. Anti-Domain Technique New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that disables a domain's guaranteed-hit effect within its range by neutralizing its barrier. Choso activated it in response to Sukuna's impromptu Malevolent Shrine to try and survive its 99 second onslaught.

Overall Skill Level : Like his older brother Maru, Cross is one of the strongest warriors among the Rumelian refugees. Osuki , another Rumelian warrior, had no confidence in defeating Cross and Maru in a fight. Innate Technique Chaos , Konton ? ) : Cross's first technique distorts the laws of order itself. Harmony , Chwa ? ) : Cross's second technique brings its targets into harmony by "harmonizing" them with the world and seeking balance between them. The targets may be specific individuals or entire groups. When used on a single person, the technique can identify someone who is their equal counterpart. In the case of biological siblings, it can specifically locate the target's sibling. When used on a group, the technique enables them to locate another group similar to themselves. It also allows both groups to communicate with each other. When the technique was used on the Simurians, they gained the ability to understand and speak Japanese. Furthermore, by applying the technique in conjunction with high-quality mul , Maru and Cross were able to construct a spaceship that transported the Rumelians to Japan. Special Traits Third Eye : Simurians possess a third eye on their foreheads that is the source of their rolloluca . All Simurians shed tears from this eye when they are born and when they die, but only Rumelians cry from their third eye when a Kalyan dies. The backlash from shedding tears from this eye can potentially be fatal.

Overall Skill Level : Dabura is widely recognized as the strongest Simurian of all those who traveled to Earth. On Simuria, he was the chosen champion of Deskunte, and easily defeated Dura, the strongest of Rumel. The Simurians traveling to Earth were confident they would be able to defeat Japan if conflict arose, solely because Dabura was on their side. Jujutsu Headquarters considers him to be an equivalent threat to Ryomen Sukuna . Dabura has engaged in fights with opponents of exceptional caliber, including his former friend Dura and Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga , the most powerful shikigami of the Ten Shadows Technique , without showing signs of significant strain. His light-based cursed technique demonstrates not only destructive capability, but also tactical versatility, forming solid constructs to manipulate the battlefield. Immense Tactical Intellect: Dabura was shown to have unprecedented levels of intellectual prowess during his duel with Mahoraga and could quickly think on his feet. He has a seemingly uncanny talent for observing and hypothesizing, and was able to instantly understand the processes of and perform reverse cursed technique and Domain Expansion by inspecting related phenomena, despite having no prior knowledge of Earth's jujutsu sorcery . Innate Techniques : Dabura's first cursed technique is a concept inherited through the Deskunte Tribe that is impossible to pronounce by Earthlings. It is described as "murderous intent given tangible form" , Shitsury namotta Satsui ? ) . Light , Hikari ? ) : Dabura's second cursed technique allows him to rapidly fire light beams of various sizes, usually from his hands or feet, which are capable of piercing opponents and causing mass destruction. The light beams can also be "solidified", forming into hard light constructs that can restrain the targets they pierced through or be stood on. Dabura is also able to move at sub-light speed using this cursed technique, dramatically increasing his speed and the kinetic energy of any attack he makes while moving. However, moving at such speeds puts a tremendous strain on his body due to the massively increased air resistance. Darkness : By pouring the positive energy from reverse cursed technique into Light, Dabura reverses its effect and generates a swirling mass of darkness between his hands. The effects of this Cursed Technique Reversal are unknown. (Unnamed) Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Dabura quickly grasped the concept of reverse cursed technique after remembering the jujutsu sorcerers' offer to treat injured Simurians and sensing the positive energy from Mahoraga's Sword of Extermination . He immediately performed the technique despite its complex process, creating positive energy to heal his mangled left leg. Domain Expansion Otherworld Between Darkness and Light: Reverse Transcendence , Ymei Iky "Sakagoe" ? ) : Dabura's domain expansion takes the form of an abstract environment filled with blocky structures, with a sphere-like construct directly behind him. Dabura learned how to expand his domain after learning barrier techniques by observing the barrier used to conceal Naunax , and used it against Mahoraga.

Overall Skill Level : Dagon was a special grade curse with the dangerous ability to generate and control water. This made him a great threat close to the level of his allies despite his lack of hostility while existing as a cursed womb. Even while docile, Dagon could easily dispatch dozens of weak non-sorcerers by using water to devour them all at once, consequently digesting and converting their flesh into cursed energy. However, he was vulnerable while alone and couldn't stand up to strong sorcerers like Naobito Zenin. Dagon was far more powerful in his evolved state in part due to his heightened intelligence and more physically imposing shape. He could generate water on such a scale that Maki claimed it far outclassed Max Elephant . Naobito and Nanami working together couldn't exorcise Dagon as quickly as it would be expected from two grade 1 sorcerers. Naobito, head of the Zenin clan at the time, recognized that Dagon had increased his cursed energy to immense levels and had access to a wide array of techniques. Dagon's jujutsu was only overcome by Naobito's speed until the cursed spirit created an opportunity to unleash his Domain Expansion. Dagon's Domain Expansion included a can't-miss attack that quickly overwhelmed his trio of opponents. While Naobito was able to weather the initial storm, Dagon recognized his opponent's talent and used intelligent maneuvering to get around his defenses. After Megumi entered the fray and expanded a domain of his own, Dagon had to fight four-on-one without his domain's guaranteed hit. Maki and Naobito were unable to deal any significant damage while fighting Dagon together and the sorcerers had to resort to trying to flee the domain. Immense Durability : Dagon's fully realized form is incredibly durable and difficult to damage, even for elite sorcerers. Alongside a flurry of several other attacks, Dagon suffered minimal damage from getting hit by Nanami's Ratio Technique , which forces critical hits. This left the sorcerer questioning if he dealt any damage at all and he felt as if Dagon had boundless health. High Tactical Intellect : Dagon's overall intelligence matured exponentially when he evolved. When his jujutsu was overcome by his adversaries' speed, Dagon fled up high to avoid them. He recognized he couldn't directly overcome Naobito's speed so he distracted him with a technique activating hand sign, giving the curse enough opportunity to actually cast his domain. Dagon accurately dedicated specific percentages of his domain's abilities to his targets and nearly eliminated all of his opponents. He was able to outmaneuver Naobito's Falling Blossom Emotion defense by using Death Swarm's endless shikigami to blow block his view before attacking. Once Dagon's can't-miss attack was neutralized by Megumi, he quickly changed strategy and focused on eliminating the competing domain. While Dagon initially misunderstood Megumi's intention, he eventually figured out Megumi was planning to use his domain to create a hole for everyone to escape. The four of them working together could never defeat Dagon head-to-head inside his domain, but allowing them to escape would leave him unable to cast Domain Expansion again. Cursed Energy Capacity : Dagon possessed massive amounts of cursed energy, which Naobito could tell from fighting him. He could use a multitude of cursed techniques that included generating enormous amounts of water from nothing, and conjuring infinite shikigami on top of his Domain Expansion. Even while relentlessly using jujutsu to counter multiple grade 1 sorcerers, Dagon never threatened to exhaust himself of cursed energy. However, after fighting a prolonged battle, Dagon would've been unable to cast a second Domain Expansion if his opponents escaped the first one. Innate Technique Disaster Tides : Dagon could produce massive waves of water without a source of it, generating it from his cursed energy alone. After outputting large volumes of water, Dagon could draw it back in and devour any victims struggling to swim. In his full-fledged form, Dagon could effortlessly release enormous tidal waves from his fingertip. Maki believed he would've easily drowned her entire team if they had fought him underground. (Unnamed) Shikigami Dagon can conjure dangerous man-eating fish and sea-serpent shikigami at will. Even without the guaranteed-hit function of his domain, Dagon can produce shikigami directly from his body. Dagon possessed a wide variety of different types of shikigami he's able to produce. His arsenal of shikigami included long eel-like sea serpents, swarms of piranhas, small sharks, and large crustaceans that are among Dagon's hardest and most powerful familiars. Death Swarm , Shiruru Ygun ? ) : An endless swarm of shikigami connected to the can't-miss effect of Horizon of the Captivating Skandha. The relentless pressure can be used to counter anti-domain techniques like Falling Blossom Emotion and Dagon can willingly divide the effectiveness of this technique among his opponents. Domain Expansion Horizon of the Captivating Skandha , Tau'un Heisen ? ) : Dagon's domain is a sunny, picturesque tropical island, where his shikigami are guaranteed to bite their prey. The domain has an umbrella and lounge chairs, which Mahito and Kenjaku use frequently.

Special Traits Third Eye : Simurians possess a third eye on their foreheads that is the source of their rolloluca . All Simurians shed tears from this eye when they are born and when they die, but only Rumelians cry from their third eye when a Kalyan dies. The backlash from shedding tears from this eye can potentially be fatal.

Overall Skill Level : Dhruv is an undoubtedly powerful sorcerer who was able to preserve his life across generations through two different incarnations after his original life. His most notable feat is single-handedly conquering Japan in the Civil War of Wa . In the modern era, the shikigami user was able to score over ninety points in the Culling Game. However, he was no match for the unusual abilities of Yuta Okkotsu, which are second only to Satoru Gojo . Incarnation: Dhruv had reincarnated himself once before, and his incarnation during modern times was his second time incarnating, indicating that Dhruv had already died once and he had learned or gained a method to incarnate himself in the past to cheat death. Shikigami Dhruv conjured two different types of independent shikigami: grotesque giant rodents with jagged teeth, four eyes, and a tail that crawled along the ground using four legs; and several small pteranodon-like creatures. The orbital routes of the shikigami constituted an inviolable domain along their trajectories. Anything that crosses the paths of Dhruv's shikigami is slashed and damaged.

Overall Skill Level : Dura is widely regarded as the strongest of the Rumel Tribe. Notably, he won a fighting tournament hosted by the Deskunte more than 12 years ago, with the Deskunte's war chief included among its participants. However, he admitted that many people did not participate in the tournament, making the other Rumelians' claim of him being the strongest Simurian dubious. Enhanced Strength : Dura demonstrated high levels of physical power. He was able to break apart a boulder several times larger than himself into pieces with a single strike.

Overall Skill Level : As a cursed object , Eso was ranked special grade . Eso was incarnated by Mahito 's group in order to aid in helping curses to take over Japan. Despite ultimately being defeated by jujutsu students, Eso and Kechizu were entrusted with retrieving one of Sukuna 's fingers and nearly killed the students attempting to do so. Eso's power proved to be greater than that of his younger brother, but both of them pale in comparison to their eldest brother, Choso. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Eso is capable of reinforcing his body with cursed energy. He attempted to endure Yuji's cursed energy-infused punch by reinforcing his arm, but the unexpected power enhancement from Black Flash easily destroyed it. Blood Conversion : Being a Death Painting Womb, Eso has a special attribute that allows him to transform his cursed energy into blood. As long as Eso has enough cursed energy, he can prevent his body from dying of blood loss. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how his cursed technique works, Eso can increase the effectiveness of his technique, shortening the time it takes for Decay to kill his target. Innate Technique Rot Technique , Shokuran Fujutsu ? ) : Eso's innate technique grants him corrosive blood that can poison and decompose his target upon contact. It also grants him the ability to reshape and manipulate his blood. Eso's blood is said to have a different quality than Kechizu's. Maximum: Wing King , GokunobanShi ? ) : The maximum technique of Rot Technique that reshapes the blood flowing out of Eso's back into wasp-shaped wings. These wings grant Eso more mobility as well as a way to attack with lines of blood from long range. Decay , Ky ? ) : Once Eso or Kechizu's blood enters their target through mucous membranes or wounds, this technique is activated. The blood begins to poison and decompose the target's body at the point of entry, forming a floral pattern. The technique is expected to kill a person within 10 to 15 minutes, leaving only their bones behind.

Overall Skill Level : Takaba is unsuspectingly strong, and his zero score in the Culling Game does not reflect his actual strength. His goofy attitude leads people to heavily underestimate him. He's a self-proclaimed old-school entertainer who is pro-violence and his resolve translates into battle. When he's determined to entertain, Takaba's strength increases dramatically. Reggie Star was surprised by this surge in power, as Takaba was able to overwhelm Hazenoki in a swift exchange. Reggie recognized Takaba's elite speed and considered him a strong opponent. After seeing Takaba's initial attacks against Hazenoki, Megumi stated that he was glad Takaba was not his enemy. Takaba's unconventional technique and fighting style opposed even Kenjaku in battle. The Angel , an ancient sorcerer, suggested that he should be the one to take on Kenjaku because she had faith in the strength of his cursed technique. He rendered Cursed Spirit Manipulation completely harmless and Kenjaku admitted if he wasn't careful, a thousand years of jujutsu knowledge would've been useless against him. Even after he realized how Takaba's technique functioned, the comedian overwhelmed him in each imaginary situation and constantly forced the ancient sorcerer to pivot strategies. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Takaba may not seem like a fighter, but he's exceptionally adept at close-quarters combat. He was able to overpower Hazenoki with an expertly performed surprise drop kick. In their next exchange, Takaba parried his opponent and landed a "blow" from behind, before following up with a powerful roundhouse kick. Later toward the end of their battle, Takaba was easily able to avoid Hazenoki's punches after covering himself in ankake sauce with his technique. Cursed Energy Output : Takaba boasts impressive levels of cursed energy that flared up enough for Reggie and Hazenoki to be on guard when he was only going to tell a joke. When he first attacked Hazenoki, his cursed energy increased dramatically and Reggie took note of the dramatic shift in output. Takaba's reinforced attacks were able to knock Hazenoki through several buildings. Innate Technique Comedian , Komedian ? ) : When Takaba thinks of something he's certain will be funny, it becomes reality. It's a technique with enough potential to oppose even Satoru Gojo , but Takaba is utterly clueless of his own power. It not only manifests phenomena in the form of comedic scenarios that can pull in others and compel their participation. The technique even integrates others' thoughts as feedback, a form of soul resonance. Comedian requires absolute assurance and confidence to activate. Any detriment to Takaba's belief in his abilities will prevent the technique from working.

Overall Skill : Haba was marked by Kenjaku and gained the capacity to develop an innate cursed technique in order to participate in the Culling Game. He developed into a sorcerer of similar strength to his partner but it is unknown how many points either of them scored. While Haba does try to infer his opponent's moves, his approach isn't tactical enough to properly take advantage of his cursed technique. He's too overconfident in his propeller's capabilities, boasting it can slash through steel. Haba should take advantage of the high ground during battles against opponents who can't fly but instead, he attacks at close range with his propeller blades. This lead to his downfall against Yuji, who lead him indoors and targeted his head as a vital spot. While he could threaten powerless people like Rin, Haba was soundly defeated by players with strength comparable to grade 1 like Higuruma and Yuji. Innate Technique Helicopter Hair : Haba's cursed technique changed his hair into a propeller with four blades. By activating it, Haba can fly around and suspend himself in the air. He's able to adjust the length and angle of his propeller as well as increase its rotational speed and toughness. Like Hanyu, it is likely that Haba's cursed energy is mainly focused on his hair. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level : Hagane is a reincarnated master swordsman who possesses peerless skills with a blade. He is a non-sorcerer, making him an outlier among Culling Game players who can wield a sword but not cursed energy . Even without cursed energy, Hagane's swordsmanship empowers him tremendously, putting him on equal terms with jujutsu users. Hagane wielded a sword with greater skill than even Maki Zenin before she was fully realized. Hagane bifurcated the vengeful spirit, Naoya Zenin , with ease, an opponent Maki struggled mightily against in their first encounter. Upon receiving Maki's sword, everyone around Hagane was overwhelmed by an aura of sheer lethality. Hagane cannot physically see cursed spirits, but he's able to "see everything else" around them, allowing him to accurately target curses with his attacks. He can also sense if the katana he's wielding is a cursed tool , referring to Maki's sword as a demonic blade.

Overall Skill Level : Hajime Kashimo is one of the strongest sorcerers Kenjaku came across 400 years ago. Although Kenjaku considered him inferior to Sukuna, he respected Hajime's strength and invited him to enter a binding vow to participate in the Culling Game. Even as an elderly man, Hajime could decimate entire battlefields and leave numerous dismembered corpses in his wake. Returned to a youthful body with a second chance at the prime of his life, Hajime quickly dominated the Culling Game and became the first player to add a new rule. Hajime effortlessly eliminated at least forty other players in only twelve days and gained notoriety throughout the Tokyo colonies. Hajime considered all those he eliminated to be far too weak, even more so than those from 400 years ago. When Hajime encountered Panda, he quickly considered that the harmless animal could actually be another player. He attacked Panda and completely outclassed him in a fight. Panda considered Hajime to be overwhelmingly swift and devastatingly strong. Hajime's speed, strength, and durability quickly overpowered even Panda's Gorilla Mode . Able to overcome cursed corpse 's attacks, including withstanding Unblockable Drumming Beat with ease, Hajime considered Panda to be a weakling as well. Even when faced with Panda's trump card, Hajime easily overcame his opponent's Triceratops Mode using his electrified cursed energy that struck like a bolt of lightning. Matched up against Hakari, Hajime went toe-to-toe with the elite Jujutsu High student while he was overflowing with infinite cursed energy. Even at a disadvantage to Hakari's fully automatic reverse cursed technique , Hajime was able to overpower and nearly kill him on several occasions without using his innate technique. With Mythical Beast Amber activated, Hajime pressured Sukuna, the strongest sorcerer in history (albeit heavily injured), and forced him to heal by completing his incarnation. However, against Sukuna's true form, Hajime was heavily outmatched and quickly overpowered even with his innate technique active. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Hajime is an exceptional fighter on all accounts and this is exemplified by his mastery of martial arts. Rather than depend on his cursed technique, Hajime prefers close combat and overwhelms his opponent with flurries of strikes supplemented by electrified cursed energy. Even while armed with his pole, Hajime openly engaged in unarmed striking and pummeled Panda with a barrage of punches. Up against an opponent with physical capabilities improved by infinite cursed energy, Kashimo was still able to hold his own and fight on even terms with Hakari. For example, Hajime hit Hakari with a three-hit combination that included a high kick, a right jab, and a knee to the face. Then he countered Hakari's flying knee with a spinning elbow. A testament to Hajime's skill in close combat is his ability to parry attacks into grappling situations to land elbows and knees. In Hakari's base state, Hajime was easily able to outpace and overpower him, displaying his overall mastery of martial arts. His opponent couldn't defend against Hajime's strikes and Hajime could easily read Hakari's attacks and parry them. He avoided Hakari's punch slipped around behind him and elbowed his neck, knocking Hakari unconscious. After Hakari undid the damage, Hajime slipped another strike, moved his opponent's arm from a defensive position, and landed a chop followed by an elbow that knocked Hakari out again. Great Tactical Intellect : Hajime's clever decision-making and use of his strengths display his wealth of experience and high battle IQ. He quickly assesses his opponent's capabilities and uses his own to create a clear path to victory. Hajime took a single hit from Panda's Unblockable Drumming Beat and could tell it dealt internal damage. He dealt with Panda's unblockable attack by using superior speed and fighting technique to effortlessly outmaneuver and overpower Gorilla Mode. Hajime severed Panda's arm and used it as a feint to get his opponent to turn around and leave himself open. Against Hakari's unique power set, Hajime understood the potential of his opponent's power without knowing the full details of his cursed technique. After their first hand-to-hand combat exchange, Hajime realized that Hakari's massive cursed energy output could resist his electrified cursed energy. After learning how Hakari's domain and unkillable mode work, Hajime knew that he could win the fight simply by outlasting Hakari's bonus round and killing him in his base state. Hajime's lust for a challenge led him to do the opposite, but he did form a definitive plan to defeat Hakari. Hajime attempted to kill Hakari in his unkillable mode using a number of clever tactics. He used his advanced knowledge of jujutsu to try and overcome Hakari's automatic reverse cursed technique. Hajime is aware positive energy flows from a sorcerer's brain and tried to destroy Hakari's head with several would-be fatal strikes, including a lightning bolt to his face. Hakari assumed Hajime's lightning needed time to recharge before he could fire again but in reality, the latter had accumulated another electrical on his polearm in advance. Using a different method to kill Hakari, Hajime received the electrical charge as feedback through Hakari's torso, dealing a fatal blow just as the time for his bonus round ended. When Hakari's luck overcame this, Hajime tried to poison him instead of destroying his head. He used his electrified cursed energy to perform electrolysis on seawater in order to create chlorine gas. Hajime's final attempt on Hakari's life was to use his remaining cursed energy to create a steam explosion while they were fighting underwater. He grabbed onto Hakari's arm at the same time so in case he survived the explosion, he would lose his arm and wouldn't be able to open his domain again. Cursed Energy Trait : Hajime's cursed energy has the properties of an electric current, putting his body in a constant state of electrification. This makes Hajime's cursed energy-reinforced physical attacks impossible to defend against, as his hits shock the opponent upon impact. It also provides Hajime with a natural resistance to electricity, displayed when he nullified a direct attack from Kamutoke . However, Hajime also has a natural weakness to water. If he's completely submerged, releasing his cursed energy will cause it to be drawn out by the water until it's completely depleted. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Hajime has such a high degree of skill in manipulating his cursed energy that he was the strongest sorcerer of his era and became one of the strongest players in the Culling Game without needing to activate his innate technique. Due to Hajime's advanced manipulation skills, he can somewhat suppress the leakage of his electrified cursed energy even while underwater. Lightning Discharge : Manipulating the characteristics of his cursed energy allows Hajime to freely separate its electric charges. By applying the positive charge to his target immediately, Hajime can discharge the negative charge without losing any electricity to the ground. This results in a powerful lightning strike that rends the air and is guaranteed to hit without the need for domain expansion. After discharging this attack, Kashimo needs time to recharge before he can fire it again. Innate Technique Mythical Beast Amber , Genj Kohaku ? ) : Hajime's innate technique reconstructs flesh in order to manifest phenomena of electricity, which he converts from cursed energy. Kashimo's body far surpasses the realm of humans when using his technique, so it can only be used once before his flesh collapses. Anti-Domain Techniques Hollow Wicker Basket , Iyako Tsuzura ? ) : The anti-domain technique predecessor to Simple Domain . Hajime intended to use it to counter Kinji Hakari's Idle Death Gamble , but the domain's activation was too fast and its sure-hit effect was harmless.

Overall Abilities : Hana is a willing combatant, but her abilities have scarcely been on display during the Culling Game. While the Angel is responsible for all of Hana's jujutsu prowess, the girl is still a skilled sorcerer despite her young age and appears to have wholly mastered the Angel's innate technique . She has shown herself very capable at mid-range, using her wings to fly while accurately casting her ability, and she can employ the Angel's signature move, Jacob's Ladder , on a massive scale at maximum cursed energy output. During the Culling Games, Hana mainly used her powers outside of combat. She can not only fly using the wings manifested through the Angel's power but also employ the Angel's technique, which allows Hana to "extinguish" all other cursed techniques without prejudice. This afforded the girl a number of advantages during the Culling Game that no other sorcerer enjoyed. This included being able to pass through barriers freely. Hana was the only player who could cross Colony borders, whereas others were trapped within single Colonies until the game's 12th rule was added. Although Hana did score points in the Culling Game (a total of 15), she was mainly seen acting to rescue people while around Megumi and Yuji, her wings making it easier to move around and carry others to safety. It was when Hana came to face Sukuna himself that she showed how exceedingly dangerous she can be when wielding the Angel's technique, especially to incarnated sorcerers who are effectively cursed objects. In fact, Hana could possibly have purged Sukuna right then and there because the King of Curses had not yet achieved a strong hold over his new host (nor was he at full strength yet); she failed to do so because Sukuna was able to lure the girl into disengaging her technique halfway through using it. Arguably Hana's greatest contribution to Yuji, Megumi, and their allies was when she used Jacob's Ladder on the " Back " of the Prison Realm to free Satoru Gojo. After being grievously injured by Sukuna and losing her arm, Hana's abilities were diminished. This was demonstrated when she activated Jacob's Ladder during the final battle with Sukuna. Whereas before it was capable of nearly defeating 15-fingered Sukuna, a heavily weakened 20-finger Sukuna was capable of enduring the attack and jumping up on debris to eliminate her. Flight : Using the Angel's power to manifest wings, Hana can fly and stay suspended in the air. Innate Technique Technique Extinguishment , Jutsushiki no Shmetsu ? ) : The Angel's cursed technique allows for the "extinguishment" the nullification of any and all cursed techniques. Barriers and cursed objects alike are no exception, including special grades like the Prison Realm. While the Angel's technique has a small chance of reverting incarnations to a pre-incarnation state, it is far more likely that a given vessel will perish as a result. Maximum Output: Jacob's Ladder , Shutsuryoku Saidai: Yakobu no Hashigo ? ) : An extension technique that conjures a four-winged trumpet made of light in Hana's hands as well as an enormous circle of light in the sky above her. Said circle resembles a magic array that features a heptagram in its middle and several crosses along its periphery. By sounding the trumpet, a massive pillar of light descends from the circle to engulf whatever is below. Any cursed technique will be "extinguished" under the light of Jacob's Ladder.

Overall Skill : Hanami is a special grade cursed spirit with an incredibly durable body, powerful cursed techniques that can control plants, and an uncanny ability to hide their presence more effectively than others. They were able to take Gojo by surprise and momentarily take advantage of Yuji Itadori 's vulnerability using their Flower Field and a wooden monster in order to rescue Jogo. This was achievable due to a combination of Hanami's high intellect as a curse as well as their escaping abilities and hidden presence. Gojo himself commended Hanami's ability to run away, as they were able to evade the Six Eyes ' strong perception. Satoru even found Hanami far more threatening than the straightforward Jogo. Hanami was able to pass through the barriers of Jujutsu High due to their unique skillset and was the cornerstone of their group's assault on Jujutsu High during their raid of the cursed warehouse. The special grade curse was able to take on six of the school's most elite students, rendering the majority of them unable to fight after encountering them. Additionally, Hanami was able to survive Gojo's Hollow Technique: Purple after reaching their limit fighting against Yuji and Aoi Todo , although barely clinging to life. In Hanami's final battle with Gojo, they were targeted due to their previous two encounters with the strongest sorcerer. While Hanami showed the capacity to follow Kenjaku 's plan to corner Gojo and was vital to his eventual sealing, they would not survive to see it through. They made a crucial mistake by switching to their innate technique that Gojo was able to exploit. Hanami's eye branches are the most vulnerable parts on their body, and without domain amplification Gojo was able to directly snap and break them off almost immediately. When the branches were fully pulled out of their hard shell, Hanami's abilities drop dramatically, making them incapable of withstanding another assault from Gojo. Immense Durability : Hanami possesses an incredibly hard shell on their body, capable of shattering Kasumi Miwa 's sword upon impact. They were also effortlessly able to brush off Noritoshi Kamo 's Slicing Exorcism attack despite it hitting the side of their head. A clean slash to Hanami's leg from Megumi Fushiguro 's sword also dealt zero damage. Even after being hit directly in their blocking arm by Maki Zenin using the special grade cursed tool , Playful Cloud , they were sent flying away but only suffered minimal damage as a result. After being hit multiple times by Maki and Megumi on their weak points, Hanami was still able to withstands their attacks, recover quickly, and ultimately subdue them with ease. The most the majority of the students could hope to achieve was stall Hanami in time for more backup to arrive. Only Yuji and Todo together were able to injure them enough to make them use their full power. Although Jogo possesses more cursed energy than Hanami and has an elemental advantage over them, he could not have survived Yuji's Black Flash assault followed by a blow from Playful Cloud wielded by Todo like Hanami was able to. Enhanced Strength : Hanami has a high degree of physical strength and can easily brutalize a human sorcerer in close range combat. Once Hanami finally closed the distance between them and Noritoshi, it only took a few strikes to incapacitate the sorcerer. On the defensive, Hanami was also able hold off Nue as the giant bird-like shikigami divebombed them with its wing. Enhanced Speed : Hanami was fast enough to swiftly escape with Jogo's head after a brief distraction. They were also able to completely blitz past Megumi and Noritoshi, taking them both off guard since Hanami was a great distance away before that moment. Hidden Presence : Gojo has stated that Hanami has the peculiar presence of a regular spirit despite definitely being a curse. Additionally, they can move through plants and erase their presence completely, making Hanami difficult to pin down. Hanami is able to move underground using the plants to escape quickly and move through barriers, avoiding exorcism from the aforementioned sorcerer twice. They also took Toge Inumaki , a semi-grade 1 sorcerer, completely by surprise after killing off another curse that the student had just noticed. Cursed Energy Capacity : As a special grade curse, Hanami had high levels of cursed energy. The difference in their amount of cursed energy and Toge's was so great that the latter quickly reached his limit from using cursed speech despite only using a few weaker commands. They were able to continuously use their innate technique throughout their battles with Megumi, Toge, Noritoshi, Maki, Yuji, and Todo without exhausting themself. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Due to their nature as a special grade cursed spirit, Hanami can easily reinforce their body with cursed energy in order to regenerate lost limbs in an instant. Regained limbs maintain the same integrity as the rest of Hanami's incredibly durable body. They can regenerate their eye branch weak points as well but not if they are fully compromised and separated from their body completely. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how their cursed technique works, Hanami can increase the effectiveness of their technique as well as mislead their opponents on how it works. Innate Technique Disaster Plants : Hanami's technique allows them to manifest the illusions of cursed plants into reality. While they appear to be manipulating normal plants using cursed energy, they are actually creating the cursed plants they control with cursed energy. Any plant or wood attack can be erased from reality just as quickly as it's manifested. Roots , Kinone ? ) : Hanami can create roots that emerge from the ground. When they limit the reach and numbers of roots, their power and speed increase. Vice versa, they can greatly expand the number of roots and their range by sacrificing speed and destructive power. Wooden Ball , Kinomari ? ) : Hanami can create a single or multiple wooden balls from cursed energy. The balls propel one or two sharp branches attack and skewer their target and then disintegrate. Hanami can also use these to suspend themself in midair. Cursed Bud , Noroi no Shushi ? ) : Hanami can launch buds that feed on the cursed energy of whoever it attaches to. The more cursed energy the person uses, the deeper its roots will extend into their bodies. Hanami can also create a giant flower that spawns a barrage of cursed buds. Flower Field , Ohanabatake ? ) : Hanami can create a circle of flowers around their opponents that distracts them with a curse that takes away their desire to fight. Hanami can launch a long range projectile that can activate this ability as well. Flower Field can be weakened depending on Hanami's injuries and Todo considered it to be one of the curse's weaker moves. Anti-Domain Techniques Domain Amplification , Ryiki Ten'en ? ) : This technique neutralizes all cursed techniques it comes into contact with; however, rather than remaining in a designated space, it acts as a fluid shield that covers the user's body completely, similar to an aura. However, the drawback is that the user cannot use their innate technique at the same time. Domain Expansion Shining Sea of Growing Branches , Dai Kkai ? ) : Hanami possesses the ability to cast Domain Expansion . The guaranteed-hit ability of the domain is the beam that is charged with Hanami's left arm. Hanami attempted to expand their domain during their fight against Todo and Yuji after they charged the flower on their shoulder with cursed energy. However, this was interrupted when the curtain keeping out Gojo was dispelled.

Overall Skill : Hanyu was marked by Kenjaku at some point in her life and given the capacity to develop a cursed technique in preparation for the Culling Game. She became a sorcerer with less than average power and a hair-based cursed technique. Her technique allows her to move through the air at great speed and hit her opponents at high velocity. It is unknown how many points she has in the Culling Game, and while she can threaten someone powerless like Rin, Hanyu is no match for someone of Yuji's level. Innate Technique Airplane Hair : Hanyu's cursed technique changes her hair into the shape of a jet plane with fiery boosters strong enough to propel her through the air at high-speed. She can gain enough velocity to drive someone through a building because the majority of her cursed energy is focused in that part of her body. Other sections of her body are less protected by cursed energy and therefore vulnerable while her technique is active. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level : Despite openly being a coward who's only willing to fight those he views weaker than himself, Shigemo is a reasonably strong sorcerer. He was recruited by Uraume to be useful to Kenjaku's plan for sealing Satoru Gojo. Non-combat sorcerers like assistant managers were easily slaughtered by him. Shigemo was also able to momentarily overpower Nobara in a fight where he was mostly focused on attacking Nitta. He was able to avoid Nobara's attacks and chase down the manager at the same time. Nobara was taken off guard by Shigemo's intelligence and his ability to land perfect strikes on her in successive fashion. However, Shigemo's strength is nothing in comparison to a true grade 1 sorcerer. Kento Nanami effortlessly beat Shigemo to a pulp without the curse user dealing so much as a scratch to him. Shigemo's innate technique makes him extremely lucky, which allowed him to survive numerous dangerous situations including his encounter with Nanami. Shigemo is mostly unaware of how his own technique works. He depends on using his cursed tool in battle, which made Nobara believe he was a mid-ranged fighter. Shigemo mainly employs crude swordplay to slice and stab opponents who can barely defend themselves. He has even thrown his blade before, but he was aware the cursed tool had the ability to act independently. In the same manner he bullied several defenseless managers, Shigemo attacked Megumi from behind after the student was already injured. Innate Technique Miracles , Kiseki ? ) : This technique erases little miracles (such as seeing a clock have the same digit across all spaces) along with memories of it, from Haruta's life and stores them, which is shown by the marks under his eyes. These stored miracles are released when Haruta's life is in danger, altering his luck to ensure he survives would-be fatal blows. When a miracle has been used, the marking turns to white.

Overall Skill Level : Hiromi Higuruma was widely regarded as a genius even before becoming a sorcerer, having established himself as a highly accomplished defense attorney capable of overcoming rigorous academic and legal challenges. However, his aptitude as a jujutsu sorcerer proved to be even more extraordinary. Upon awakening his innate technique , Higuruma carefully analyzed the domain that manifested alongside it and used it to independently grasp the fundamentals of barrier techniques . By effectively reverse-engineering barrier construction, he developed an instinctive and highly advanced understanding of cursed energy manipulation. Within only twelve days of awakening as a sorcerer, Higuruma reached a level of combat proficiency comparable to that of a grade 1 sorcerer. Prior to entering Tokyo Colony No. 1, he had already exorcised numerous cursed spirits . During the Culling Game, he personally killed at least twenty players who attempted to attack him, making him the first modern sorcerer to accumulate 100 points in the game. Higurumas exceptional legal intellect translated seamlessly into combat due to the nature of his cursed technique. Within his domain, he is able to prosecute opponents using his extensive knowledge of judicial proceedings, forcing them to participate in trials overseen by Judgeman. Through logical argumentation and evidentiary presentation, Higuruma can secure guilty verdicts that impose severe penalties on his opponents, such as the confiscation of their cursed technique or cursed energy. Once Judgeman enacts punishment, Higuruma possesses sufficient physical strength and weapon proficiency to decisively overwhelm his opponent. He wields a shape-shifting gavel with considerable dexterity, allowing him to capitalize on the vulnerability of enemies stripped of their sorcery. After successfully convincing Judgeman that Yuji Itadori was guilty, Higuruma completely deprived him of his cursed energy. Although he initially attempted to eliminate Yuji immediately, Higuruma quickly realized that Yujis resistance stemmed from his superhuman physical strength rather than sorcery. In response, Higuruma escalated his assault and unleashed his full combat capability, nearly killing Yuji. Yuji narrowly avoided defeat only by invoking his right to a retrial at the final moment. Less than two months after awakening as a sorcerer, Higurumas abilities continued to grow at an astonishing rate, reaching a level that even impressed Sukuna . He demonstrated talent rivaling that of Satoru Gojo , mastering advanced techniques such as Domain Amplification and Reverse Cursed Technique during live combat. Most notably, Higuruma displayed the rare ability to activate domain amplification with sufficient precision to subsequently resume use of his cursed technique, a feat that requires extreme cursed energy efficiency. Sukuna directly compared the level of control required to accomplish this to his own. Expert Armed Combatant : Higuruma is highly proficient at wielding his gavel cursed tool in battle. His main form of direct combat is using the gavel to smash his opponents. He makes it slightly change form to emulate an arsenal, displaying his weapon dexterity and ability to wield different types of arms. Yuji found himself nearly crushed by Hiromi and noted how the sorcerer was extremely powerful. Superior Intellect : Higuruma is extraordinarily brilliant even by Law School standards. On top of the peers who already believe him to be a genius, one of his senior mentors recommended he become a judge before even graduating. Higuruma has always readily overcome challenges such as his Law School's entrance exam and the national bar exam. To him, it was just a simple matter of using the necessary effort to ascertain the required knowledge. He applies the same reasoning to being a sorcerer, making up for the lack of experience professional sorcerers would normally have. In just under two weeks, Higuruma studied and deduced the details of jujutsu based on his awakened cursed technique. While barrier techniques are complicated to most sorcerers, Higuruma was able to reverse engineer how casting barriers work in order to master control over his cursed energy. When Judgeman confiscated Yuji's cursed energy, Higuruma was quick to figure out that this occurred because Yuji does not possess an innate cursed technique. He also surmised that sorcerers normally lose their instincts after having their cursed technique taken away. While not having cursed energy is even more disadvantageous, Yuji survived Higuruma's onslaught with pure innate talent. Rather than write Yuji off, Hiromi acknowledged the threat he possessed and never underestimated Yuji. Instead, he immediately poured all his effort into crushing Yuji before giving him any chance.
