Cursed Energy Manipulation : By analyzing the domain expansion his cursed technique granted by default, Higuruma was able to learn the basics of barrier techniques . Through reverse-engineering of barrier techniques, he understood how to control his cursed energy and reinforce himself. Higuruma's incredible skill with cursed energy manipulation allowed him to interrupt and resume his cursed technique after using Domain Amplification instead of terminating it, a feat that was only achieved by Sukuna . Reverse cursed technique also requires extremely precise cursed energy manipulation. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : By reinforcing his strikes with cursed energy, Higuruma could sufficiently enhance their power, enabling him to shatter a wooden floor and a bathtub with simple swings of his gavel. Shikigami Judgeman : Higuruma possesses a cursed technique that allows him to conjure a large shikigami with a black body that has three stubbed points that act as two arms and a leg. Each arm holds a scale and the shikigami's white face has eyes that are sewn shut with three stitches each. This gives Judgeman an appearance that resembles Lady Justice, which represents "blind justice". Judgeman has the ability to speak and is apparently impatient. Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Higuruma's genius talent in jujutsu allowed him to grasp the complex process of reverse cursed technique within less than two months after awakening as a jujutsu sorcerer. Using reverse cursed technique, he regenerated his arm and healed his legs after they were slashed by Sukuna 's Dismantle , allowing him to surprise attack the King of Curses. Anti-Domain Techniques Domain Amplification , Ry'iki Ten'en ? ) : Expands Higuruma's domain over his body like an aura, allowing him to neutralize cursed techniques that come in physical contact with him. While domain amplification is active, his innate technique cannot be activated, causing anything created with it, such as the Executioner's Sword, to disappear. Domain Expansion Deadly Sentencing , Chbuku Shishi ? ) : Higuruma's innate technique is linked to his Domain Expansion by default. It manifests a small courtroom domain surrounded by guillotines where he and his opponent are placed on podiums standing across from one other. This domain does not use a guaranteed-kill attack, instead, anyone inside is simply forced to follow its rules. Violence is not permitted in the domain and anyone who tries to engage will be returned to their podium. Inside the courtroom, Judgeman floats behind Higuruma, who acts as the prosecution. Hiromi's opponent is the defendant and Judgeman knows everything about everyone inside the domain. Higuruma does not receive any information from Judgeman, just evidence the shikigami submits for deliberation. The evidence is not conclusive and the defendant is not told what's inside. While inside the domain, the defendant is put on trial by Judgeman and the verdict depends solely on the arguments they make with Hiromi. The defendant's goal is to dispel all doubt and earn a pronouncement of innocence from Judgeman. Both the defendant and the prosecution have just one chance to make a statement before Judgeman delivers a verdict. The defendant has three options: silence, confession, and denial. After which Hiromi has a chance to offer his rebuttal based on the evidence he was given. All of these rules must be explained as per a binding vow on the domain. A guilty verdict can result in Judgeman confiscating their ability to control cursed energy. Defendants are allowed up to three retrials if they have not pleaded guilty, though each retrial will charge the defendant with another crime.

Overall Skill : Hazenoki is an elite-level sorcerer from the past with fundamental knowledge of jujutsu and enough combat prowess to apply it in a fight. He's highly tolerant to pain, willing to frequently gouge out his own eyes and teeth to provide ammunition for his cursed technique . Reggie considers Hazenoki to be exceptionally dangerous and believes he will kill anyone who makes him angry enough to go all out. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Hazenoki has remarkable control over his cursed energy, as the rare skill to use reverse cursed technique requires extremely precise cursed energy manipulation. Innate Technique Explosive Flesh : Hazenoki's innate technique allows him to remotely detonate his own body parts and use them as bombs. He generally does so by removing his eyes and teeth before using them as projectiles and exploding them on command. Using reverse cursed technique to replace his lost body parts makes it simple for Hazenoki to continue creating bombs and barrage his targets with explosions. (Unnamed) Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Hazenoki uses reverse cursed technique to replace the body parts he explodes using his innate technique. He does so fairly constantly in order to keep producing bombs in battle, a testament to his mastery over replenishing his own human flesh.

Overall Skill : Jinichi was a special grade 1 sorcerer and member of the Hei, a group of the strongest fighters within the Zenin clan. While undoubtedly a powerful sorcerer, Jinichi and the rest of the Hei were easily defeated by Maki during her avenging rampage through the clan. Jinichi unleashed his cursed technique and appeared to barrage her with numerous giant fists, but it had no effect. Innate Technique Missile Fists : Jinichi possessed a highly destructive technique that could conjure giant fists propelled by cursed energy like missiles. These massive fists accompanied Jinichi's own physical punches. He was capable of forming at least seven of these fists at once, each one being large and powerful enough to easily crush a building during a barrage. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill : Awasaka is a tough, close-combat type fighter with experience in the art of killing. Most of his work came against victims incapable of fighting back, but even in his old age, Awasaka was effective in battling other sorcerers. Awasaka's experience is made clear by his ability to use his innate technique and cursed energy manipulation to make himself nigh-invulnerable in battle. It was also shown in his hand-to-hand combat skills, capable of taking on two much younger jujutsu sorcerers at the same time. He believes the harder his opponents fight, the easier it is for him to win. Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Awasaka is a very capable close-quarters combatant who likes to throw a mix of hand strikes and athletic kicks. He was confident in taking on both Yuji and Megumi at the same time, two very proficient hand-to-hand fighters. Awasaka usually is good at picking his shots, using a wait and counter fighting style that plays to the strengths of his cursed technique. No one has ever been able to dodge his counter-attack after a desperate full swing at him. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Awasaka constantly uses cursed energy to reinforce his body and protect it from cursed techniques and slashing attacks. Combining this with his innate technique makes him nearly invulnerable to most attacks. Innate Technique Inverse : While Awasaka's cursed technique is activated, attacks become weaker the stronger they are and stronger the weaker they are. There is a maximum and minimum limit to how much of an impact can be affected by the technique.

Overall Skill Level : Jogo was one of several unregistered special grades that appeared around 2018. He was a curse born of humanity's collective fear of the earth, specifically volcanoes and, by extension, fire-based natural disasters. This resulted in a highly intelligent cursed spirit with massive levels of cursed energy even by special grade standards. Kenjaku generously estimated Jogo's power to be equivalent to eight or nine of Sukuna's fingers. While Jogo proved no match for overwhelming powers like Satoru Gojo and Sukuna (at 16 fingers worth of power), he still far outclassed even the most talented grade 1 sorcerers and other special grade curses. Non-sorcerers would combust in Jogo's very presence if he simply activated his cursed technique, and jujutsu sorcerers who entered his domain would suffer a similar fate. In Shibuya, the Zenin Team and Nanami considered Jogo to be leaps and bounds more powerful than the fully realized Dagon, whom they had just struggled mightily against. Jogo defeated Nanami, Maki, and Naobito in rapid succession using his superior speed and power. Within just a few seconds, Jogo severely disfigured Nanami, charring half of his body, permanently scarred Maki all over her body despite her superior Heavenly Restriction resilience, and fatally wounded Naobito. Despite not being able to match up against Sukuna with sixteen fingers absorbed, Jogo's strength was still acknowledged by the King of Curses. Sukuna admitted that Jogo's maximum technique might have hurt him had it landed. Throughout all the opponents Sukuna have faced over a thousand years, Jogo has stood out to him as one of the stronger ones, a great testament to his overall power. Kenjaku likewise acknowledged his strength, stating that he would have liked to have absorbed Jogo with Cursed Spirit Manipulation and acquired his technique. Highly Enhanced Speed & Reflexes : Jogo was incredibly fast, able to get past several grade 1 sorcerers without them noticing. He blitzed Nanami and Maki one after another, setting them both ablaze before they could react. Jogo even outmanuevered Naobito, one of the fastest jujutsu sorcerers, and burnt him alive right after. Highly Enhanced Durability : Jogo was always durable and not easily exorcised. He took a beating from Satoru Gojo himself and, although he was ultimately dominated, Jogo survived hits from several of Satoru's cursed techniques, including Cursed Technique Reversal: Red. He was also able to sustain himself through a prolonged fight with Sukuna, able to recover from every physical strike he was hit with. Cursed Energy Capacity : Jogo possessed extraordinary levels of cursed energy even for a special grade, comparable to eight or nine of Sukuna's fingers . Satoru and other sorcerers could sense his power was within special grade parameters just from his presence alone. Jogo relies entirely on his cursed technique in battle and used it relentlessly without exhausting himself. Jogo can also construct a domain and use a maximum technique, both testaments to his mastery over jujutsu and overall cursed energy reserves. Innate Technique Disaster Flames : Jogo possessed a volcanic innate technique that allowed him to produce highly concentrated cursed flames. He could generate flames or shoot heat rays from his palms or manifest small volcanic openings in the environment that erupted his powerful beams as well. (Unnamed) Ember Insects , Karekich ? ) : Jogo could summon small flying insect-like curses from the volcanic opening in his head. They had large stingers that produced a loud noise upon impact before detonating into a flaming explosion. Maximum: Meteor , GokunobanIn ? ) : Jogo's maximum technique generated a gigantic flaming meteor that he could hurl at his target. The impact caused immense destruction, enough so to decimate a large portion of Shibuya. Even Sukuna admitted he wouldn't have come out unscathed if Maximum: Meteor had hit him. Anti-Domain Techniques Domain Amplification , Ryiki Ten'en ? ) : Amplifies Jogo's cursed energy into an aura capable of including a can't-miss attack. Jogo refrained from doing so to free up the capacity to pour in Satoru Gojo's Limitless technique and neutralize it. Domain Expansion Coffin of the Iron Mountain , Gaikan Tecchisen ? ) : Jogo's Domain Expansion constructs the inside of a volcano he was capable of manipulating at will. Even an average sorcerer would burn up on impact and the volcanic stone within the domain serves as a deadly sure-hit.

Overall Skill Level : Prior to meeting Mahito, Junpei was weak. He was an average non-sorcerer who was constantly picked on and bullied. Mahito altered Junpei with his Idle Transfiguration and turned him into a jujutsu sorcerer , allowing Junpei to get his revenge. To his peers, it looked as if Junpei gained psychic powers they could not perceive. They were unable to view Junpei's jujutsu and Shota Ito suffered a wrath he couldn't even see. Junpei gained the ability to summon a fairly strong shikigami . This allowed him to even put up a fight against Yuji, who was a relatively new sorcerer at the time. Shikigami Moon Dregs , Orizuki ? ) : A large jelly-fish like shikigami capable of paralyzing targets with a unique poison emitted from its tendrils. The poison is created from cursed energy , and upon contact covers the skin in black spots that burn the victim as if they were being stung. Moon Dregs also has a pair of spiked stingers that can pierce through flesh.

Overall Skill Level : Juzo is a curse user with the ability to create cursed tools . Combined with his aggressive and reckless nature, he's a dangerous opponent. Kyoto Jujutsu High 's Principal Yoshinobu considered Juzo a formidable opponent despite not being as strong as the special grade cursed spirits. However, Kenjaku felt that Juzo was expendable for their cause mostly due to his attitude and refusal to follow orders. Expert Weapons Specialist : Juzo wields his axe in battle well enough to fend off Yoshinobu's waves of cursed energy. He's also an adept craftsman, having a workshop where he built cursed tools. He forged Haruta's sword for him. Dragon-Bone was his personal masterpiece, the finest cursed tool in his collection, which was later obtained by Maki Zenin . Barrier Techniques Curtain , Tobari ? ) : After setting up a commissioned curtain and channeling his cursed energy into it, Juzo can fully activate a pre-made curtain with set conditions.

Innate Technique Prayer Formation Technique , Kijin Juh ? ) : Yuki's technique activates a barrier using a "cornerstone" as its core. The barrier places a curse on those inside it, forcing them to fight, thereby amplifying the cursed energy within it. The technique is bound by a pre-established binding vow stating that the technique cannot affect Yuki himself, meaning he cannot strengthen his own abilities. This binding also applies to the "cornerstone," which carries his cursed energy, so anyone within the barrier who possesses the stone is likewise unaffected by the technique. Kensuke Nagino falsely named this technique Cursed Technique Boost , Juren Sojutsu ? ) to conceal its true nature. Night Hunt , Yokari ? ) : An extension technique that creates a barrier that confines cursed spirits, similar in function to a curtain . It also amplifies the cursed energy of humans within the barrier, making their bodies feel lighter and easier to move. Prayer to Palm Strike , Kekki Tensh ? ) : An extension technique that creates a spherical barrier around Yuki's fist, which is holding the barrier's cornerstone. Yuki then punches an opponent, which shatters the barrier and amplifies the force of the punch.

Kaori's abilities are unknown as it is unclear whether she was a jujutsu sorcerer , or if she was a case similar to Junpei 's, where a non-sorcerer possesses a cursed technique but lacks the brain structure to perform it. Innate Technique Antigravity System , Anchigurabiti Shisutemu ? ) : A cursed technique that negates gravity when used. Its cursed technique reversal allows the user to intensify the gravitational pull around them.

Overall Skill Level : Kasumi is an average jujutsu sorcerer who lacks an innate technique , but compensates with New Shadow Style swordsmanship techniques and her work ethic. Panda speculates that she is around the level of a grade 3 sorcerer. Miwa is capable of using her sword and New Shadow Style techniques effectively, as displayed when she exorcised several curses in a single sword stroke during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons . However, she was no match for Maki during the Goodwill Event , and her efforts against a powerful sorcerer like Kenjaku were useless in Shibuya as well. Binding Vows Kasumi made a binding vow during her attack on Kenjaku to enhance the slash from her Batto Sword Drawing by vowing to never swing a katana again. However, the sword was blocked and crushed by Kenjaku with his hand. New Shadow Style Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a domain 's barrier and disables its sure-hit effect in a set area of space around the user. After Kasumi assumes the proper stance, she creates a Simple Domain with a 2.21-meter radius around her. Anything that enters this space is automatically intercepted by Kasumi's blade. As part of the binding vow to perform Simple Domain, if both of Kasumi's feet leave the position where her stance began, the technique is dispelled. Batto Sword Drawing , Batt ? ) : A New Shadow Style technique that uses cursed energy to surround Kasumi's blade when sheathed and rotates it to create incredible speed when she draws the blade. It is the fastest sword-drawing technique of the New Shadow Style.

Overall Skill Level : As a cursed object , Kechizu was ranked special grade . Kechizu was incarnated by Mahito 's group in order to aid in helping curses take over Japan. Despite ultimately being defeated by jujutsu students, Eso and Kechizu were entrusted with retrieving one of Sukuna 's fingers and nearly killed the students attempting to do so. Even though Kechizu was the weakest of the three Death Painting brothers, he was still able to land a surprise attack on Yuji. Blood Conversion : Being a Death Painting Womb, Kechizu has a special attribute that allows him to transform his cursed energy into blood. As long as Kechizu has enough cursed energy, he can prevent his body from dying of blood loss. Innate Technique Rot Technique , Shokuran Fujutsu ? ) : Kechizu can manipulate his body's corrosive blood, which is capable of poisoning his targets. He generally does so by spewing blasts of rotten blood at his opponents, burning their flesh on impact. Decay , Ky ? ) : Once Eso or Kechizu's blood enters their target through mucous membranes or wounds, this technique is activated. The blood begins to poison and decompose the target's body at the point of entry, forming a floral pattern. The technique is expected to kill a person within 10 to 15 minutes, leaving only their bones behind.

Overall Skill Level : Kenjaku is an ancient sorcerer who has accumulated a wealth of jujutsu -related knowledge and experience over the course of a thousand years. His advanced understanding of jujutsu sorcery is second to none with numerous feats that display his talent. As Noritoshi Kamo, Kenjaku created the Cursed Womb: Death Paintings and became known as the most evil curse user in history. He is the only person who knows how to turn a sorcerer into a cursed object after death, something not even Sukuna knew how to do during the Heian Era. He is also the second most powerful barrier user after Tengen, recognized as one of few sorcerers who can match them in barrier techniques . Kenjaku possesses the bodies of other sorcerers and utilizes their techniques in addition to his own natural skillset. He uses Cursed Spirit Manipulation with the same degree of skill as his current host, Suguru Geto. He took Sugurus body specifically for this technique and has a masterful understanding of how it works and how best to use it for his ambitions. He forced Mei Mei , a grade 1 sorcerer who is familiar with Geto's technique, to retreat. Kenjaku not only expertly applies the technique to battle but used its applications to set up his schemes as well. For example, he absorbed Mahito with Cursed Spirit Manipulation and then used Mahitos Idle Transfiguration to set up the Culling Game. He also used the technique to absorb Tengen, who had evolved into more cursed spirit than human, continuing to further his own ends. Kenjakus talent extends well beyond jujutsu sorcery. He is an excellent unarmed combatant, is highly intelligent, and is an unrivaled mastermind when it comes to underhanded schemes. Kenjaku was the orchestrator of both the Shibuya Incident and the Culling Game , two of the largest jujutsu terrorist events in modern history. Not only were they both effectively set up and executed, but went nearly perfectly to plan. The Shibuya Incident successfully sealed Satoru Gojo, the strongest sorcerer of the modern age. Kenjaku and Uraume effortlessly held off a group of sorcerers who attempted to reclaim Satoru at the end of the incident. Yuji was completely outclassed against Kenjaku and even Choso was unable to deal any significant damage. Not only did Kenjaku escape unscathed with the Prison Realm , but successfully began preparations for the Culling Game as well. The combination of Kenjaku's ambition, manipulative tactics, and overall talent in jujutsu allowed him to establish a convoluted competition like the Culling Game. He used a complex blend of several sorcery techniques to create the Culling Game. So complex in fact, that Tengen had to hold an in-depth conversation with their allies to explain exactly how the Culling Game operates. Kenjaku invited a thousand players over the course of millennia, set up numerous colonies using Tengens pure barriers as a foundation, and established the rules of the game using a series of intricate binding vows . Some of the vows Kenjaku took upon himself include not being a game master and to end what was permanent. Kenjaku's plan was so well thought out that his enemies, the Jujutsu High sorcerers, had no choice but to participate. Kenjaku displayed the full range of his abilities when he bested Yuki Tsukumo, a special grade sorcerer, Choso, a special grade Death Painting Womb, and Tengen, all by himself. His barrier prowess enabled him to invade the Tombs of the Star without trouble, something Tengen had no doubts hed be able to accomplish. One-on-one, Kenjaku had Choso completely overmatched and his opponent was unable to land a single hit. Initially, Kenjaku easily overpowered Choso using only low-level cursed spirits reinforced with his cursed energy. Even when Choso managed to surprise his creator, he failed to land an attack because Kenjaku possessed another cursed technique. Kenjaku wanted to win without revealing this technique but his arsenal of sorcery abilities are what ultimately pushed him to victory. Yuki proved a far greater challenge than Choso, capable of overcoming any cursed spirit Kenjaku threw at her. He was forced to use everything in his arsenal to defeat Yuki, displaying his most advanced feats of jujutsu to date. As a master of barriers, Kenjaku possesses the divine skill to expand his domain without enclosing the outer shell. Only he and Sukuna are capable of doing so, not even Satoru Gojo can expand his domain without closing the barrier. The strength of Kenjakus barrier ripped Yukis simple domain to shreds and his domains cant-miss attack dealt massive damage. Even with his domain dispelled and his cursed techniques burnt out, Kenjaku held his own against Yuki and Choso at the same time. When backed into a corner, he used clever, unpredictable, spur-of-the-moment actions to survive. . Unlikely to brute force his way past Yuki, Kenjaku won by outsmarting her. He let her believe victory was at hand so shed be caught off guard by the clever ways he used his techniques. Kenjaku even survived Yukis last-ditch effort, a black hole, by yet again using a complex blend of jujutsu mechanics. Kenjakus victory over Yuki and Choso made their allies, other powerful sorcerers, recognize that he could not be defeated with conventional means. While Kenjaku openly recognizes that he is no match for Satoru Gojo, he confidently takes on any other opponent in his path. With Suguru Geto's body, he wields an army of cursed spirits capable of single-handedly conquering a nation. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Kenjaku possesses masterful skills in close combat that can stand up to nearly any opponent. Like Suguru Geto, Kenjaku is a highly capable close-range combatant despite being a curse manipulator. He mainly uses taijutsu to supplement his sorcery, but Kenjaku is fully capable of relying on hand-to-hand combat if need be. Kenjaku effortlessly caught Kasumi Miwa 's katana while unarmed and snapped the blade with a simple clench of his fist. Moments later he held off Choso's assault in Shibuya with contemptible ease. Kenjaku casually parried every strike Choso threw at him while easily landing his own hits. In the Tombs of the Star, Kenjaku once again made taking out Choso look easy by using close combat in combination with Cursed Spirit Manipulation. Yuki Tsukumo, who specializes in close combat, proved more of a challenge. However, Kenjaku held off both Yuki and Choso at the same time on his own. Kenjaku's cursed techniques were burnt out and he was forced to rely solely on taijutsu to survive. While he couldn't get off any attacks due to the sheer volume of offense coming at him, Kenjaku effectively defended himself until his techniques were replenished while only suffering moderate damage. Immense Tactical Intellect : As previously stated, Kenjaku is a thousand-year-old individual with a vast amount of knowledge acquired over hundreds of years of existence. This includes general expertise, a comprehensive understanding of sorcery, and strategic intellect. He is extraordinarily clever and a masterfully calculating criminal mastermind. This is due to his wealth of knowledge on jujutsu sorcery and his talent for manipulation and tactical forecasting. Kenjaku's intellect, along with his focus and patience are what makes him most cunning. He was willing to wait hundreds of years to create the proper conditions to accomplish his goals. His careful consideration and planning are what allowed Kenjaku's schemes to overcome the Six Eyes after losing to it multiple times in the past. Kenjaku analyzed Satoru Gojo to come up with a proper strategy to get the nigh-unbeatable sorcerer out of his way. He saw that Satoru was strongest when fighting alone and as a countermeasure, Kenjaku orchestrated the Shibuya Incident to put him in unfavorable conditions. While Satoru was stifled by non-sorcerers and forced to combat several special grade cursed spirits at the same time, Kenjaku waited for just the right moment to seal him. Kenjaku also had the foresight to make sure nobody from Jujutsu High saw him as Suguru Geto, as this would've ruined the surprise that was key to distracting and sealing Satoru Gojo. With his primary obstacle removed, Kenjaku immediately moved on to his next well-thought-out and extremely convoluted scheme. The Culling Game was created as a means for Kenjaku to achieve his primary goal of merging the Japanese population with Tengen. He launched the Culling Game directly after the Shibuya Incident, having fully prepared for it beforehand. Throughout numerous generations, Kenjaku recruited sorcerers from different time periods to participate. He is the only sorcerer who knows how to transform someone into a cursed object after death, a major testament to his unmatched knowledge of jujutsu sorcery. Kenjaku even accounted for the return of Satoru Gojo and avoided a surely fatal encounter with him by allying with Sukuna. Kenjaku's aforementioned mastery of sorcery is appropriately applied to battle. He is a cerebral fighter who can accurately analyze his opponent's abilities and use his own to overcome them in clever and complex ways. Yuki Tsukumo is one of the few sorcerers that Kenjaku encountered whom he didn't have any prior information. He was well aware of Choso's weaknesses and took advantage of them to easily overpower the Death Painting Womb, but this didn't apply to Yuki. Kenjaku analyzed Yuki throughout their battle and had to take numerous risks to overcome her. He began their battle by trying to keep her at a distance to observe her skills, a solid strategy that ended up backfiring. Even though he lost the exchange, Kenjaku recognized that his opponent still found his abilities troublesome. Immediately after seeing Yuki's hesitation to open a domain, Kenjaku expanded his own domain and ended up dealing massive damage. Kenjaku displayed a talent for thinking on his feet when Choso joined Yuki's side and ambushed him. Although Choso's ambush surprised Kenjaku, he quickly adapted and avoided a fatal blow. Kenjaku ultimately defeated Yuki with deception, a sorcerer's greatest weapon. He had her believe that he was using cursed spirit manipulation to buy time for a gravity attack. This lured Yuki into range, where Kenjaku surprised her with a miniature Maximum: Uzumaki and dealt the finishing blow. Kenjaku came up with clever countermeasures for even his worst matchup. Fumihiko Takaba , whose abilities defy all logic and reasoning. Kenjaku quickly recognized that his techniques were useless against Takaba and he would have to keep his guard up or else his thousand years of jujutsu knowledge would go to waste. Despite his disadvantage, Kenjaku persisted because he was confident every technique has a weakness. He eventually figured out Takaba needed certainty to activate his technique, so Kenjaku responded by targeting his confidence as a comedian. Kenjaku willingly stooped to Takaba's level of foolish antics to regain the advantage in their fight. When Takaba regained his confidence and reactivated his technique, Kenjaku understood Takaba well enough to realize the only way to win would be to satisfy his desire for comedy. Rather than fight against Takaba, Kenjaku joined him as a comedy duo and helped manifest his greatest fantasy. This led to Kenjaku ultimately avoiding defeat against Takaba. Although he was caught off guard and executed by Yuta Okkotsu immediately after, Kenjaku naturally always had a contingency plan in place. He passed on his will, transferring authority to activate the Great Merger to Sukuna, as a failsafe. Innate Techniques Brain Transplant : Kenjaku's innate technique allows him to swap bodies with another person, even if they are dead, by transplanting his brain into the body of his target. After the transplant, this technique leaves a stitched scar running horizontally through the forehead, which he cannot heal as part of a binding vow . By undoing the stitches, Kenjaku can remove the top part of his head to reveal his original brain. Once inside a body, Kenjaku gains access to the host's cursed energy, all their innate techniques, and memories. Even the Six Eyes cannot recognize him as an imposter as he retains the host's cursed energy. Kenjaku can live more than a thousand years thanks to his cursed technique while inhabiting different bodies. As shown with his usage of Kaori Itadoris technique while fighting Choso and Yuki, it's hinted that even when switching to a new body, Kenjaku retains access and usage of his former hosts innate techniques. However, even if Kenjaku could collect different cursed techniques from his previous hosts, there's a limit to how much his brain can store before overloading. (Unnamed) 400 years ago, Kenjaku transplanted his brain with his innate technique into an unknown person's body. He used this vessel to make binding vows with past sorcerers, particularly with Hajime Kashimo . Noritoshi Kamo , Kamo Noritoshi ? ) : At some point in the past, Kenjaku transplanted his brain with his innate technique into Noritoshi's body. As Noritoshi Kamo, Kenjaku experimented with the fusion of human flesh and curses, resulting in the Death Paintings . Kaori Itadori , Itadori Kaori ? ) : At some point in the past, Kenjaku transplanted his brain with his innate technique into the body of Jin Itadori 's partner, Kaori. Posing as her, Kenjaku used her body to mate and give birth to her son, Yuji , to serve as Sukuna's vessel in the Culling Game. It remains unclear how long he inhabited her body. Suguru Geto , Get Suguru ? ) : After Suguru Geto's death at the hands of Satoru Gojo , Kenjaku transplanted his brain with his innate technique into Suguru's body and has taken Geto as his host body, effectively giving Kenjaku access to all of Geto's memories, skills, and jujutsu. Cursed Spirit Manipulation , Jurei Sjutsu ? ) : A technique where the user can summon and control naturally formed cursed spirits for a desired purpose. Due to gaining Geto's body, Kenjaku can utilize this technique as if it is his own innate technique. Thanks to this technique, Kenjaku was shown to have acquired numerous cursed spirits as his personal familiars. He has deployed them to fight off multiple opponents and bombard them with a variety of different cursed techniques that each curse possesses. One of the cursed spirits he acquired was the Smallpox Deity , which was a powerful special grade cursed spirit capable of casting its own Domain Expansion . As shown during its battle against Mei Mei , it was powerful enough to nearly corner the grade 1 sorcerer if not for her brother 's assistance to distract it and give her a chance to finish it off. Later, he absorbs Mahito after he is weakened by Yuji Itadori . Maximum: Uzumaki , GokunobanUzumaki ? ) : The maximum technique of Curse Spirit Manipulation combines a massive number of collected curses into one powerful attack. Uzumaki extracts a curse's innate technique when used with cursed spirits of semi-grade 1 or higher, allowing the user to keep the techniques for one-time uses. Kenjaku first used this technique against Kasumi Miwa using Mahito , allowing him to extract Idle Transfiguration . Antigravity System , Anchigurabiti Shisutemu ? ) : A cursed technique that negates gravity when used. Kenjaku primarily uses a cursed technique reversal of this ability, allowing him to intensify the gravitational pull around him. This technique originally belonged to Kaori Itadori . Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Kenjaku is capable of using reverse cursed technique to heal his body. He is also able to use positive energy to fuel a cursed technique reversal. Domain Expansion Womb Profusion , Taiz Hen'ya ? ) : Kenjaku's domain expansion takes the form of a giant pillar made up of cursed spirits. It is an open barrier type domain, similar to Malevolent Shrine . The effect of this domain is unclear, though its guaranteed-hit severely injured Yuki Tsukumo , a special grade jujutsu sorcerer. Extracted Technique Idle Transfiguration , Mui Tenpen ? ) : After expelling Mahito via the Maximum: Uzumaki technique, Kenjaku gained his innate technique for a one-time use. Idle Transfiguration granted Kenjaku the ability to reshape other people's souls and potentially himself. He used it on Tengen's barrier to kickstart the Culling Game by remotely altering the souls of the people he marked over the years.

Overall Skill Level : Nanami is a model example of what a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer should be. Yuji and Takuma Ino both look up to Nanami for his demeanor when actively approaching a difficult situation as well as his incredible skill when it comes down to solving it. Satoru Gojo entrusted Nanami with looking after Yuji due to these traits as well and it paid off well for Yuji's growth. Ino, a powerful grade 2 sorcerer, approaches every tough decision with "what would Nanami do" in mind because he believes Nanami always handles things the right way. When it comes to combat ability, Nanami is capable of fighting on par with special grade cursed spirits such as Mahito . While Mahito was still in the infancy of his existence, Nanami was able to keep up in several of the exchanges. With a lack of information on Mahito's ability, Nanami suffered a direct blow to his soul but was still able to survive, something no one Mahito faced before had been able to do. Mahito himself considered Nanami to be exceptionally strong and a worthy opponent, far stronger than the average sorcerer. During the Shibuya Incident , Nanami showcased his leadership ability alongside great intellect and fighting strength. Upon learning about Satoru's sealing, Nanami was able to deduce what would be the best move for his team and helped carry out Mechamaru 's rescue plan without delay. Understanding that Kiyotaka Ijichi and the managers are crucial for communication in a large-scale mission, Nanami went alone to put protocols for the operation in place while also delegating the others on another task. Following finding Ijichi injured, Nanami was quickly able to track down the culprit, Haruta Shigemo , and beat the curse user senseless without so much as suffering a scratch. This performance in particular was stunning to Nobara Kugisaki , a very capable grade 3 student. Watching Nanami fight helped her understand that he's on a completely different level and that embodies what it means to be a true grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer. Alongside Naobito and Maki Zenin , Nanami was also able to fight the special grade curse Dagon . They were able to overpower him mostly thanks to Naobito's incredible speed backed up by Nanami's support. However, not even the two grade 1 sorcerers were able to exorcise him. Trapped inside Dagon's Domain , Nanami was unable to take any offensive position whatsoever. However, he miraculously survived Dagon's endless stream of Death Swarm shikigami for over a minute, something that surprised him the domain's caster. Once Megumi arrived and nullified Dagon's automatic hit with his own domain , Nanami focused on protecting Megumi and was easily able to dispatch any shikigami that tried to attack the student despite his injuries. Despite being heavily injured by Dagon and later burned by Jogo, Nanami massacred an entire swarm of transfigured humans attempting to kill him. Master Swordsman : Nanami mainly utilizes a blunt sword in battle and does so with incredible proficiency. Combined with his cursed technique , Nanami can cut through anything, including a blocking opponent that is using cursed energy to defend themselves. Nanami wields his blade with grace and balance, striking with extreme speed and precision with every swipe of his sword. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : In addition to being adept at armed combat, Nanami is an extremely capable unarmed fighter as well. His innate technique works with his fists as well as it does with his blunt sword. Nanami used this method to effortlessly overpower the curse user Haruta Shigemo. Each of Nanami's blows were incredibly devastating, a simple backhand was enough to send Shigemo flying across the room. There was never a point in the fight where Nanami was any danger fighting at close range, he delivered one bone-shattering blow after another and Shigemo would have died if not for his cursed technique. Enhanced Durability : Nanami is incredibly durable for a human even by sorcerer standards. As previously mentioned, he was able to survive being touched by Mahito's Idle Transfiguration and continued to fight, and eventually escaped with his life and body intact. When Shigemo fought Nanami he attempted to cut and kick him right after. However, Nanami was unscathed from the slash and didn't move as much as an inch from the curse user's kick. Shigemo compared hitting Nanami to a stone wall and said it felt like he wasn't even hitting a person. Additionally, Nanami was able to survive an endless swarm of man-eating fish shikigami for over a minute and was attacked by Jogo shortly after that. He was miraculously able to survive both and was even able to continue fighting, unlike Maki and Naobito who were completely incapacitated and near-death. Superior Precision & Technique : Nanami is an extremely technical fighter who plans on using his every move to exploit an opening in his opponent. His aim is always extremely precise, as he never misses his target's weak point when it's exposed by his cursed technique. Against stronger opponents, Nanami fights by breaking them down and creating constant weak points until they eventually fall. This same level of precision allows Nanami to evade his opponent's attacks with clever maneuvers. For example, by sticking his sword into a wall, Nanami was able to raise his legs high enough to avoid a ranged attack from Mahito. Great Tactical Intellect : Nanami's greatest assets in battle outside of his cursed technique are his astute fighting instincts and deductive reasoning skills. Both times he fought Mahito Nanami knew he was outmatched in terms of raw cursed energy, however, he survived both accounts and overwhelmed Mahito on several occasions thanks to quick thinking and masterful execution. When Nanami was assigned Mahito's case, he was able to effectively utilize his team to track down the proper clues that eventually lead them right to Mahito. He was also able to recognize that Mahito was purposely leading them into his hideout, and decided to go alone to prevent harm from coming to the others. During their first encounter, Nanami eventually realized his cursed technique could not win against Mahito's. As a countermeasure, Nanami used the environment around them to pin Mahito down. In their second fight, Nanami quickly realized that Yuji could land attacks that actually damaged Mahito. Instantly, Nanami came up with a strategy to overwhelm Mahito together that completely worked, and if not for Mahito's sudden evolution, would have killed the special grade cursed spirit. At the mercy of Mahito's Domain Expansion , Nanami was able to instantly assess his situation and what it meant for Mahito's advantage. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Nanami has remarkable control over his cursed energy, shown by his ability to assign a binding vow to himself and limit its usage for a given amount of time. Against Mahito's Idle Transfiguration , Nanami subconsciously guarded his soul with cursed energy to survive the initial impact from his opponent's innate technique. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : By reinforcing his body, Nanami rendered himself impervious to a kick and a slash from Shigemo's sword. Using his technique and cursed energy to enhance his strength, Nanami delivered three punches to Shigemo, each blow being powerful enough to send him hurtling and kill him outright, with the curse user only surviving due to his cursed technique . Black Flash , Kokusen ? ) : A phenomenon that creates a spatial distortion when a user connects an impact of cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, causing cursed energy to flash black, creating a more potent attack to the power of 2.5 of a normal hit. Before Yuji fought Hanami , Nanami was the record holder for the most consecutive uses of Black Flash with four times in a row. He claims he got lucky. Binding Vows Overtime , Jikangaird ? ) : Nanami's signature binding vow with himself. Nanami limits the amount of cursed energy he can utilize during the time he's officially on the clock working for Jujutsu High. Once he goes beyond his normal shift and overtime hours begin, Nanami's cursed energy swells to a great degree and grants him a boost in fighting power. While working his normal hours, Nanami suppresses his cursed energy to about 80-90%. By invoking Overtime, Nanami exerts 110-120% of his maximum power. Nanami can actively break the vow and use 100% of his cursed energy at any given time, but using Overtime in that case would only result in a 1% increase. Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how his cursed technique works, Nanami can make his technique more effective. Innate Technique Ratio Technique , Tkaku Juh ? ) : Divides target with ten lines and forcibly create a weak spot at the ratio point of seven to three. The target's lines don't have to match their length or wingspan. Nanami can choose which part to divide, including the target's head, torso, arms, and legs. This technique is also applicable to non-living objects. Collapse , Garagara ? ) : An extension technique that creates a weak point in the surrounding environment, allowing Nanami to destroy it with a single blow. Nanami first used this technique after unleashing both his binding vows to destroy the underground tunnel and trap Mahito.

Overall Skill Level : Hakari is widely recognized as one of the most powerful students at Tokyo Jujutsu High. Gojo, the undisputed strongest sorcerer of the modern day, believed that Hakari and Yuta Okkotsu had the potential to rival him. Before Yuji ever met Hakari, he heard from his senpai that Hakari's abilities were exceptional. Yuta himself said that Hakari was the stronger of the two of them when he's worked up. Hakari is not only an elite close-quarters combatant who possesses serrated cursed energy but also an extraordinary jujutsu specialist armed with a dynamic domain . He distinguished himself in the Culling Game by defeating Kashimo, not only one of the strongest players in the death game, but one of the most powerful sorcerers Kenjaku ever encountered in 1,000 years. Hakari's domain is unique and his luck is reliable, making for a combination capable of opposing any threat. Charles could see briefly into Hakari's future , but was instantly bested as soon as Kinji hit the jackpot of his domain. Kashimo nearly killed Hakari on several exchanges but he was able to repeatedly open his domain and successfully hit the jackpot to enter his unkillable mode. Hakari's strategic thinking and expert battle sense ultimately complemented his techniques and led to victory over Kashimo. Hakari was chosen to fight Sukuna's closest ally, Uraume, during the raid in Makyo Shinjuku. The Jujutsu High sorcerers planned extensively for the raid and everyone was confident enough to leave the ancient ice sorcerer to Kinji. Uraume was a powerful ancient sorcerer who was forced to go all out after realizing Kinji wasn't afraid of embracing his sorcery at the cost of his humanity. Kinji never slowed down his attacks despite having his limbs frozen and destroyed. He never hesitated to counterattack and surprise his opponent with instantly regrown limbs. While Kinji was fighting Uraume in his unkillable mode, his regeneration exceeded the speed Gojo and Sukuna displayed during their showdown. While Hakari wasn't able to overcome Uraume before the raid ended, they fought an extensive, high-level jujutsu battle, and Hakari survived in the end. Master Hand-to-Hand-Combatant : Hakari is an exceptionally capable hand-to-hand combatant, able to apply life-threatening pressure to Yuji, a very proficient taijutsu specialist. Yuji stopped resisting in order to win Hakari's approval and ended up suffering several blows that dealt serious damage to the first year. While his fighting style is very direct, Hakari isn't just a brawler. He's a skillful martial artist with a wide range of physical attacks in his arsenal. He uses combinations of punches, kicks, knees, and elbows among other grappling moves and strikes to take out his opponent with maximum force. Hakari's pure hand-to-hand combat skills were enough to put pressure on Charles even while the latter could see into his future. He was so confident in his abilities that Hakari began their fight with his hands in his pockets while only defending himself with kicks. Charles acknowledged that not for his cursed technique, Hakari would've defeated him right away with physical prowess alone. The full extent of Hakari's close combat prowess was on display against Kashimo, an incarnated sorcerer who slayed forty Culling Game players. While Hakari's base state can't challenge Kashimo's mastery of martial arts , his close combat abilities shine the most when he's amped up by his domain's jackpot. Fueled with limitless cursed energy, Hakari supercharged his physical attacks and overpowered Kashimo in several exchanges. Up against cursed spirits , Kinji effortlessly tore a swarm of them apart with his bare hands. High Tactical Intellect : Hakari doesn't present himself as a fighter with a plan because he's fearless and straightforward. That being said, Hakari is an experienced sorcerer with a high strategic battle sense and a knack for reading his opponents. Upon learning about Charles' ability to see the future, Hakari immediately attacked to confirm how it works and then quickly came up with the countermeasure. He knew Charles needed to see his target to use this ability and decided to attack Charles's blind spots with relentless pressure. Hakari also predicted that Charles would counter by attacking his own blind spots and acted accordingly by parrying his attempts. Even inside his domain, Hakari knew Charles still had a slight advantage and kept the pressure on to prevent him from focusing on the future. While he is a relatively cerebral fighter, Hakari tends to recklessly abandon tactics when he's in his unkillable mode. He allowed himself to be hit by Kashimo during a surge of cursed energy because the assault barely hurt his reinforced body. Despite the lack of caution, Hakari's recklessness does often work in his favor. Immediately after his arm was dismembered by Kashimo's lightning, Kinji continued his own offense because he knew the unkillable mode would regenerate his arm. This took Kashimo off guard and allowed Hakari to retake the momentum of their duel. Hakari's unkillable mode is rooted in a fully automatic reverse cursed technique but he doesn't overly rely on the involuntary healing factor and knows how to best make use of it. When Kashimo attempted to destroy his head in one shot, Hakari voluntarily ejected his opponent's cursed energy while allowing his reverse cursed technique to heal him while he breaks. After being hit by Kashimo's electric discharge twice, Hakari figured out there must be a trick to the attack and assumed his opponent couldn't launch it again. Acting on this assumption, Kinji decided to recklessly go full force on his offense and attempted to defeat Kashimo within the eight seconds before his unkillable state ceased. This backfired because Kashimo developed a loophole for his attack that Hakari was unaware of, nearly costing the latter his life. However, on the verge of death, Hakari was able to remain focused and did the only thing he could in order to survive, using all of his strength to bank on expanding his domain, a gamble that ultimately paid off. As Hakari's fight with Kashimo began to draw out, he switched his approach from a straight-on brawl to a more tactical one. He shifted his domain over the ocean before the barrier dispelled and dropped Kashimo into it, correctly assuming that the water would forcibly draw out his electrified cursed energy. While fighting in the ocean, Hakari carefully considered his options of either returning to the surface or using his last five seconds of immortality to finish the fight. Kinji recklessly decided to try to finish Kashimo off, only to end up on the receiving end of a steam explosion. He survived thanks to quick and clever thinking, using a last-second binding vow to sacrifice his left arm so the rest of him would be unharmed. Hakari knew Kashimo grabbed onto his arm before initiating the explosion in case he survived, which would've made Hakari unable to make the hand signs to cast his domain again. With this information, Hakari wisely decided to sacrifice his arm entirely and used the cursed energy reinforcing it to protect the rest of his body. As displayed at the end of their battle, Hakari's cleverness and forward thinking are what allowed him to best Kashimo in the end. Immense Luck : While Hakari is an extremely gifted sorcerer, more so than any of his skills, he's extraordinarily lucky. He's as fortunate as he is talented and can comfortably rely on this to win fights. Hakari's domain is based on drawing a jackpot with only a 1/239 chance of doing so, yet he claims to have never needed to spin more than 30 times. It only took him two spins to hit the jackpot against Charles and he hit it twice in a row on the first try against Kashimo. The second time, Hakari was mere moments from death and needed an immediate jackpot in order to heal himself. His good fortune pulled through and even Kashimo was forced to admit that Hakari truly has incredible luck. Cursed Energy Trait : Hakari's cursed energy apparently has a much rougher texture to it than others. He was told by Gojo that his cursed energy has an "edge", giving his blunt attacks a sharp cutting effect. Regardless of how much or how little force Hakari puts behind a blow, his opponent will be struck with a sharp pain regardless. Yuji compares it to being hit with a serrated bat and Charles likened it to sandpaper. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Hakari is very adept at reinforcing his physical attacks with cursed energy, allowing him to deliver devastating blows. While being filled with unlimited cursed energy, a single cursed energy-reinforced strike from Hakari could leave dents in large shipping containers and send them flying, either by punching his opponents into them or hitting them himself. Additionally, Hakari is also proficient in using cursed energy defensively to reinforce his physical durability. When confronted with a steam explosion, Hakari made a spur-of-the-moment binding vow that shifted the cursed energy protecting his left arm to the rest of his body, sacrificing the arm but bolstering the rest of his body to survive the explosion. Innate Technique Private Pure Love Train : A pachinko-themed technique that is primarily applied through domain expansion. The cursed technique imbued into the domain manifests Private Pure Love Train , a pachinko game inspired by the eponymously named romance manga series. However, Hakari can summon the visual effect indicators of the game such as the shutter doors outside of his domain. (Unnamed) Domain Expansion Idle Death Gamble , Zasatsu Bakuto ? ) : A pachinko-themed domain expansion that creates an environment resembling a train station that hosts a game of chance. Hakari's primary goal is to line up three of the same numbers to hit a jackpot with only a 1/239 chance of doing so. Unkillable Mode : Hitting the jackpot of Idle Death Gamble grants Hakari a bonus of unlimited cursed energy for four minutes and eleven seconds, the exact duration of the Private Pure Love Train theme song, "Admiring You", which plays throughout the round. The limitless cursed energy causes Kinji's body to reflexively use Reverse Cursed Technique to automatically heal any injury, making him temporarily unkillable after hitting a jackpot.

Overall Skill : Kirara has studied at Jujutsu High for three years and possesses a high-level understanding of jujutsu and how to apply it. Their cursed technique is a complex one, but Kirara has mastered it and made themselves an asset to Hakari, one of Jujutsu High's strongest sorcerers. Kirara applied their technique appropriately to protect the headquarters of their fight club with great efficiency. No one including Panda was able to access the monitor room where Hakari was staying unless invited. In a two-on-one scuffle where they were fairly well prepared, Kirara was able to ultimately prevent Panda and Megumi from reaching the monitor room. Several objects on the roof were already pre-charged with cursed energy so Kirara could apply their technique and keep their opponents at bay. Megumi was able to deduce Kirara's cursed technique and eventually outwit them, but Kirara forced Megumi to make a gamble that could have just easily backfired and secured Kirara's victory. Kirara also managed to incapacitate Panda and make him a non-factor in the battle. They also played a small role in the Raid on Sukuna in Makyo Shinjuku, aiding Ui Ui in recovering their injured allies. High Tactical Intellect : Kirara is a cerebral fighter with an intellect that can match Megumi's. When Megumi was beginning to figure out the rules of their cursed technique, Kirara quickly understood he was gathering enough information to figure it out. He used Rabbit Escape to see where the cursed technique was affecting, and Kirara recognized that he was risking attracting all the rabbits back to him and suffocating. Megumi guessed the technique was based on the Southern Cross and Kirara accidentally confirmed it for him with the look on their face. Kirara thought Megumi knew for sure but his change in the expression made Kirara realize that he didn't actually know before seeing their reaction. Once Megumi was able to get the gist of the technique, Kirara wisely decided to immediately go on the offensive to keep them at bay. They used clever ways to attract objects to Panda and Megumi, even managing to immobilize Panda with a car. Megumi believed that Kirara wouldn't be able to hit him with objects because they had already marked their cursed energy with Love Rendezvous . However, Kirara surprised him by removing the mark from themselves so they could mark an object with one that matches Megumi's, attracting several objects to him. Kirara admitted they were impressed Megumi figured out the conditions of Love Rendezvous, but they pointed out to him that he was too quick to believe more projectiles couldn't be sent at him. Innate Technique Love Rendezvous , Rabu Randeb ? ) : Apportions five "stars" with a motif of the Southern Cross constellation in order to target and mark cursed energy. For someone marked with one star to approach another star, they must follow a determined order or be unable to close the distance. Targets of the same star will attract each other. The order follows the stars from nearest to furthest distance to the Earth: Imai, Acrux, Mimosa, Ginan, and Gacrux.

Overall Skill Level : Ijichi attended Tokyo Jujutsu High with the intention of becoming a full-fledged jujutsu sorcerer, like Gojo and Shoko, though the former discouraged him from pursuing that path, with Ijichi becoming an assistant manager instead. While he does not possess an innate technique , Ijichi can conjure shikigami and cast barriers . He is highly knowledgeable on jujutsu , which helps make him an asset on any mission, especially with students. Often tasked with overseeing the assignments of young jujutsu sorcerers, Ijichi specializes in guiding sorcerers on their assignments, while also using curtains to maintain secrecy. Ijichi is also fully capable of overseeing and directing multiple teams of sorcerers and assistant managers as if needed as well. During the Shibuya Incident when communications were down, Ijichi recognized that the managers were crucial and made it a priority to use them to communicate with sorcerers inside the city. Managers like Ijichi were targeted during the incident by Haruta Shigemo for this very reason, proving how much of a major asset Ijichi is, despite his low combat ability. While as a student, Ijichi went on some missions and received minimal combat skills. He can exorcise a grade 3 cursed spirit if he was forced to fight. Barrier Techniques Simple Barrier : Barriers are used to conceal, contain, or deny entry to others within that space. Ijichi is a skilled barrier user who used talismans to conceal Gojo's Hollow Technique: Purple against Sukuna. Curtain , Tobari ? ) : Ijichi can create a curtain, a dome-shaped barrier conceals the environment within it from the outside and turns the sky inside it into night, luring out cursed spirits . Shikigami Shikigami , Shikigami ? ) : As an assistant manager, Ijichi is capable of summoning shikigami to support other sorcerers.

Overall Skill Level : Evidenced by his ability to communicate, Ko-Guy is at least a grade 2 cursed spirit with high combat abilities that surpass some semi-grade 1 curses. He is more intelligent than most curses, but the grasshopper curse isn't very smart compared to a typical jujutsu sorcerer. In Shibuya , he was given two simple tasks: guarding the commissioned curtain and killing non-sorcerers. Despite having natural physical prowess superior to a normal human, Yuji was far superior in physical skill and easily defeated the curse. Mahito mentioned that it must have taken a strong jujutsu sorcerer to defeat him. Cursed Spirit Physiology Grasshopper Physiology : As a grasshopper curse, Ko-Guy claims to have arms, jaws, and eyes all far superior to humans. All the abilities of normal grasshoppers can be adapted for combat as well. He can shoot black mucus from his mouth, and expand his abdomen to stab his opponents. Enhanced Jumping and Biting Power : Ko-Guy can use his strong legs and powerful jaw to rapidly move across a contained area and bite everything in sight. His jaws are capable of gnawing clean through a metal sign. Black Mucus : During a grasshopper plague disaster, the black mucus excreted by the grasshoppers covered all the land the swarm went over. Ko-Guy can spit out the same mucus from his mouth as a projectile. Expandable Abdomen : A grasshopper's abdomens expand and contract so they can lay eggs deep in the ground. The tip is hard and can expand up to three times his normal length. Ko-Guy can extend his abdomen quickly as a surprise attack to stab an opponent. He attempted to use this in a sneak attack against Yuji but failed.

Overall Skill Level : Kokichi Muta was a semi-grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer while he was still a second-year student at Jujutsu High. He could control several puppets at once remotely from a great distance, with each puppet possessing high combat abilities worthy enough to earn him his rank. In order to defeat Mahito, Kokichi was prepared to unleash his entire life's worth of reserves of cursed energy to win. Kenjaku acknowledged that Kokichis skill and strategies were exceptional in this battle. It was nearly enough to exorcise the special grade curse, but he was ultimately defeated because Mahito was able to lure him into a false sense of security after believing he had achieved his objective. Great Tactical Intellect : Kokichi was a highly tactical thinker and fighter who tried to always stay a step ahead of his opponent. While in combat with Panda, Kokichi ascertained Panda's strengths and weaknesses as well as his own at every stage of the fight. Kenjaku also praised Kokichi for having decent tactical prowess while fighting Mahito. Kokichi was well prepared for their fight and his tactics nearly succeeded in wearing Mahito out and damaging his body while neutralizing his technique. Cursed Energy Output : To supplement his Puppet Manipulation technique's vast range, Kokichi can exceed the limits of his cursed energy output, allowing him to control his puppets from afar. While piloting Mechamaru Mode: Absolute , Kokichi was prepared to use all seventeen years, five months, and six days of cursed energy he collected over his entire lifespan, releasing cursed energy comparable to a special grade 's even if only momentarily. Heavenly Restriction Kokichi was born without a right arm and both of his legs were useless. He had no feeling below his waist, his skin was so sensitive it couldn't be touched by natural light and the pores on his body always felt like they were being stabbed with needles. In exchange, he could use his cursed technique over a vast range and output more cursed energy beyond his limits. Binding Vows Kokichi Muta had a binding vow with Mahito's group, promising to give them information as a mole in exchange for a healthy body. One of the conditions Kokichi had was for Mahito's group to not hurt anyone from Kyoto Jujutsu High. Innate Technique Puppet Manipulation , Kairai Sjutsu ? ) : Kokichi's technique allowed him to remotely control cursed corpse puppets over a wide range, encompassing the entirety of Japan due to his Heavenly Restriction. Puppets such as Mechamaru are capable of discharging cursed energy as heat rays among a bevy of other abilities. Cursed Corpses Ultimate Mechamaru , Arutimetto Mekamaru ? ) : A humanoid, mechanical cursed corpse that Kokichi originally used as his proxy to attend school and missions. Sword Option , Sdo Opushon ? ) : Multiple blades protrude from Mechamaru's forearm, along with its nails extending. Mechamaru is also capable of increasing the size of its forearm and having spikes protrude out of it. Ultra Spin , Urutora Supin ? ) : Mechamaru spins its hand and forearm, and swings its right arm at the target. This technique is capable of easily piercing through a tree trunk. Ultra Shield , Urutora Shrudo ? ) : Mechamaru puts up its guard, with its forearm in front of it, to block incoming attacks. Boost On , Bsuto On ? ) : Mechamaru releases cursed energy from its elbows to increase the speed of its attack. Ultra Cannon , Urutora Kyanon ? ) : Mechamaru fires a blast of cursed energy from the palm of its hand. Mode: Albatross , Mdo Arubatorosu ? ) : Mechamaru protrudes a cannon from its mouth. Ultimate Cannon , Arutimetto Kyanon ? ) : With the additional cannon in its mouth from Mode: Albatross, Mechamaru combines its firepower with its palms' and fires a large blast of cursed energy. Ultimate Mechamaru - Mode: Absolute , Arutimetto Mekamaru Mdo Abusoryto ? ) : A large mechanical puppet that Kokichi is capable of piloting from the cockpit in the puppet's head. It is capable of large scale attacks by using up cursed energy that was saved beforehand. Ultra Cannon , Urutora Kyanon ? ) : Kokichi fires a blast of cursed energy from the palm of the puppet's hand. This technique consumes one year's worth of cursed energy that Kokichi has saved up. Miracle Cannon , Mirakuru Kyanon ? ) : Kokichi fires a blast of cursed energy from both of his puppet's hands. This technique consumes two years' worth of cursed energy that Kokichi has saved up. Pigeon Viola , Pijon ~Viora~ ? ) : Kokichi creates 5 orbs made of cursed energy and blasts from them when released. The blasts follow the target until they come in contact with something. This technique consumes five years' worth of cursed energy that Kokichi has saved up. Mini-Mechamaru , Mini Mekamaru ? ) : During the Shibuya Incident , Kokichi had three small communication puppets prepared to guide his sorcerer comrades. These devices were running on the remains of Kokichi's cursed energy after his death. Once the energy ran out, they deactivated. Anti-Domain Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : Kokichi invented four tubes that contain the Simple Domain cursed technique. It was the only way he could perform the technique. The tubes are entered into a panel inside Mode: Absolute's cockpit, which announces Technique Charge , Jutsushiki Sten ? ) once the technique is loaded. From there, Kokichi can shift Mechamaru's fingers into spikes or shooting barrels that can inject Simple Domain's effect into his desired target. It can also be used to protect the cockpit from an enemy's Domain Expansion .
Overall Skills: Kokun is a curse user with unknown capabilities. He was no match for Suguru Geto , who defeated him in seconds with a cursed spirit.

Overall Skill Level : As a grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer, Usami is a capable fighter befitting his rank. He was able to effortlessly defeat Masaki Takeda , a curse user whom Tsurugi believed to be of the same grade as Usami, although Masaki had already been weakened after fighting Tsurugi, Yuka Okkotsu , and Marulu Val Vol Yelvori . Skilled Diplomat : Usami is an experienced diplomat who efficiently manages responsibilities that were historically handled by the Big Three Families, particularly the Kamo Clan . As the Acting Minister for Foreign Affairs, he successfully fostered and established peaceful diplomatic relations with the Simurians aimed at achieving coexistence, a remarkable accomplishment given the widespread hostility between many Japanese sorcerers and Simurians at the time. Enhanced Speed : Usami possesses above-average speed. After paralyzing Masaki with Cursed Speech , he swiftly knocked the curse user unconscious with a punch to the jaw followed by a kick to the face before Masaki could even finish reacting to the revelation of Usami's cursed technique. High Endurance : Despite suffering severe backlash from using Cursed Speech on Dabura Karaba , Usami remained conscious long enough to plead for the lives of his subordinates. He only collapsed after ensuring the Simurians withdrew. Innate Technique Cursed Speech , Jugon ? ) : Usami's innate technique allows him to infuse his words with cursed energy , compelling others to obey to his verbal commands. To activate the technique, he covers his mouth with either hand, both of which bear the Snake Eyes and Fangs cursed seals on their backs. The backlash inflicted upon his body is proportional to both the strength of the command and the difference in power between himself and the target. While commanding Masaki to "don't move" produced no noticeable recoil, attempting to restrain Dabura proved far beyond Usami's capabilities. Dabura's continued movement after being affected by the technique greatly intensified the backlash, causing Usami to cough up blood profusely and suffer life-threatening injuries.

Overall Skill Level : Kurourushi was one of only sixteen registered special grade cursed spirits. Humanity shares a collective fear and disdain for cockroaches, which gave rise to the Kurourushi. It possessed the unique physiology of a humanoid-cockroach, as well as the ability to summon and manipulate endless cockroaches reinforced by its cursed energy. Additionally, Kurourushi could use cursed techniques and wield its signature cursed tool, the especially dangerous Festering Life Sword . At some point, Kurourushi was defeated by Kenjaku and it was absorbed into Cursed Spirit Manipulation. Kenjaku released Kurourushi so the cursed spirit could compete at an elite level in the Culling Game. Despite generally acting on the instinct of satisfying an endless appetite, Kurourushi is a relatively intelligent creature compared to most cursed spirits. While not to the degree of the unregistered special grades like Jogo , Mahito , Hanami or Dagon , Kurourushi can speak and communicate clearly. Kurourushi understood its own status within the Culling Game and collected fifty-two points before entering a deadlock with the most powerful players in the Sendai Colony. The cockroach curse was intelligent enough to understand that Dhruv Lakdawalla would've been an unfavorable matchup and decided to enter a dormant state. Kurourushi also prepared for the worst by creating an offspring that would inherit its cursed energy in the event of an exorcism. Dhruv's defeat caused Kurourushi to awaken in a state of starvation. Its bottomless hunger immediately lashed out and used swarms of cursed cockroaches to devour any humans in the vicinity. When Yuta Okkotsu stopped Kurourushi's swarm, its instincts led it to try and devour the special grade sorcerer. Kurourushi used its ability to manipulate large swarms of cockroaches well in tandem with wielding the Festering Life Sword. It could balance itself on a twister made of flying cockroaches and cast cursed techniques from a distance. Kurourushi used this tactic to distract Yuta with a swarm before impairing his vision with its Earthen Insect Trance technique from behind. This created the opening Kurourushi needed to make effective use of the Festering Life Sword. Kurourushi landed consecutive blows on Yuta and was poised to devour him, the prodigal sorcerer second only to Satoru Gojo. Kurourushi withstood Yuta's reinforced taijutsu and swordplay but its body was completely compromised by his reverse cursed technique . At the last moment before Kurourushi ate Yuta, the sorcerer bit the cockroach curse and delivered a mouth-to-mouth blast of positive energy. After the parent's exorcism, the cursed energy of fear throughout Japan was poured into the child. Even after Kurourushi the Culling Game player perished, the cursed spirit still thrived. Takako Uro , an exceptionally strong player, was at a disadvantage against Kurourushi and considered it a particularly nasty opponent. She was displeased when Kurourushi became active again after Dhruv fell and didn't break the stalemate in the Colony until the parent was exorcised. Kurourushi's reappearance was such a threat that Uro's focus left her unguarded against Yuta. Uro was vulnerable after she used domain expansion and Kurourushi severed her arm with the Festering Life Sword. However, Kurourushi could not withstand a direct hit from Ryu Ishigori 's Granite Blast and was ultimately exorcised by a consecutive blast of positive energy. Innate Technique Cursed Cockroaches : Kurourushi could produce and control countless swarms of real cockroaches reinforced by its cursed energy. These man-eating cockroaches could strip all the flesh off a group of humans in seconds. This feeds Kurourushi's endless appetite and stimulates parthenogenesis. A single cockroach is not a real threat but a full swarm can be a serious issue even to a jujutsu sorcerer. Parthenogenesis : Flesh devoured by the cursed cockroaches stimulated Kurourushi's parthenogenesis process, granting it the ability to produce more cockroaches. Additionally, Kurourushi used this to reproduce an identical yet entirely new cursed spirit offspring. In order to preserve Kurourushi's existence, the cursed energy from the parent was passed on to the child when it died. Earthen Insect Trance , Doch Zenj ? ) : A cursed technique that conjures flying insect curses that carry large sacs filled with a liquid substance that gets released when destroyed. The substance gets into the target's eyes to impair their vision.
Overall Skill Level : Kyoko has the qualifications to be an assistant manager , meaning that she has enough cursed energy to see curses and use simple barrier techniques and shikigami .

Overall Skill : Larue is a capable sorcerer, seeing that he was one of Geto's former commanders and was likely involved in the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons . He is durable enough to survive a Black Flash from Sukuna . Innate Technique Heart Catch , Hto Kyatchi ? ) : Larue's cursed technique creates a virtual hand that grabs his target from afar, allowing him to throw or crush them with it. If the hand is destroyed, Larue can restore it, though one tenth of the damage is transferred back to his body. Cutie Honey , Kythan ? ) is an ability that allows Larue to "grab" the attention of his target from afar. This forcibly diverts the target's line of sight and focus towards Larue, which creates a distraction that his allies can exploit. The target must have been grabbed by Heart Catch before. While affected, the target's pupils change into heart shapes.

Overall Skill Level : Mahito is an unregistered special grade cursed spirit that eclipses the power of at least three of Sukuna's fingers at the time of his first encounter with Yuji Itadori , and only continues to grow stronger. He is younger than Jogo and as a result, is less experienced and not as powerful at first. Despite this, Mahito is far above what a special grade cursed spirit would normally be and demonstrates rapid growth over the course of only two months. He has very high intelligence and an extremely dangerous cursed technique. Mahito has incredible development potential, as on multiple instances he has developed in the middle of battle. In a one on one fight, he was able to overwhelm the grade 1 sorcerer, Kento Nanami , by rendering his cursed technique useless. Following that fight, Nanami believed that Mahito had to be exorcised immediately or else he would grow into something too fearsome for Jujutsu High to handle. In Mahito's two on one battle with Nanami and Yuji, Mahito would have likely defeated both jujutsu sorcerers if it were not for Sukuna's intervention. During this fight, Mahito was able to grow stronger while his life was in danger, allowing him to conjure his own Domain Expansion . Later, during the Shibuya Incident , Mahito went further beyond his boundaries, being able to create clones of himself that were indistinguishable from the original, while also developing his soul-manipulating abilities. Even after splitting his cursed energy in order to create a double, the divided Mahito still demonstrated relativity to Yuji in combat. During his fight with Yuji and later, Aoi Todo , he managed to land a Black Flash on the two of them, allowing him to gain sufficient understanding of cursed energy and his own soul to activate Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing , further increasing his power. Enhanced Strength : Mahito has great physical strength. He mercilessly beat Yuji in their second fight, enough to make the latter cough up blood. Despite having divided strength after splitting his body to create a double, he delivered a blow to Yuji that was so powerful it made him bleed from the forehead. Mahito claimed that if he had put his back into it more, he could have split Yuji's skull. He could easily destroy numerous Mechamarus and was strong enough to pin down Nanami. When enhanced with Black Flash , Mahito's hits can be so powerful they made Aoi Todo cough up blood despite the latter focusing his cursed energy to protect the impacted area. Enhanced Speed : Mahito has immense speed. He was able to blitz past Nanami's guard in their fight by morphing his legs. He was able to outrun Yuji and attack Todo so fast the only thing he could do was to focus his cursed energy to protect himself. Enhanced Reflexes : Mahito has superb reflexes. When fighting with Yuji and Todo, he was able to react to their attacks and counter. Mahito even kept up with Todo's Boogie Woogie to an extent. He even single-handedly fought both Yuji and Nanami, all while dodging their attacks and countering extremely fast. Enhanced Durability : Mahito is exceptionally difficult to kill. Not only does his cursed technique render physical attacks meaningless, but even Mahito's soul is extremely resistant to damage. Nanami attempted to crush Mahito's body, but he went through their entire battle without expressing that he felt any pain even when attacks did land. When Yuji was able to hit Mahito's soul and both jujutsu sorcerers overwhelmed Mahito, he was able to weather the storm and unlocked a new power instead of allowing his body to crumble under the pressure. While using Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing in a weakened state, Mahito suffered zero damage from Yuji's reinforced punches. This prompted Yuji to believe that only a Black Flash imbued with his maximum cursed energy could take Mahito down. High Intellect : Mahito possesses very high intellectual prowess, especially for a cursed spirit. He was accurately able to deduce that jujutsu sorcerers were investigating him and was able to set a trap for his pursuers. Mahito can also surmise his opponent's skill level and even their cursed technique after just a few exchanges. He was able to accurately do so against Nanami and he was able to realize that Yuji had the ability to see souls thanks to his relationship with Sukuna. He developed countermeasures to Todo's Boogie Woogie far quicker than Hanami did. He is also very adept at using a variety of tricks to fool his opponents. Along with Kenjaku, Mahito often acts as the brains of his faction's operation. Cursed Energy Capacity : Mahito has a vast amount of cursed energy at his disposal. Nanami himself said that fighting Mahito until his cursed energy ran out was unrealistic. Mahito was capable of transfiguring over one thousand humans during the Shibuya Incident without exhausting his cursed energy and even after separating half of his remaining cursed energy into a clone, he still had enough cursed energy to engage in a prolonged fight with Yuji and Aoi Todo, heal multiple grievous wounds, and activate powerful extensions of his technique during their battle. Mahito only showed signs of exhaustion after using his Domain Expansion and being hit by another Black Flash from Yuji.
