He could easily defeat a very large cursed spirit with just a simple swipe, and during his fight against Gojo he was able to punch the roof of the school so hard it caused the building to rupture and crack. He easily overpowered the likes of a Finger Bearer, a special-grade curse. When gambling Yuji's life against Megumi, Sukuna managed to fling the sorcerer through several building floors without effort and he easily overpowered and destroyed Megumi's shikigami . He even punched Megumi so hard, the raindrops in that area dispersed. With 16 of his fingers, Sukuna punched Jogo through numerous skyscrapers with sufficient force to blow enormous holes through their sides and even destroyed the latter's jaw with a downward punch that opened a hole through at least six floors. His blows also had considerable effect on the likes of Mahoraga. Upon taking over Megumi's body, he was able to easily pierce through Yuji's gut and send him flying across the city with a single punch, temporarily incapacitating the sorcerer. Immense Speed : Sukuna has repeatedly displayed overwhelming levels of raw physical speed, capable of effortlessly surprising most opponents with the sheer quickness of his movements. With three fingers, Sukuna easily slammed a Finger Bearer to the ground and even cut off its arm without it noticing. He was also able to effortlessly blitz Megumi several times, delivering powerful blows with Megumi barely able to react at all. With 16 fingers, he completely overwhelmed Jogo and was able to easily keep up with Mahoraga in their fight. Sukuna was even able to instantly appear in the middle of Atsuya Kusakabe and Panda , both capable sorcerers, with the former being praised as the strongest grade 1 sorcerer by Satoru Gojo himself. In his fully incarnated form, he was able to outrun Yuji, who could run at speeds of 60.02 km/h (37.3 mph). Immense Reflexes : In accordance with his agility, Sukuna has incredible reflexes that allow him to easily counter most of his opponents' attacks. He was able to dodge Jogo's Maximum: Meteor seconds before its impact and emerge unscathed, and consistently dodged and countered Mahoraga's blows during their fight. It should also be noted that Sukunas motor skill is so polished that in his true form, he can independently control his four arms and two mouths with ease; even in the middle of a fight, two of his arms can make hand signs, and the mouth on his abdomen is capable of chanting empowered words continuously. Immense Durability : When in Yuji's body, Sukuna can use cursed energy to bolster his host's resilience, first shown when he effortlessly repelled an attack by a Finger Bearer just by holding his hand out to block it. Sukuna was punched through five buildings and shown to be completely fine, as well as managing to block a hit from the Sword of Extermination without much difficulty. Sukuna was even able to withstand a 200% Hollow Technique: Purple during his fight with Satoru Gojo despite defending himself at the last second, losing only his hands, and even then they were quickly regenerated with reverse cursed technique . Perhaps his biggest accomplishment in this regard is surviving an unlimited Hollow Purple by Gojo, which completely destroyed Mahoraga and decimated a large area of Shinjuku, albeit left with severe injuries and barely being able to stand. Great Tactical Intellect: Despite his outwardly brutish mannerisms and sadism, Sukuna is an extremely intelligent individual. He has fully grasped the nature of cursed techniques, curses and reverse cursed technique as a whole. Due to that, he is able to quickly deduce the inner workings of cursed techniques after only seeing them once or twice and can create suitable foils to such techniques. He did this against Mahoraga in their fight, and was able to defeat the shikigami after gaining an understanding of its ability. Sukuna was also able to realize the potential of Megumi's cursed technique just by seeing it once during their short battle and he was able to create a binding vow with Yuji in order to take Megumi's body, patiently waiting for the right moment before executing his plan. During his fight with Hana Kurusu , by using Megumi's memories, he was able to make Hana think that Megumi was in control of his body and thus when she hugged him he was able to critically injure her. When pushed into desperate situations, Sukuna has demonstrated the intellectual capacity to remain levelheaded and formulate strategies to counter his opponents. After Mahoraga was destroyed and he was severely injured by Hollow Purple, Sukuna made a binding vow that allowed him to bypass the world-cutting slash's conditions and unleash it, killing Gojo when the latter least expected it. Even when he lost two left hands and suffered seven consecutive Black Flashes from Yuji, which disrupted his connection with Megumi's soul and lowered his cursed energy output and physical control, Sukuna regained his ability to expand his domain without lowering its output or difficulty by improvising several binding vows that included uncertain conditions, instantly turning the tides of the battle by removing all the sorcerers except Yuji from the battlefield. Cursed Energy Capacity : True to his title as the King of Curses, Sukuna possesses vast levels of cursed energy, likely the most transcendent throughout history, far surpassing special grade cursed spirits and sorcerers alike. Yuta Okkotsu , a special grade sorcerer who possesses even more cursed energy than Satoru Gojo , states that Sukuna has double the amount of cursed energy that he has or more. Coupled with his extraordinarily efficient usage of cursed energy, Sukuna was able to continuously use his techniques throughout his battles without exhausting himself in the slightest. Even after expanding his domain three times throughout his fight with Gojo, Sukuna's cursed energy reserves were merely lowered to the same level as Yuta's, which was still enough for him to cast domain expansion two more times and possibly countless more. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Sukuna has incredible control over his cursed energy, being extremely proficient in using cursed techniques that require sophisticated manipulation of cursed energy such as domain expansion and reverse cursed technique, and capable of performing both flawlessly and repeatedly without issue. Hajime Kashimo , one of the strongest sorcerers from 400 years ago, was astonished by Sukuna's mastery over his cursed energy, displayed by his ability to seamlessly shift between Domain Amplification to his innate technique, to where he stated that if not for the Six Eyes , even Satoru Gojo would be no match against Sukuna in utilizing cursed energy. Sukuna's expertise in controlling cursed energy even allows him to survive after his heart was stabbed through, doing so by using cursed energy to keep his heart beating. Cursed Energy Output : In addition to his immeasurable amounts of cursed energy, Sukuna can output high amounts of cursed energy into his cursed techniques, vastly increasing their effectiveness. When using his Dismantle and Cleave techniques, the slashes can easily slice skyscrapers in half and instantly kill sorcerers by dicing their bodies into pieces. In contrast, Yuta's Cleave was only able to inflict minor cuts on Sukuna's face while Yuji's slash barely cut off Sukuna's leg. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Augmenting his already immense physical prowess, Sukuna regularly uses cursed energy to enhance his strength and durability. Most of his aforementioned strength and durability feats can be attributed to his reinforcement technique. By reinforcing his hands with cursed energy, Sukuna was able to tank a direct hit from a Hollow Technique: Purple at 200% output after it traveled about four kilometers, albeit taking enough damage to lose both hands. Black Flash , Kokusen ? ) : A phenomenon that occurs when the user applies cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, creating a spatial distortion that causes their cursed energy to flash black and amplifies the destructive power of the strike to the power of 2.5. Sukuna unleashed Black Flash against Maki Zenin during the jujutsu sorcerers' raid on him in Shinjuku , dealing a powerful strike that sent the girl gifted with Heavenly Restriction flying. Sukuna achieved Black Flash a total of seven times throughout the battle. Binding Vows Sukuna had a binding vow with Yuji. The King of Curses agreed to revive the boy after his apparent death under two conditions: Yuji would allow Sukuna to take over his body for one minute when the latter chants "Enchain" , Keikatsu ? ) and he would forget about the agreement. Yuji initially opposed the binding vow, making Sukuna promise that he wouldn't kill or hurt anyone during that minute. The boy still disagreed with the terms and instead had a battle against the King of Curses, where he'd allow the agreement to occur if he lost. Sukuna effortlessly defeated Yuji, forcing him into accepting the binding vow. When he originally learned it, Sukuna could launch a "slash that cuts the world" by only having to form the hand sign of Enma , Enmaten ? ) , the same two-handed sign needed to cast Malevolent Shrine . However, Sukuna was unable to fulfill this condition after losing a hand to Gojo's Hollow Purple. In order to bypass the conditions and launch the enhanced Dismantle, Sukuna imposed a binding vow on himself that required him to make the hand sign, chant Dismantle's incantation, and direct the slash's trajectory with his palm for all subsequent uses. By changing his domain expansion's hand sign and applying cursed techniques and barrier techniques through a part of his brain undamaged by Unlimited Void , then including improvised binding vows with imprecise elements, Sukuna was able to activate Malevolent Shrine without any decrease to its range, difficulty or output for 99 seconds. Sukuna can remove the time limit by shrinking the range of his domain down to the size of a sports ball. To mitigate Divine Flame's slow speed and narrow range, Sukuna entered into a binding vow that restricted him from using Divine Flame when outnumbered unless inside his domain. In return, Malevolent Shrine's cursed technique is expanded, imbuing all the pulverized substances within it with the same explosive cursed energy as Divine Flame, which he contains within the domain by altering the barrier 's specifications to restrict entry and exit for everything other than living creatures. This effectively turns the particles into thermobaric explosives that scatter throughout the domain, which are detonated when Divine Flame is unleashed, causing instantaneous high temperature, shock waves, decompression, and intense pressurization that kills all living things within the domain. Innate Techniques Shrine , Mizushi ? ) : Sukuna's cursed technique allows him to launch slashes at various ranges to cut through objects and space, as well as unleash destructive flames. Dismantle , Kai ? ) : An invisible, high-speed ranged slashing attack that can cut apart cursed spirits, sorcerers, and inanimate objects with great effectiveness. Using Mahoraga 's second adaptation to Limitless as a model, Sukuna can enhance Dismantle by extending its target area to the world itself, transforming them into " slashes that cut the world " , Sekai o Tatsu Zangeki ? ) . Cleave , Hachi ? ) : A slashing attack that adjusts itself depending on the target's toughness and cursed energy level to cut them down in one fell swoop. Unless used in his domain expansion, Sukuna must make physical contact with the target in order to activate Cleave. Spiderweb , Kumo no Ito ? ) : Sukuna can utilize the Cleave technique in the shape of a spider's web by touching the ground. As a variation of Cleave, Spiderweb adjusts itself to the surroundings' toughness, collapsing the ground in one fell swoop. Divine Flame , Kamino ? ) : Sukuna can create and manipulate fire for long-range attacks by chanting "Open" , Fga ? ) and forming an arrow. This technique can only be used after he performs Dismantle and Cleave. The firepower of these flames far exceed Jogo 's, a special grade curse whose defining trait involves extremely destructive pyrokinetic powers . Ten Shadows Technique , Tokusa no Kage Bjutsu ? ) : After incarnating through Megumi's body, Sukuna gained access to the prized inherited technique of the Zenin Clan, allowing him to summon ten different shikigami using his shadows as an intermediary. It also grants him overall manipulation of shadows, allowing him to hide in shadows or store objects within his own shadow. Divine Dogs , Gyokuken ? ) : Twin canine shikigami with powerful noses for tracking and lethal fangs and claws for devouring curses. By intentionally keeping the shikigami's form unstable, Sukuna can increase its effective range and prevent it from being completely destroyed. While this prevents the shikigami from acting independently and reduces its attack power, Sukuna can compensate for the latter with his immense cursed energy capacity and output. Divine Dog: Totality , GyokukenKon ? ) : An improved version of Divine Dog that combines both shikigami into a single stronger shikigami. Sukuna's Divine Dog: Totality is larger and more muscular, and has long lower canine teeth. Its strength is noticeably greater, being able to smash apart the ground with a single punch. Nue , Nue ? ) : An owl-like shikigami that can fly and emit electricity from its wings. Sukuna's Nue is several times larger in size, possesses two additional arms and a long tail that resembles a snake's, and has Great Serpent 's marking on its head. The electricity it discharges are much stronger, akin to lightning bolts. Max Elephant , Bansh ? ) : An elephant shikigami that can produce a massive volume of water from its trunk and crush enemies with its weight. Sukuna's Max Elephant has sunken eye sockets and long curved tusks. By using Max Elephant's water-producing ability without directly summoning it, Sukuna can imitate Piercing Blood by firing a water beam out from his hands. Rabbit Escape , Datto ? ) : A swarm of rabbit shikigami that Sukuna uses as a distraction or to obscure his target's vision. As many rabbits can be summoned as needed, and they can be destroyed without any repercussions. Round Deer , Madoka ? ) : A deer shikigami that Sukuna dominated after possessing Megumi. Piercing Ox , Kangy ? ) : A bull shikigami that Sukuna dominated after possessing Megumi. It deals damage by charging and ramming into enemies. While it can only move in a straight line, the further it travels, the harder it hits. Tiger Funeral , Kos ? ) : A shikigami that Sukuna dominated after possessing Megumi. Its appearance and abilities are unknown. Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga , Yatsuka-no-Tsurugi Ikaishinsh Makora ? ) : The most powerful shikigami that the Ten Shadows Technique can summon. It is equipped with the Sword of Extermination and possesses the ability to adapt to all phenomena. Having exorcised it during their battle in Shibuya, Sukuna became the first Ten Shadows Technique user to tame this shikigami. Taming this shikigami allows him to manifest its eight-handled wheel over himself or others and have them shoulder Mahoraga's adaptation process. Nue: Totality - Merged Beast Agito , NueKon - Kang J Agito ? ) : A fusion shikigami that combines Nue with Great Serpent, Round Deer, and Tiger Funeral. The resulting humanoid shikigami is as tall as Mahoraga, can produce electricity from its fists, and regenerate itself or heal others with reverse cursed technique. Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Sukuna is highly proficient with reverse cursed technique. While incarnated in Yuji's body, he used his reverse cursed technique to instantly heal any injuries, including even regenerating lost limbs within moments. Regained limbs maintain the same integrity as the rest of Sukuna's body. He can even output positive energy to heal others, something few can do. After learning it from Gojo, Sukuna can also use reverse cursed technique to heal his burned-out cursed technique by destroying the part of his brain that cursed techniques are engraved in and regenerating it. As a result of incarnating through Yuji, Sukuna became aware of his soul's shape, allowing him to repair his soul using reverse cursed technique. Anti-Domain Techniques Domain Amplification , Ry'iki Ten'en ? ) : Envelops Sukuna in his own domain in the form of an aura around himself. Sukuna uses this technique to neutralize Gojo's Limitless technique and thus is capable of physical contact with him. His finesse with domain amplification allows him to keep it active while using his domain expansion, as well as use it in quick intervals to interrupt and resume Mahoraga 's adaptation instead of nullifying its effect. Hollow Wicker Basket , Iyako Tsuzura ? ) : An anti-domain technique that is the predecessor to New Shadow Style: Simple Domain . It erects a basket-shaped barrier that neutralizes a domain's barrier to nullify its sure-hit factor. Domain Expansion Malevolent Shrine , Fukuma Mizushi ? ) : Sukuna's domain expansion creates a Buddhist shrine decorated with skulls. Everything within the domain is relentlessly slashed with either Dismantle or Cleave, depending on its cursed energy level. Malevolent Shrine has a unique trait; it doesn't create a separate space by enclosing its barrier and is instead manifested into the surrounding airspace. By allowing an escape route, a binding vow is formed which vastly increases the sure-hit's effective area with a maximum radius of nearly 200 meters. Special Abilities Unique Body Structure : In his true form, Sukuna possesses four arms and two mouths. The extra arms allow him to perform hand signs while keeping two of his hands free, and the extra mouth can continuously chant empowered words without straining his heart or lungs. These additional body parts provide him with an immense advantage over other jujutsu sorcerers, and despite its abnormality, his bodily functions are not impeded.

Overall Skill Level : Takako is an exceptional fighter even by the standards of incarnated jujutsu sorcerers. She was the leader of a group of elite assassins that served a respected sorcerer clan in a much more prominent and violent era of jujutsu . Takako has retained her strength in her second life. She is one of the highest-scoring players in the early stages of the Culling Game while fighting in one of its most violent colonies. She scored 70 points in 12 days and her abilities forced a deadlock with other elite players, the likes of Dhruv Lakdawalla , Kurourushi , and Ryu Ishigori . Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Takako possesses expert close combat skills complimented by her cursed technique and is a master of counterattacking. Her ability to manipulate space makes her a such a complex fighter to engage that even Yuta Okkotsu, a special grade sorcerer and prodigy among modern sorcerers, had difficulty combating her directly. She warped one of his punches and then countered by hitting him with an elbow followed by a blastwave from her cursed technique. Yuta was even unable to land a solid hit on Takako without utilizing Rika and his ability to use copied cursed techniques . Takako's skills also proved to be a bad matchup for Ryu, a player who directly rivals her level of strength. Takako easily took on Ryu's best attack and then sent it back at him, becoming the first person to hit him with his own cursed energy output. High Tactical Intellect : Takako is an opportunist who strikes when her chances of victory are at their highest. She was trapped in a deadlock in the Sendai Colony because she recognized Kurourushi's abilities put her at a disadvantage. As soon as Kurourushi was exorcised by Yuta, she moved in on the exhausted sorcerer and surprise attacked him. Her opportunistic nature was also shown when she surprised Yuta again, attacking him after he was sent flying by Ryu. Takako also has advanced knowledge of jujutsu, able to instantly recognize the Snake Eyes and Fangs cursed seal associated with Cursed Speech . This helped her recognize that Yuta wasn't simply a Cursed Speech user with the ability to summon shikigami as well. After getting hit by several different moves, Takako realized that Yuta's true ability was the power to copy other cursed techniques. When she activated Domain Expansion at the same time as Yuta and Ryu, both she and Ryu knew to form their barriers quickly to prevent Rika from entering and giving Yuta the initiative. Advanced Endurance : In addition to her elite martial arts talent and jujutsu ability, Takako is resilient and possesses advanced stamina as well. She displayed her toughness when she withstood a barrage of hard punches from both Yuta and Rika while immobilized by Cursed Speech unable to defend herself. Immediately after, Takako was able to counter one of Yuta's shikigami and despite getting hit by their trajectory constituted domain, Takako retained enough stamina and cursed energy to activate her own domain. Even after her arm was severed by Kurourushi, Takako was ready to continue fighting despite the exhaustion and injuries she accumulated throughout the extended battle. Cursed Energy Capacity : Takako possesses a high amount of cursed energy, demonstrated by her ability to perform Domain Expansion, which requires exceptional levels of cursed energy and control over it. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how her cursed technique works, Uro can increase the effectiveness of her technique. Innate Technique Sky Manipulation : Takako's technique grants her the ability to control the "sky" , sora ? ) like a tangible "surface" , men ? ) . By grabbing hold of and pulling the surrounding atmosphere as if it were a solid sheet or cloak, Takako effectively controls space akin to how a lens creates distortion. She casually uses this to levitate and to cloak her nude body as an alternative to clothing. In battle, Takako can defend by distorting the shape of her opponent's attacks. While the surfaces she controls can't crush her opponents directly, Takako can break the surface of the sky like a thin layer of ice and hit her target with the consequent impact. This allows her attacks to slip past her opponent's guard and generate massive destruction, capable of destroying even multiple city blocks. (Unnamed) Thin Ice Breaker , Usurabi ? ) : Takako applies her technique offensively by hitting the surface of the sky, not her opponent directly. She hits the surface layer of the sky and shatters it like thin ice, striking her opponent with a focused shockwave. Domain Expansion Takako possesses the ability to use domain expansion, but the details of her domain and its sure-hit effect are unknown. When she used it at the same time as Yuta and Ryu, the barrier came apart before any of their domains were fully realized.

Overall Skill : Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer but his rank does not reflect his true skill level. According to Nanami, Ino could easily become a semi-grade 1 sorcerer if he chose to. He is an exceptional combatant with a very potent cursed technique. Ino actively chooses to stay at grade 2 until he gets Nanami's approval and doesn't always have confidence in himself. However, Nanami was completely sure Ino could take out a large room full of Transfigured Humans and left him there alone to take care of them. He even believed Ino could exorcise Mahito in his weakened state after fighting with Nanami and Yuji. During the Shibuya Incident Ino was assigned to Nanami's Team and was eventually put in charge of leading Yuji and Megumi. He worked together with the squad to deduce the enemy curse users' location and was able to fight two at once after confronting them. Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Ino outclassed an average level curse user in close combat with no issues. However, he caught on to his opponent's plan too late, allowing Granny Ogami to outmaneuver him and activate her Sance Technique . After her grandson shapeshifted into Toji Fushiguro , Ino proved no match in terms of physical prowess. Innate Technique Auspicious Beasts Summon , Raih Zuish ? ) is activated when Ino hides his face by covering it with his mask, turning himself into a spiritual medium. This allows Ino to summon and use the abilities of four auspicious beasts: Kaichi, Reiki, Kirin, and Ryu. Kaichi , Kaichi ? ) : Auspicious Beast Number One. Summons a horn with a spiral pattern on it. Can be fired as a projectile cloaked in cursed energy that won't stop until it hits its target. Reiki , Reiki ? ) : Auspicious Beast Number Two. Covers Ino's body in cursed water that can be used to cushion him from danger and increases his overall mobility. Kirin , Kirin ? ) : Auspicious Beast Number Three. Effectively causes intracerebral doping, which nullifies Ino's own sense of pain. However, it also drains his stamina, causing him to become extremely tired but unable to sleep at the same time. Once Kirin has been summoned and the technique completes, Ino becomes immobile for some time. Ryu , Ry ? ) : Auspicious Beast Number Four. Ino concentrates cursed energy around his hands and summons a large serpentine dragon-like creature that rushes out from them and crashes into his target. The dragon can be attacked and dissipates if sufficient damage is dealt. Anti-Domain Technique New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that disables a domain's guaranteed-hit effect within its range by neutralizing its barrier. Ino activated it in response to Sukuna's impromptu Malevolent Shrine to try and survive its 99 second onslaught .

Overall Skill Level : Tengen is viewed as an immortal entity and a pillar of security within the jujutsu community, not a fighter, or someone who interacts with the everyday functions of the world. Tengen's abilities are essential to the structure and organization of jujutsu society. They have existed for centuries and are responsible for teaching the foundations of jujutsu that eventually evolved into the modern-day culture surrounding it. Tengen is the most potent barrier user among all jujutsu sorcerers, even superior to Kenjaku. Tengen created and maintained four pure barriers that improved cursed spirit suppression and the barriers cast by Jujutsu High assistant managers . However, Tengen is a non-combatant and doesn't use jujutsu for fighting. As far as combat, Kenjaku told his allies to consider Tengen a non-factor. Though it was believed that Tengen could pose a threat to humanity once they evolved and their sense of self diminished, Tengen maintained their self-awareness through force of will and barriers. Tengen requested strong sorcerers for protection because they are a non-combatant. Even so, Tengen supported the aforementioned sorcerers in battle. Tengen contributed to Yuki Tsukumo and Choso 's fight against Kenjaku by manipulating the empty barriers that served as the setting. Tengen, Yuki, and Choso strategized for the encounter beforehand and the former contributed to the actual fight by dispelling their empty barriers to destroy Kenjaku's domain. Tengen also served as a distraction where they could in order to give Yuki and Choso any advantage possible. Great Tactical Intellect : Tengen is a wise being with a vast wealth of knowledge, especially as it relates to jujutsu sorcery. It was around Tengen's planning that Megumi and his allies formulated their operation to rescue Tsumiki. Their group was able to gain all the proper answers they needed from Tengen and formulated a plan of action to combat the Culling Game. Tengen contributed the majority of the tactics Yuki and Choso employed during the fight with Kenjaku. Tengen accurately predicted that leading Kenjaku into an area made of barriers would make him comfortable and centered their plan around repeatedly surprising him to force him to expand his domain and burn out his cursed techniques. When Kenjaku unveiled his domain, Tengen immediately recognized it possessed an open barrier just like Sukuna's. Tengen quickly adapted and assumed the edge of the guaranteed-hit area served as the outer shell and erased it along with his empty barrier. Innate Technique Immortality , Fushi ? ) grants Tengen eternal life, just as the name implies. It does not stop them from aging, so their body and technique must be reset every five hundred years. In 2006, Tengen failed to merge with a Star Plasma Vessel and evolved into more of a cursed spirit than a human. They have maintained their self-awareness but their very self has become the world in a sense. Barrier Techniques Jujutsu High Barriers : There is a barrier at both Jujutsu High locations. It changes the appearance of the layout of the buildings every day to hide the schools' existence from the public. These barriers are effective for hiding the school but not necessarily protecting it from infiltration. If an individual already knows the location of Jujutsu High beforehand, the barrier isn't difficult to get into. Concealing Barriers : The entrance to the Tombs of the Star Corridor is protected by a barrier that manipulates over one thousand shuffling doors. The entrance is constantly changing while only one door is connected to the pathway leading to the tombs. On that same pathway is Jujutsu High's cursed warehouse that stores cursed tools and cursed objects. Master Tengen's shrine itself is the base of all their barriers across Japan. The shrine is protected by a different barrier altogether that only allows those invited to enter. Empty Barriers : Completely vacant barriers where the edge is defined by an outer shell made of hexagonal panels. There are numerous empty barriers above the Tombs of the Star. Pure Barriers : A superior type of barrier that raises the precision of Tengen's cursed spirit suppression and the barrier techniques cast by assistant managers from Jujutsu High. Four of them; the Imperial Palace, the Tombs of the Star, the Yamakuni Mausoleum, and Mt. Hida, are crucial to the jujutsu world.

Overall Skill Level : As a member of the Inumaki Clan who has inherited Cursed Speech, Toge is a respected and highly capable semi-grade 1 sorcerer. He was ranked grade 2 as a first year student and was the only one among his peers who could take on solo missions. At that time, Geto also believed Toge was blessed with great potential. His skills have only grown since then and while not currently on the level of Yuta, Hakari , or Todo , Toge is still among the most skilled students at Jujutsu High. Toge is highly intelligent and very capable in battle, displayed by his strong grasp over the strengths and weaknesses of Cursed Speech and how to effectively apply it in every situation. During the Goodwill Event, the rival Kyoto team considered Toge to be one of their biggest threats during the competition. While they were aware of how to counter Cursed Speech, the uncertainty of when Toge could show up and use it made it difficult for some of the Kyoto students to focus on their own battles. Megumi and Noritoshi only survived a drawn-out chase with Hanami because Toge was the only one with an ability that could immobilize the special grade. During the Shibuya Incident , Toge was tasked with saving civilians and eliminating transfigured humans . He saved numerous non-sorcerers and cleared out the entire Dogenzaka district during the middle stages of the incident. High Mobility : While not quite as fast as freaks of nature like Yuji or Maki, Toge is a very athletic individual. He is quick on his feet and very nimble, able to evade Hanami's attacks and lead him on a long chase through the battlefield until he could find his comrades. Toge was also one of the only students in the baseball game who took a base clean after batting and remained a threat to steal. Even Yuji was surprised by Toge's speed, which Maki also endorsed. High Endurance : Toge's Cursed Speech requires a high amount of stamina to use. It causes extreme throat irritation, leading him to cough up blood if overused. Despite this, Toge continues fighting even after reaching his limit and can still unleash commands against higher level opponents. Inherited Technique Cursed Speech , Jugon ? ) : Toge possesses the "Snake Eyes and Fangs" seal of the Inumaki Clan on his tongue and around both sides of his mouth. This allows Toge to infuse his words with cursed energy to improve the spirit of his commands, forcing all who hear it to obey. This power can target living beings and inorganic objects. The more demanding the command, the more of a toll it pays on Toge's body. Weaker curses can be exorcised with powerful commands without backlash, but even less powerful words will consume more energy and stamina when used against opponents with more cursed energy than Toge. Communication devices and voice amplifiers, such as cellphones and bullhorns, do not disrupt Toge's technique, allowing him to project his words and their effects over a longer distance if need be. " Explode " causes Toge's target to violently explode. He used it to effortlessly exorcise a swarm of weak curses. " Get Twisted " or " Twist " forces an appendage of a curse to twist to the point of complete disfigurement. He used this in an attempt to exorcise a semi-grade 1 curse, though it avoids fatal damage. " Get Crushed " causes the target to implode until they're flattened out. Toge used this to finish off the aforementioned semi-grade 1. " Crumble Away " or " Plummet " creates a small field of intensely heavy gravity that crushes the target until they're violently sent underground. Toge used this in an attempt to kill Suguru Geto . " Don't Move " or " Stop " completely immobilizes Toge's target or any of their attacks. He first used this command to stop Aoi Todo and then repeatedly commanded Hanami to stop in their fight. He later used it again in Shibuya to stop the transfigured humans , and in Shinjuku to immobilize Sukuna via a prerecorded tape record. " Sleep " instantly sends whoever hears the command into a deep sleep. Toge used this to incapacitate Kasumi Miwa over the phone. " Return " can forcibly dispel a shikigami . He used this command to return Megumi's Divine Dog after using it for tracking purposes. " Run Away " forces Toge's target to flee the area. He used this to command his allies to run away from Hanami's approach. " Blast Away " is a powerful command that creates an explosive impact of great concussive force strong enough to send a special grade curse crashing up the side of a temple.

Overall Skill Level : While Toji is technically a non-curse user with no innate talent for jujutsu, he was one of the most elite fighters in the jujutsu world when he was alive. With innate physical prowess far superior to all others in his path, Toji contended with the most dangerous and highly ranked jujutsu practitioners this era had to offer. He was able to defeat the strongest jujutsu sorcerers at the time without sustaining any injuries beyond a small cut around the ear, one of which was a young Satoru Gojo, a prodigy who possessed the Six Eyes and Limitless cursed technique. The other was the curse manipulator Suguru Geto , a powerful grade 1 sorcerer that would reach special grade a year later. Toji was able to effortlessly take down Suguru along with several of his strongest cursed spirits. Toji referred to Suguru's abilities as rabble compared to his own strength. Toji used the jujutsu knowledge from the Zenin clan and turned it against sorcerers, earning him the moniker of "Sorcerer Killer." During the Star Plasma Vessel Escort Mission, an assignment given to the two strongest sorcerers by Master Tengen , Toji was hired by the Time Vessel Association to assassinate the Star Plasma Vessel. Toji was able to completely derail the escort through a series of tactical moves over a few days. This wore down the escort team and lured them into a false sense of security before he abruptly made his move. Toji's elaborate planning led to him successfully pulling off a surprise attack on a user of the prestigious Six Eyes , ocular jujutsu that grants god-like perception. Toji took full advantage of his lack of cursed energy, making him the perfect assassin thanks to his status as an "invisible man". The culmination of all Toji's talents allowed him to successfully defeat the Star Plasma Vessel's escort team and assassinate Riko Amanai , as well as her sorcerer maid, Misato Kuroi , completing his assignment while nearly killing both of Jujutsu High's most blessed sorcerers in the process. Toji was only defeated when he pitted his pure physical prowess against the awakened Limitless technique wielded by Satoru Gojo. Even in the face of this power, Toji was able to create clever ways to combat the abilities of the Limitless that were known to the Zenin clan. Only the secret Hollow Purple technique was powerful enough to put down Toji once and for all. Yuki Tsukumo , another special grade sorcerer, found that Toji was the only case where a Heavenly Restriction has eradicated someone's cursed energy completely. By eliminating all cursed energy, Toji's body was sharpened to the point where he developed a resistance to curses and could detect them with his highly refined five senses. This also allowed him to dominate and utilize a cursed spirit capable of storing his wide arsenal of weapons. Yuki considered him to be truly superhuman and told Suguru that he shouldn't be ashamed to have lost to him in a fight. When resurrected by Ogami's Sance Technique, Toji's body was able to overwrite her technique and acted purely on fighting instinct. At the start of his out-of-control rampage, Toji killed Ogami with a single blow and nearly beat grade 2 sorcerer, Takuma Ino , to death with his bare hands. He also took on a special grade cursed spirit, Dagon , and single-handledly dominated him. Dagon was a powerful curse that Maki and grade 1 sorcerers Kento Nanami and Naobito Zenin could not defeat together. In comparison, Toji made exorcising Dagon look effortless, cementing his own status undeniably on the level of that of a special grade. Shortly afterward, Toji confronted Megumi, and the latter compared Toji to a fully realized Maki. He also recognized Toji as a "monster" capable of taking out a special grade cursed spirit and assessed his shikigami were no match for him. If Toji had not chosen to sacrifice himself, Megumi, too would have been another victim of Toji's rampage. Master Weapons Specialist : The Sorcerer Killer is capable of employing a wide variety of weapons in battle. His entire fighting style is based around using weapons to substitute for jujutsu. He keeps a vast arsenal in his cursed spirit, allowing him to efficiently switch weapons out based on necessity. Toji has used non-cursed tools such as swords to perform a sneak attack, so no cursed energy will be detected. Armed with a normal handgun, he's also an expert marksmen with extremely precise aim. The Sorcerer Killer can counter jujutsu users because he is also a master of wielding cursed tools. He's used a cursed tool broadsword to counter and slice open giant cursed spirits. Toji has employed knives and daggers, sometimes one in each hand. Additionally he employs his special grade cursed tool: The Inverted Spear of Heaven with a mastery worthy of that ranking. He could capitalize on the dagger's powerful nullification technique to negate even the most powerful sorcerer's abilities. Toji successfully complements his physical gifts with high adaptability and dexterity with all his weapons. By attaching a chain to the Inverted Spear of Heaven, Toji changed his entire fighting style to suit a long ranged battle. When he first confronted Dagon, Toji took Playful Cloud , a weapon that Megumi stated was difficult to use, from Maki and used it to its maximum potential. Enhanced Senses : Thanks to his " Physically Gifted " Heavenly Restriction, Toji's lack of cursed energy resulted in his five senses being heightened to their absolute peak. He was able to see curses and jujutsu with just his elevated senses and even developed a resistance to them. This also allowed Toji to track sorcerers without the use of residuals, as he was able to follow human footprints and odors. Immense Strength : Toji possesses a superhuman degree of physical strength, enough so to effortlessly yank Playful Cloud from Maki's hands, another person with great physical gifts. Using Playful Cloud, a tool that depends on physical strength, Toji was able to easily smash through Dagon's hardest shikigami. With another cursed tool, he was able to cut through Suguru's toughest curse, and used his bare hands to beat Takuma Ino's face so badly he almost died. Immense Speed and Reflexes : Toji has been noted to have superhuman speed, so much so that his opponents can't read his moves. He could dodge Satoru's cursed technique Lapse: Blue, completely avoiding the field of attraction before Satoru even realized it. Megumi also stated that Toji was ridiculously fast, even faster than Sukuna with three fingers. In their fight, Toji could avoid a point-blank stabbing attack despite getting his foot caught in Megumi's shadow, thanks to incredible agility and reflexes. He also stated that seeing Toji while he moves is near impossible and was impressed his speed rivaled that of Sukuna's without cursed energy. Toji's speed was enough to easily counter Suguru's curses in exchange. He quickly avoided Suguru's Rainbow Dragon by moving on top of a building despite the swift curse in front of him. His reflexes were also quick enough to counter Kuchisake-Onna 's scissor blades, which were already so close to him that they cut his flesh when he first noticed them. As soon as Suguru came in close range, Toji cut him and the Imaginary Vengeful Curse down in a flash. Inside Dagon's Domain, Toji was so fast that he could run on water like it was nothing, shocking the special grade. He only got faster as their fight went on, allowing him to plow through the endless stream of shikigamis with ease. Great Tactical Intellect : When it came to his assignments, Toji approached his missions with careful calculation, caution, and patience. Toji has retained a plethora of information from being a member of the Zenin clan, including understanding the workings of the Limitless and the Six Eyes. Using this information, Toji could plot out a way to slowly wear down Satoru and his escort team. With connections to the curse user community and funds from the Star Religious Group, Toji put a bounty on the Star Plasma Vessel's head. By posting it on a website for curse users with a time limit, evil sorcerers flocked to collect the bounty. He knew they'd be unable to win, so this was free labor, a smart way to use his resources. The time limit also worked in his favor, luring Satoru into lowering his guard once the mission was over. Once Satoru deactivated the Infinity, the Sorcerer Killer immediately acted and only then jumped in to fight the sorcerer directly. Toji is clever in battle and quick to analyze his opponent's abilities. He correctly assumed Suguru's technique early in their battle. He quickly recognized his Kuchisake-Onna 's ability within her Domain. He also came up with several ways to counter Satoru's Limitless in their final bout. When he was brought back by Ogami, Toji instantly created a theory that was correct on how exactly he was able to keep his individuality despite his technique. Zero Cursed Energy : Unlike any other known case, Toji possesses no cursed energy. His Heavenly Restriction completely eliminated cursed energy from his body. This makes Toji undetectable to other jujutsu sorcerers, making him capable of moving through barriers undetected or even sneaking past the Six Eyes. This aided his unpredictability in battle and caused others to underestimate him based purely on cursed energy. Heavenly Restriction Physically Gifted : The trade-off for Toji's complete lack of cursed energy is his immense physical prowess. While it has been noted that several people have had Heavenly Restrictions that bring their cursed energy to normal levels, Toji is the only case where it has erased the person's cursed energy completely. By eliminating all cursed energy, Toji's body became sharpened to a point where his five senses reached his pinnacle, and he could freely interact with curses. When Granny Ogami summoned the information of Toji's body for her Sance Technique, she could not control him because his heavenly gifted body overwrites her grandchild's soul's information. Furthermore, his body doesn't take up cursed energy, allowing Toji to be resurrected for an unprecedented amount of time. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how his heavenly restriction works, Toji can increase his physical prowess.

Overall Skill : Toshihisa Negi's abilities as a sorcerer are completely unknown. As one of Suguru Geto's former commanders, it can be safely assumed he's a capable fighter and was heavily involved in the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons in Kyoto. He was confident enough in his abilities to take on grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer; Atsuya Kusakabe . However, Kusakabe wasn't the least bit intimidated by Negi in comparison to the special grade cursed spirits lurking in Shibuya.
As a non-sorcerer, Tsumiki had no special abilities. After having her brain transfigured into that of a sorcerer's by Kenjaku, she had the strength to serve as Yorozu's vessel.

Overall Skill Level : Tsurugi is a talented young sorcerer possessing a heavenly restricted body with low levels of cursed energy in exchange for superhuman physical performance. He is a cursed tool user capable of attacking with New Shadow Style swordsmanship techniques. Usami , the siblings' direct superior, believes Tsurugi and Yuka are talented sorcerers comparable in strength. However, Tsurugi has proven to be the stronger of the two in unarmed hand-to-hand combat exchanges, able to quickly overwhelm Yuka and knock her down. Enhanced Physical Abilities : In addition to being physically gifted due to his heavenly restriction, Tsurugi also exercises tirelessly to further enhance his superhuman physical strength. Low Cursed Energy : Tsurugi's cursed energy levels are below that of an average non-sorcerer due to his heavenly restriction. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Despite possessing too little cursed energy to perform cursed techniques on his own, Tsurgi is skilled enough to manipulate the cursed energy within his cursed tool to compensate. Heavenly Restriction Physically Gifted : Tsurugi's heavenly restriction is the same as the one his grandmother Maki was born with. In exchange for low cursed energy, Tsurugi possesses superhuman physical gifts. His movements cannot be predicted through the flow of cursed energy, making his attacks difficult to read in battle. Binding Vows During his battle with Marulu Val Vol Yelvori , Tsurugi made a binding vow in which he released Rika 's fusion with himself and the cursed energy she granted him, in exchange for a substantial increase in speed. New Shadow Style Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a Domain Expansion 's barrier and disables its sure-hit effect within its range. Tsurugi uses the cursed energy within his cursed tool to activate this technique and incorporate New Shadow Style sword techniques. Batto Sword Drawing , Batt ? ) : A sword-drawing technique that surrounds the user's blade with cursed energy while it's sheathed, rotating it to create incredible speed when the sword is drawn. It is the fastest sword-drawing technique of the New Shadow Style. Used in conjunction with the Honoyagi , Tsurugi unleashes a flaming slash that sets objects in his vicinity ablaze. Maculation , Madara ? ) : Rather than the typical circular-shaped Simple Domain, this technique creates a grid-shaped barrier of interconnected spots. The Simple Domain integrates a fully automatic attack interception function that allows the user to instantly block and evade attacks from anything that enters into the domain. Rika Rika : The cursed spirit that remained with Yuta after Rika Orimoto passed away. She resided within Yuta's ring, having agreed to protect whoever wore it. She remains immature, voicing disgust that Tsurugi resembled Maki Zenin , speaking to Maru despite Tsurugi telling her not to, and being easily angered by Tsurugi's retorts. Rika merged with Tsurugi when he was on the brink of death after he agreed to accept her help, causing her head to appear over Tsurugi's. In this form, Tsurugi is granted the immense amount of cursed energy Yuta poured into the ring over decades, which he can combine with his brute strength to amplify his strikes, as well as force through the effects of cursed techniques.

Overall Skill : Ui Ui is still too young to be a professional jujutsu sorcerer. However, he's still capable of handling dangerous situations and being a useful asset in battle. Mei Mei trusted him on her team during the Shibuya Incident with Yuji. He carried her axe outside of combat and was responsible for countering domains, making him useful to his grade 1 sister rather than a liability. Regardless of his age, Ui Ui possesses a talent for jujutsu , proven by his ability to use his innate technique as well as barrier techniques. Binding Vows Ui Ui has a binding vow with his sister Mei Mei where he agrees to limit his cursed energy and restrict his usage of jujutsu until she gives him permission. This stems from his own desire to please his elder sister. Innate Technique Spatial Transference : Ui Ui's technique is the spatial transference of "targets" that allows him to teleport himself and others with him to locations and people he has marked. By concealing himself and others with a sheet, Ui Ui can teleport himself and others to another location. This technique allows him to spatially transfer himself or others across vast distances within a short time, as seen when Mei Mei and him escaped from Kenjaku by teleporting from Shibuya, Japan to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia in less than two hours. His technique also allowed him to act as a liaison along with Maki Zenin during the Culling Game , and allowed the jujutsu sorcerers to recover Satoru Gojo , Hiromi Higuruma , Yuta Okkotsu , and Atsuya Kusakabe during the Shinjuku Showdown . If Ui Ui's target is a person, the technique targets their body and soul altogether. If given permission, he can target only the soul, which allows him to switch the souls of his marked targets without changing the shapes of their bodies. This application of Ui Ui's technique can only be used twice per person in a month. (Unnamed) Anti-Domain Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kageryu: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that neutralizes a domain's barrier and disables its sure-hit effect in a set area of space around the user. Ui Ui used Simple Domain to counter the Smallpox Deity's domain, avoiding its gravestone after getting trapped inside a coffin.

Overall Skill Level : Uraume was an ancient sorcerer deemed worthy of standing by Sukuna's side. Atsuya Kusakabe , regarded as one of Jujutsu High's strongest grade 1 sorcerers, felt Uraume's sorcery was completely out of his league when they fought in Shibuya . Uraume incapacitated numerous sorcerers including Kusakabe and Choso, with ease. They would have killed several Jujutsu High sorcerers if they weren't rescued by special grade sorcerer Yuki Tsukumo at the last moment. When Uraume intervened in Sukuna's fight with Yuji and Maki, they ended it with a single attack, allowing Sukuna to escape. In Makyo Shinjuku , Uraume fought on even terms with one of Jujutsu High's strongest students, Kinji Hakari . They were confident enough to believe they could easily overcome Hakari but voluntarily displayed their full strength in response to Hakari's. Uraume displayed their ultimate clever applications and overall control over the technique in this fight. They froze the ground to burst underground pipes, creating more water for Uraume to freeze and utilize to their advantage. Although neither side could best the other, Uraume kept Hakari from joining the raid against Sukuna. In the aftermath, Hakari admitted that Uraume was a tough opponent. Cooking Skills : Uraume couldn't control their cursed technique during their youth and ended up freezing everything around them. Sukuna found Uraume and had them use this technique to keep butchered meat fresh, eventually leading to Uraume showing Sukuna their culinary skills. They're self-taught skills Uraume acquired due to boredom in isolation. Sukuna was impressed by Uraume's cooking and asked him to learn how to prepare people, as the King of Curses had an appetite for human flesh. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Uraume has remarkable control over their cursed energy, as the rare skill to use reverse cursed technique requires extremely precise cursed energy manipulation. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : By reinforcing their hands with cursed energy, Uraume was able to partially block Choso's Piercing Blood and completely brushed aside Momo Nishimiya 's Wind Scythe . Innate Technique Ice Formation , Hikori Juh ? ) : Uraume's innate technique gives them the ability to create and manipulate ice. It can range from small to large quantities, depending on the desired utilization. Frost Calm , Shimonagi ? ) : Uraume channels a cloud of freezing mist from their mouth and blows it towards their opponent. The freezing mist materializes into large columns of thick ice and frost to ensnare the enemy. This technique was shown to be especially effective against groups of people, instantly freezing an entire squad of sorcerers in place. Icefall , Choku Baku ? ) : After covering their hand in frost and touching the ground, Uraume can generate a large amount of spiked ice that can be controlled to float telekinetically through the air like shards. The ice freezes its target on impact and rains down sharpened icicles to skewer them as well. This attack is extremely deadly, nearly subduing a group of targets all at once. Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Uraume is capable of producing positive energy with ease. They were able to regenerate the flesh of their palm that was drilled through by Choso's Piercing Blood.

Overall Skill Level: Utahime is a capable semi-grade 1 sorcerer who mainly acts as support for her allies. Although primarily a support sorcerer, Utahime still goes on dangerous missions, such as when she went to save the students from potential curse users or cursed spirits , with Yoshinobu Gakuganji asking her to avoid fighting, confirming that she is capable of it if necessary. She easily dodged an attack from Haruta Shigemo and was about to engage with him in a fight. Utahime was also fast enough to run in front of Kasumi Miwa to protect her from Kenjaku 's point-blank Maximum: Uzumaki , with Momo Nishimiya immediately stating that Utahime shouldn't be in the frontlines. Innate Technique Solo Forbidden Area , Soro Soro Kinku ? ) is Utahime's innate technique . It temporarily amplifies the cursed energy of any willing sorcerer within range, including herself. The technique can be elevated into a ritual using incantations, hand signs, dance, and music. By including all of these steps, the technique's effectiveness can be raised to 120%. Barrier Techniques Curtain , Tobari ? ) : A type of barrier that is cast over a large area to hide everything within it from the outside world. Utahime, while investigating a cursed mansion in Hamamatsu City, attempted to cast a curtain , though Mei Mei interrupted her.
As an ordinary human, Wasuke has no additional abilities, though he does know basic martial arts that he later taught to Yuji.

Overall Skill Level : Yorozu was a powerful sorcerer of the Heian era, the golden age of jujutsu. She made a name for herself in a time period when the strongest fighters boasted incredible cursed techniques. She was on par with these sorcerers despite her technique being far less efficient in its consumption of cursed energy than average. However, as a battle-hardened veteran of the Heian era, Yorozu had used her combat experiences to figure out a way to work around her deficiencies. She invented clever solutions to her problem, resulting in a fighting style that bested the Five Empty Generals of the Toh, garnering Yorozu official recognition from the Fujiwara clan. During the Culling Game, Yoruzu was able to fight on nearly even terms with Sukuna after Ryu Ishigori , a powerful sorcerer in his own right, was dispatched instantly by the latter. Their battle was initially competitive, where Yorozu landed several direct hits and withstood the Ten Shadows Technique . She displayed the full strength of her Construction technique as well as the ability to expand her domain . However, Yorozu was unable to force Sukuna to use his own innate technique and she was ultimately bested by the full might of the Ten Shadows Technique. Cursed Energy Capacity : In terms of cursed energy reserves and output, Yorozu was on par with the greatest sorcerers of the Heian era. Unlike Mai Zenin who has the same incredibly energy-inefficient technique, Yorozu could consecutively create large constructs with no signs of fatigue. Only after creating her ultimate construct did she show signs of exhausting her cursed energy via a nosebleed, but even then she still had enough cursed energy left to cast domain expansion, a technique that expends an incredibly high amount of cursed energy. Cursed Energy Manipulation : While her technique was energy-inefficient, Yorozu found the most effective creations and manipulated them using advanced control of her cursed energy. This included the semi-autonomous cursed energy that controlled her liquid metal, which she used to pilot her Insect Armor. Cursed Energy Output : As previously mentioned, Yorozu's cursed energy output was equal to some of the powerhouses in the Heian period, allowing her to output large amounts of cursed energy into her technique and recreate almost any object she knows of despite Constructions immense cursed energy consumption. Innate Technique Construction , Kchiku Jutsushiki ? ) : Depending on her familiarity and training, Yorozu could re-create any substance she recognized except for special cursed tools. Creating something from nothing uses a lot of cursed energy, making this technique energy-inefficient compared to other cursed techniques. Insect Wings : Yorozu can construct two pairs of insect-like wings on her back that allow her to fly at high speeds. Liquid Metal , Ekitai Kinzoku ? ) : Having constructed several kinds of combat equipment, Yorozu used her experience to develop a liquid metal as her primary weapon on her way to becoming a veteran sorcerer. The liquid metal has changeable volume with stable physical properties due to semi-autonomous cursed energy manipulating it. Insect Armor , Mushi no Yoroi ? ) : Yorozu created flesh armor specialized in appropriating numerous insect biofunctions. She saw a solution to her cursed technique's weakness in the efficiency of insects. Yorozu deemed an insect's carapace the ultimate armor and the ideal subject for construction. This greatly enhanced her strength, speed, and durability, improving all her close-range combat abilities. True Sphere , Shinky ? ) : Under normal circumstances, a perfect sphere is thought to be impossible to create. Yorozu was able to do so by shaping it from liquid metal. A true sphere has no contact area and generates infinite pressure as a result, making it untouchable. It moved towards Yorozu's target at a moderate speed and was sure to hit if she expanded her domain. Domain Expansion Threefold Affliction , Shikkushikku Shikku ? ) : Yorozu's domain is a mostly blank space, although with several oversized, organic structures floating within it that resemble the disembodied brains and ganglia of insects. The sure-hit effect of the domain applies to Yorozu's constructed items, particularly her True Sphere , hence destroying anything caught in the domain instantly should Yorozu will it.

Overall Skill: As the principal of Kyoto Jujutsu High, Gakuganji is a strong jujutsu sorcerer, managing to defeat a grade 1 sorcerer like his fellow principal Masamichi Yaga with the aid of another sorcerer. Innate Technique Sound Amplifier : Gakuganji's technique uses his body as a sound amplification device, amplifying the melodies he plays on his electric guitar and launching it in waves of cursed energy. (Unnamed)

Overall Skill Level: Yu's abilities were not explicitly shown. However, he was selected for training at Tokyo Jujutsu High, indicating above-average potential. He and Nanami were sent to exorcise what was believed to be a grade 2 cursed spirit ; it was later revealed to be a grade 1, which was too powerful for Yu. This suggests his strength was approximately at the grade 2 level.

Overall Skill Level : Yuji is one of Tokyo Jujutsu High's most powerful and talented students. Satoru Gojo places him on the same level of potential as Yuta Okkotsu and Kinji Hakari , the three students who he believes will surpass his strength. Despite having no connections to the jujutsu world before a few months prior to the Shibuya Incident , Yuji is able to contend with and defeat grade 1 and special grade curses. Yuji was gifted with superhuman physical abilities which he masterfully combines with his cursed energy . Yuji is also able to contain Sukuna with no ill effects, which allows him to perceive the shape of souls. This enables him to harm Mahito , whose control over the shape of his soul otherwise renders him immune to injury. Poison Resistance : Since Yuji became Sukuna's vessel by ingesting one of his fingers , which is considered lethal poison, he has a resistance to all kinds of poison. Yuji will feel the pain from the poison, but he is mostly unaffected. This ability was first demonstrated during his fight with Junpei Yoshino when he could resist Moon Dregs ' poison. It was demonstrated again when Yuji resisted the effects of Eso and Kechizu 's Decay . Weapon Mastery : Yuji was not trained in the use of weapons; however, due to his physical power and talent, he can still become proficient with one quickly. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Yuji is one of the greatest, if not the greatest practitioner of martial arts in the series. His fighting prowess goes toe to toe with Aoi Todo, another extremely proficient martial artist. Yuji can effortlessly defeat a grade 2 cursed spirit , and challenge special grade curses purely using martial arts and infusing his style with cursed energy . Yuji also possesses an impressive control over his attacks, being able to pause his punch a moment before impact and adjust his power into several counter blows. Yuji's fighting style is usually depicted as being very acrobatic with his movements, allowing him to strike his opponent in several different angles which also allow him to evade several oncoming attacks, essentially giving him great offensive and defensive capabilities. If the initial strike he is going for has been blocked, he is able to use high flying kicks, unorthodox punches, and even a knee strike to retaliate. He is also skilled in a martial arts style known as Taido Martial Arts , which grants him the ability to perform Knee Release , an ancient martial arts technique that eliminates starting movements and allows Yuji to release his knees, hips, and shoulders to guide him to his opponent's feet instead of falling down. By combining the technique mentioned above with Taido Martial Arts, Yuji can perform Manji Kick , where he uses the momentum to throw his right leg upwards and land a kick to his opponent's head. By adding cursed energy to this attack, it can harm cursed spirits. Immense Strength : Yuji is quite powerful even without the usage of cursed energy, as he can destroy walls with ease, throw a lead ball with enough force to bend a soccer goalpost, and even throw a car. As powerful as he is without cursed energy, especially when it comes to fighting, his exceptional strength can often be augmented to further levels with the usage of cursed energy, the Divergent Fist technique, and Black Flash , allowing him to exorcise cursed spirits. His unique strength has also been compared to Kento Nanami , a grade 1 sorcerer. He can even harm Hanami and Choso , two curses who have remarkable durability and toughness with the former being near-impossible to damage. During his fight with Sukuna, Yuji jumped 20 stories from two buildings to reach Sukuna after the latter took control over Megumi's body. Also in his fight with Sukuna, Yuji was able to kick a massive chunk of rubble towards Sukuna , momentarily stopping him. Immense Speed and Reflexes : Yuji is shown to have great speed and can finish a 50-meter track within 3 seconds, implying he can run at speeds of 60.02 km/h (37.3 mph). He's also been shown to dodge the attacks of all five opposing sorcerers from the students from Kyoto Jujutsu High who tried to murder him. He is fast enough to evade Choso's Piercing Blood , which travels at the speed of sound, proving he has superb reflexes. During Yuji and Maki 's fight against Sukuna while possessing Megumi, Yuji was able to keep up with their magnificent speed and reflexes despite being grievously wounded from his previous battle. Immense Durability : Yuji's durability surpasses the average sorcerer. He was able to continuously take hits from Choso during their fight and even Piercing Blood, an attack moving at the speed of sound didn't pierce Yuji immediately. He was also able to withstand numerous attacks from Mahito in his Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing form and continue fighting. After Sukuna took control over Megumi's body, he punched Yuji through multiple buildings and Yuji survived that, and afterwards was able to fight him and even survive Sukuna relentlessly attacking him with Dismantle and keep fighting him with Maki's help. Immense Stamina : Fitting his other superhuman capabilities, Yuji possesses a large amount of stamina and has often been shown continuing to fight despite grievous injuries for longer periods of time without rest, such as having his hand severed and his fingers disintegrated when battling the Finger Bearer , allowing for Megumi to escape with Nobara. He was also able to resist several poisonous stab wounds from when he tried to stop Junpei from hurting anyone at his school. His incredible stamina is especially shown afterwards when he sustained grievous injuries from Mahito but was able to continue attacking. Proficient Learner : Yuji is a curious person and an earnest student. He is also good at progressing - being quick at Gojo's Watching Movies Training, and realizing Todo's advice quickly. According to Akutami , he is the best at cooking among the first years trio. He was able to master using martial arts alongside cursed energy and honed it to a level with which he can take on special grade curses. He was even able to use Black Flash four times in a row a short time after he had even learnt of its existence. Another testament to his development was his growing understanding of cursed energy within just a month prior to his battle against Sukuna. Through two sessions of replacement training with Atsuya Kusakabe and Yuta Okkotsu , aside from drastically improving his cursed energy reinforcement, Yuji managed to grasp the complex nature of reverse cursed technique and learned how to use and perform it efficiently to heal himself. Cursed Energy Capacity : Yuji's cursed energy originates from the parts of the special grade cursed object , Ryomen Sukuna . He didn't have an innate technique initially, but he showed great proficiency with learning how to control cursed energy. Even after Sukuna left his body, Yuji retained an immense cursed energy pool, having continuously used cursed energy to reinforce his body and perform various cursed techniques throughout the raid against Sukuna while showing no signs of exhaustion until after using his Domain Expansion , which requires and expends a massive amount of cursed energy. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Having been thrust into the jujutsu world without any prior knowledge about jujutsu, Yuji initially struggled to draw out or manipulate his cursed energy, being unable to attack curses without a cursed tool . Thanks to the various training regimens he underwent and having experienced Black Flash, Yuji better grasped the nature of cursed energy. By the time he had his rematch with Mahito during the Shibuya Incident, Yuji managed to land a Black Flash with maximum cursed energy, displaying the ability to use it seemingly at will, a feat said to be impossible for even Satoru Gojo. After the Shibuya Incident , Yuji has added much greater finesse onto his cursed energy manipulation, combining cursed energy and superhuman physical abilities, with Choso describing him as a "demon god". In the month before fighting Sukuna, through replacement training with Kusakabe and Yuta, Yuji improved his cursed energy reinforcement and learned how to perform reverse cursed technique. Cursed Energy Reinforcement : Yuji primarily uses cursed energy combined with his martial arts skills and superhuman strength to reinforce his strikes, increasing their impact and allowing him to hurt curses. After undergoing replacement training with Kusakabe, Yuji's cursed energy reinforcement is improved, enabling him to withstand Sukuna's slashes without substantial damage. Divergent Fist , Keitei Ken ? ) : After Yuji lands a punch on a target, his cursed energy flows after the strike and makes a stronger second impact. Divergent Fist was initially used when Yuji didn't have good control over his cursed energy, causing it to lag behind his attacks due to his superhuman speed. During Yuji's fight with Todo in the Goodwill Event , the Kyoto third-year critiqued this attack and taught the first-year how to apply cursed energy at the exact moment his strikes hit by improving his understanding of how to flow cursed energy. Since his fight with Choso, Yuji learned to use Divergent Fist at will, exploiting the delayed second impact's effect to confuse his opponents, leaving them open for his next attack. Black Flash , Kokusen ? ) : A phenomenon that occurs when the user applies cursed energy within 0.000001 seconds of a physical hit, creating a spatial distortion that causes their cursed energy to flash black and amplifies the destructive power of the strike to the power of 2.5. Yuji is capable of performing Black Flash seven times in a row and has used it a total of nineteen times. Blood Poisoning : After ingesting the remaining six cursed objects , Yuji's body, including his blood, became similar to that of an incarnated Death Painting Womb. By injecting his blood into others, Yuji can poison them due to the incompatibility of his non-human blood, which can even affect aliens . Even a small amount of his blood introduced through something as minor as a scratch to the face can immediately cause nausea and vomiting. Higher doses can render a person unconscious after vomiting and induce symptoms resembling a severe case of the flu, though these effects typically subside after a few days of rest. Blood Conversion : Yuji's similar constitution to that of a Death Painting Womb allows him to convert cursed energy directly into blood. As long as he possesses sufficient cursed energy, he can prevent himself from dying due to blood loss. This trait also enabled him to learn and utilize reverse cursed technique more easily than most sorcerers. Unlike them, he does not require technical knowledge on how to convert cursed energy into blood, nor does he suffer the massive cursed energy consumption associated with that process. Additionally, he can perform Blood Manipulation extension techniques on a larger and more powerful scale without relying on pre-prepared blood bags. Binding Vows Yuji had a binding vow with Sukuna. The King of Curses agreed to revive the boy after his apparent death under two conditions: Yuji would allow Sukuna to take over his body for one minute when the latter chants "Enchain" , Keikatsu ? ) and he would forget about the agreement. Yuji initially opposed the binding vow, making Sukuna promise that he wouldn't kill or hurt anyone during that minute. The boy still disagreed with the terms and instead had a battle against the King of Curses, where he'd allow the agreement to occur if he lost. Sukuna effortlessly defeated Yuji, forcing him into accepting the binding vow. Through a binding vow, Yuji increased Dismantle's effectiveness at separating souls by restricting its target to the boundary between Sukuna and Megumi's souls, rending them more effectively than his physical strikes. Innate Techniques Blood Manipulation , Sekketsu Sjutsu ? ) : After absorbing Cursed Womb: Death Painting No. 4-9, Yuji was engraved with Blood Manipulation, the inherited technique of the Kamo Clan . Using this innate technique, Yuji can manipulate his own blood. Convergence , Byakuren ? ) : An extension technique that compresses and condenses the user's blood to its absolute limit with cursed energy. The blood orb created by this technique is required for using Piercing Blood and Supernova . Due to his inexperience, Yuji is unable to perform Convergence very well. 68 years later, Yuji has learned how to properly perform Convergence, and is able to compress large amounts of blood into a single orb. Piercing Blood , Senketsu ? ) : After using Convergence, the user clasps their hands around the blood orb and fires a blood beam that travels at the speed of sound. Yuji used this technique against Sukuna during their fight, damaging his face. Due to being unable to use Convergence, Yuji took a pressurized blood orb created by Choso in order to perform Piercing Blood. 68 years later, Yuji has mastered this technique and is able to perform a variant of it, firing multiple homing beams of blood instead of a single shot. Shrine , Mizushi ? ) : After landing a Black Flash against Sukuna, the awakened state brought forth by the phenomenon drew out Sukuna's own cursed technique that was engraved in Yuji, albeit with some differences. Unlike Sukuna, Yuji creates dashed lines with scissors on anything he touches that are subsequently cut along those lines. Due to only recently awakening the technique, Yuji's output for the technique was low. Dismantle , Kai ? ) : A slashing attack that can be used through touch or at range against cursed spirits and sorcerers to great effectiveness. When he initially awakened Shrine, Yuji could only deliver Dismantle through physical contact. 68 years later, Yuji mastered Shrine and could launch Dismantle at range and with high output, capable of exorcising a horde of cursed spirits with one giant flying slash, and dicing apart his opponent and surroundings with countless imperceivable slashes. Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Within the month before his battle against Sukuna, Yuji learned how to use reverse cursed technique to heal himself. Using reverse cursed technique, he regenerated his body after suffering a Cleave from Sukuna. He later used it to heal the wounds he received from two of Sukuna's Dismantle slashes, and continuously used it throughout the battle whenever he was damaged. Anti-Domain Technique New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique Yuji learned by switching souls with Atsuya Kusakabe . It is used to disable a domain's guaranteed-hit effect by neutralizing its barrier. Yuji activated it in response to Sukuna's impromptu Malevolent Shrine , allowing him to resist its slashes for almost 99 seconds before finally crumbling. Domain Expansion Hometown Domain : Due to his replacement training with Kusakabe, Yuji learned the basics of barrier techniques, allowing him to cast domain expansion. Yuji's Domain Expansion perfectly recreates his hometown, including landmarks familiar to him such as a local statue, a park that he played in, a department store, a farm he visited, etc.. It can even create animals such as crayfish, horses, and geese. The sure-hit effect of this domain attacks Yuji's targets with his soul-rending Dismantle without requiring physical contact.

Overall Skill Level : Yuka is a talented young sorcerer. Usami , the siblings' direct superior, believes Yuka and Tsurugi are talented sorcerers comparable in strength. Skilled Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Although she inherited the prized Ten Shadows Technique of the Zenin Clan , Yuka is only permitted to use abilities of certain shikigami during combat rather than summoning them. Nonetheless, Yuka is well-versed in hand-to-hand combat and can combine her martial arts with jujutsu . Enhanced Strength : Yuka possesses above-average levels of physical strength, presumably through manipulating cursed energy to reinforce her body. With a single strike, she was able to send a metal door flying across a large room. Binding Vows Before summoning Mahoraga to clash with Dabura Karaba , Yuka made a binding vow in which she traded her life for a considerable boost to her cursed energy and cursed technique . Inherited Technique Ten Shadows Technique , Tokusa no Kage Bjutsu ? ) : A technique passed down in the Zenin Clan which Yuka inherited, allowing her to summon up to ten potential shikigami using her shadows as an intermediary. It also grants the user overall manipulation of shadows, allowing Yuka to hide in shadows or store objects within her own shadow. Savage Jaw Strike , Kugakus ? ) : Presumably by drawing out the abilities of Divine Dogs , Yuka infuses her hands with cursed energy, causing her fingernails to grow long and sharp. Curling her fingers in a claw-fashion, Yuka then strikes her opponents with her hands. The cursed energy possesses special traits , causing it to deal slashing damage upon contact. Biting Twist , Knen ? ) : Using Savage Jaw Strike, Yuka strikes her target with both of her hands in a twisting motion, delivering a powerful impact that can knock a human unconscious. Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga , Yatsuka-no-Tsurugi Ikaishinsh Makora ? ) : The most powerful shikigami that the Ten Shadows Technique can summon. Mahoraga is equipped with the Sword of Extermination and has the ability to adapt to all phenomena. Yuka summoned Mahoraga as the opening move in her duel against Dabura before hiding in its shadow, forcing the Simurian to fight the shikigami alone.

Overall Skill Level : Yuki is an extremely powerful fighter, one of only four registered special grade sorcerers who possesses incredibly unorthodox abilities. Jujutsu Headquarters knew next to nothing about Yuki's powers despite designating her special grade but she has shown up for her allies and showcased her abilities against some of the strongest opponents available. Yuki possesses elite combat instincts and is highly talented in jujutsu, capable of using her innate technique, barrier techniques, and domain expansion. She's also fully capable of instructing students and fostering elite talent despite not being a teacher at Jujutsu High. Yuki introduced Aoi Todo to jujutsu and mentored him into the exceptional grade 1 sorcerer he's flourished into. Her training was extremely grueling, enough so to physically scar Todo for life.
