Todo has shown the fruits of her imparted knowledge time and time again, including learning to use Simple Domain from her. Yuki displayed her own strength when she effortlessly repelled Uraume 's Icefall technique using only Garuda . Uraume had overpowered a large group of sorcerers on their own who were all saved by Yuki's intervention. Yuki used her full strength against Kenjaku and effortlessly exorcised one of his special grade curses with her first attack. Her second attack sent Kenjaku flying and made him question whether he could even tame the wild beast known as Yuki Tsukumo. Kenjaku's domain expansion severely injured Tsukumo only because she chose to rely on Tengen's help and their countermeasures had a severe miscalculation. Yuki's simple domain couldn't stand up to Kenjaku's domain but using her domain would've likely ended with a different outcome. Yuki continued fighting despite her injuries, and with Choso's help, she drove the curse user into a corner. Despite initially believing Choso would only hold her back, Yuki fought effectively alongside Choso even while her body was mangled and proficiently utilized reverse cursed technique to heal herself while Choso was holding their opponent off. Once healed, Yuki quickly regained momentum with her pure destructive power but Kenjaku outwitted her and dealt an unexpected fatal blow. Yuki fought to the end and used her innate technique to transform into a black hole with the potential to destroy the world. She suppressed its power using her will and prevented a catastrophe, impressing even the callous Kenjaku. Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant : Yuki is primarily a close-quarters combatant who supplements her martial arts with her innate technique to unleash devastating attacks. In her first hand-to-hand exchange with Kenjaku, she was able to use a single punch to literally break through his guard and send him flying. Yuki kept Kenjaku, an excellent taijutsu user, on the defensive throughout most of their hand-to-hand combat exchanges. Even with a broken arm and numerous other injuries, Yuki was able to pressure Kenjaku with flurries of kicks and other improvised attacks. A fully healed Yuki easily outmaneuvered Kenjaku at close range and nearly defeated him. Immense Endurance : Yuki is exceptionally durable for a human being and has a high pain tolerance. She suffered a direct hit from Womb Profusion that dealt her a serious head injury as well as a completely shattered right arm. Not only was Yuki able to move despite her injuries, but she kept her innate technique active and fought Kenjaku on even terms in hand-to-hand combat. While her body quickly reached its limit due to her injuries, Yuki fought through them and continued to use her mangled body to pressure Kenjaku alongside Choso. Yuki even managed to move and activate with her body bifurcated, fighting until the very end. Great Tactical Intellect : While her wits are not always on display due to her straightforward attitude, Yuki is as smart as she is strong and goes into every situation with a considerable amount of thought. Using her advanced knowledge of jujutsu, Yuki vigorously analyzes her opponent's every move throughout a battle, taking mental notes of every technique used and every countermeasure that is taken. As a testament to her jujutsu-related knowledge and intuition, Yuki was able to recognize Ganesha was a cursed spirit foreign to Japan with a single glance. It only took a single activation for Yuki to figure out Kenjaku could manipulate gravity. Further observation of Kenjaku's technique allowed Yuki to figure out its effective range as well as the time needed between activation intervals. Yuki worked with Tengen to formulate a multi-layered plan to deal with Kenjaku that was nearly successful in several facets. Although the second phase of their plan was miscalculated and Yuki didn't escape Kenjaku's domain unharmed, she knew she needed to keep fighting through her physical trauma so Choso could ambush him in the next phase. When Kenjaku survived the ambush, Yuki quickly deduced how he managed to avoid a fatal blow. She also recognized he would've died if her technique was at full power and that he was still cornered regardless. While Yuki can keep pace in a cerebral battle with an incredibly experienced sorcerer such as Kenjaku, even she makes mistakes. Not only did she underestimate Kenjaku in her strategy with Tengen, but when Yuki attempted to exploit the time lag in Kenjaku's ability to manipulate gravity, she assumed Star Rage could power through any resistance from Cursed Spirit Manipulation . While this was a safe assumption, it was reckless and turned out to be incorrect, which Yuki herself realized and admitted. Even in defeat, Yuki quickly improvised a maneuver to take her opponent down with her in a last-ditch effort to do what was necessary for the greater good. Cursed Energy Manipulation : Yuki has remarkable control over her cursed energy, as the rare skill to use reverse cursed technique requires extremely precise cursed energy manipulation. Cursed Energy Capacity : Yuki possesses a high amount of cursed energy, demonstrated by her ability to perform domain expansion, which requires exceptional levels of cursed energy and control over it. Binding Vows Revealing One's Hand , Jh no Kaiji ? ) : A commonly used binding vow by many jujutsu practitioners. By divulging how her cursed technique works, Yuki can increase the effectiveness of her technique. Innate Technique Star Rage , Bonbaie ? ) : Yuki's innate technique allows her to grant virtual mass to herself and her shikigami, Garuda. The mass added to Yuki and Garuda's attacks gives them devastating destructive force, capable of effortlessly exorcising a special grade curse. Reverse Cursed Technique Reverse Cursed Technique , Hanten Jutsushiki ? ) : Yuki is able to utilize reverse cursed technique to heal herself. She has used this during her fight against Kenjaku after she was severely damaged by the sure-hit technique of his Womb Profusion . Shikigami Garuda , Garuda ? ) : Yuki's shikigami is directly connected to her innate technique. By having virtual mass added to it by Star Rage, Garuda becomes a cursed tool for Yuki to utilize in battle. Garuda can also fight and restrain Yuki's opponents independently, creating situations where they fight side-by-side. Anti-Domain Techniques New Shadow Style: Simple Domain , Shin Kagery: Kan'i Ryiki ? ) : An anti-domain technique that nullifies a domain expansion's sure-hit effect by neutralizing its barrier. Yuki also taught Aoi Todo how to use this technique. Against Kenjaku, Yuki's Simple Domain was quickly stripped away by Womb Profusion. Domain Expansion Yuki can expand her innate domain and imbue it with her innate technique. It was never displayed but Yuki spoke about it with Tengen while planning to fight against Kenjaku.

Overall Skill Level : Yuta is one of only four special grade sorcerers recognized by Jujutsu High. While being haunted by Rika's vengeful spirit, Yuta was immediately registered as a special grade due to Rika's immense power, making him the most recent person to receive the ranking. Yuta was completely unaware of how to fight or control his cursed energy when Satoru threw him into his first mission. He relied on Maki until they were swallowed by a curse and it came down to Yuta to rescue everyone inside. Yuta was able to tap into his emotions and fully manifest Rika, ripping the other curse apart and freeing everyone. Yuta barely carried everyone outside the barrier but he used what little physical strength and stamina he had to finish the mission. This made Yuta painfully aware of how weak he was, so Maki trained him on the basics of armed combat for three months before his next assignment. He was never able to land a hit on Maki but always trained hard to improve himself and started to move a lot better. However, in his second mission, an exorcism with Toge, Yuta still found himself relying on his classmate's skill. When a semi-grade 1 curse ambushed them, Toge was injured saving Yuta. Yuta stepped up on his own without relying on Rika and helped Toge exorcise it. Yuta's training allowed him to avoid most of the cursed spirit's attacks and he even landed a counterattack. It was just a shallow slash, however, due to the toughness of the curse and Yuta's poor cursed energy control at the time. Apparently, during the 2017 Goodwill Event , Yuta completely dominated all of the Kyoto Jujutsu High competitors, including Aoi Todo . There is no record of him fully manifesting Rika at that time but Maki noted she was still around and was likely the reason Yuta won the event. Continuing training throughout his tenure at Jujutsu High, Yuta continued to grow stronger and built a solid foundation as a sorcerer. On December 24, 2017, Suguru Geto targeted Yuta and injured his friends while invading the school. This set Yuta off, unleashing extraordinary levels of cursed energy throughout his body. This resulted in a mighty increase of Yuta's physical abilities and fine-tuned of his senses. Alongside Rika, Yuta was able to match Geto one-on-one. He revealed not only the ability to use the extremely rare reverse cursed technique but the capacity to copy other cursed techniques like cursed speech as well. This led Geto to claim he was glad that he attacked Yuta before the student learned to properly wield Rika's power. Yuta was only able to defeat Geto by vowing to give his life in exchange for removing the limiters on Rika's boundless power, ultimately overpowering Maximum: Uzumaki and Tamamo-no-Mae Incarnate . The major difference in their battle was that Yuta was willing to give his life to win while the cursed manipulator didn't have the vast majority of his curses, with over four thousand serving the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons. Following his victory, Yuta discovered he was the one who cursed Rika when they were young, not the other way around. He is a descendant of Michizane Sugawara , one of the greatest sorcerers to ever live, making Yuta a distant relative of the Gojo clan . Yuta severed the bond tying servant to master and Rika didn't desire to punish him, so the curse was broken, freeing Orimoto's soul. Yuta originally thought that after Rika passed away he wouldn't be able to be a sorcerer anymore. Kenjaku believes that Yuta's vast cursed energy and his ability to copy cursed techniques were tied to detaining his loved one's soul. However, these are incorrect assumptions and Satoru Gojo has stated on more than one occasion that Yuta still has the potential to surpass him. By March of 2018, only three months after the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons, Yuta regained his rank as a special grade sorcerer. He is a prodigy who boasts incredible power and unusual abilities second only to Satoru Gojo. Satoru forced Geto's comrade, Miguel, to train Yuta. Miguel mentored Yuta overseas while they searched for the Black Rope . By the time he returned to Tokyo following the Shibuya Incident, Yuta was able to dispatch large cursed spirits without much effort. Upon arriving to execute Sukuna 's vessel, Yuta was recognized as a major threat to everyone. Yuji , Choso , and Naoya , three strong jujutsu users, were all briefly stricken by Yuta's unsettling cursed energy. Naoya, who especially prides himself on his abilities, was quick to ally himself with Yuta in order to avoid any potential conflict. Choso told Yuji to run away immediately because he could feel Yuta's overwhelming strength is on a scale similar to Satoru Gojo's, ensuring death. Following Choso's advice to get away from Yuta, Yuji attempted to flee but Yuta was able to run him down and engage his target one-on-one. Due to what occurred in Shibuya , Yuji was holding himself back, and Yuta was easily able to overpower him. Yuta displayed more overall cursed energy then their sensei as well as reinforcement techniques far beyond an elite sorcerer. Yuji's normal reinforcement was no match for the amount Yuta was enhancing his own body with, leading the former to evade attacks most of the fight. Following his victory, Yuta found Choso after he defeated Naoya and knocked him unconscious with a single blow. In addition to mastering close combat skills, Yuta has become a proficient user of reverse cursed technique. After executing Yuji, Yuta instantly restarted his heart by outputting positive energy into him. His ability to output positive energy at will is something even Satoru is unable to do. Yuta only showcased a small portion of his abilities against Yuji and yet his very presence intimidated the likes of Naoya and Choso. He displayed the full extent of his powers during the Culling Game, where Yuta was matched up against some of the strongest players the deadly battle royal had to offer. He effortlessly dispatched Dhruv Lakdawalla, an incarnated sorcerer who once conquered Japan, single-handedly shattering the four-way deadlock in the Sendai Colony . Yuta likely could've also made short work of Kurourushi if he had chosen to use reverse cursed technique from the beginning. However, Yuta handicapped himself to avoid displaying his abilities to those observing him and still managed to overpower the cockroach curse in multiple exchanges. Yuta was eventually cornered and nearly defeated but he ultimately exorcised the curse using a calculated maneuver that blasted Kurourushi's head with positive energy. Yuta put up fierce resistance against Uro and Ryu directly after defeating Kurourushi. He used reverse cursed technique and his cursed energy manipulation to survive their attacks but could hardly go on the offensive against their cursed techniques. In order to ensure victory, Yuta went all out and showcased the full extent of his abilities. Utilizing Rika and his full skillset, Yuta completely took over the momentum of the battle and overpowered both his opponents, forcing them to rely on domain expansion. Yuta cast his own domain in response, displaying his capacity to use the supreme jujutsu art as well. Even after the domain struggle resulted in everyone being unable to use cursed techniques for a limited time, Yuta still excelled and was directly involved in eliminating Uro and Kurourushi's offspring from the fight. Yuta's advanced reinforcement techniques gave him an edge over Uro and his positive energy was used to easily dispatch Kurourushi's offspring. Ryu proved to not only be the strongest among the participants of the four-way deadlock but the toughest opponent for Yuta as well. His cursed energy output could even bypass Yuta's toughness and his directed blasts were far superior to Yuta and Rika's. Yuta was able to achieve victory due to his growth as a fighter, made abundant by his tactical awareness and the ability to contend with the experience of a four-hundred-year-old being like Ryu. By copying Uro's power to control space, Yuta turned his opponent's own destructive force against him. Even without Rika backing him up, Yuta bought enough time for his plan to succeed by matching Ryu in close combat. Once Yuta was victorious, Ryu proudly admitted that Yuta gave him the most satisfying fight he's ever had, proving that Yuta's strength surpasses that of the vast majority of jujutsu sorcerers, past or present.
